bloxd.io 更新ウォッチ

bloxd.io の更新を自動で見張って、「ゲームの中で何が変わったか」を日本語でまとめます。非公式の個人用ページで、運営とは無関係です。

📚 詳しい分析ドキュメント🗺️ シードマップ(好きな番号)✨ エンチャント早見表 🏆 エンチャントの最適な組み合わせ 🌍 世界の作られ方(鉱石・チェスト)

最後に確認した時刻2026/11/11 09:00
現在のビルドitj4su
検知した更新18 回
最後の更新2026/11/11 01:30

✨ 更新と、ゲーム内の変化

最新2026年11月11日 01:30890cfc → itj4su

シェーダーパックの「一覧・公開」ページ(探す、検索、人気順、比較、公開、更新、削除)と、Frontline のラウンド終了の表彰(勝敗・MVP・活躍の発表)。なお、「約 2 万 6 千行の削除」に見えるのは、文言が別のファイルに移っただけ

＋ 新しい文言 101－ 削除 8104🎮 新ゲーム 13
🎨
遊ぶ人・作る人

シェーダーパックの「一覧ページ」が追加(80 項目)

シェーダーパック(見た目を変える追加データ)を、探して使えるページです。「Browse Shader Packs(探す)」「My Packs(自分のパック)」「検索」、並び順は「人気 / 更新順 / 新着」、場面ごとの見本は「森 / 砂漠 / 水 / 夜 / 洞窟」、絞り込みは「地形 / 水 / 空 / モデル / 影 / すべてのゲーム」です。パックごとに、ダウンロード数、大きさ(KB)、ファイル数、更新日、作成日、「Lag(重さの目安 %)」が出ます。「Compare」で、パックを使った絵と、標準の絵を見比べられます。「Use Pack」で使えて、別のシェーダー API 用のパックや、この端末でエラーになるパックは、使えない旨が出ます。
【公開する人向け】「Publish Pack」で公開できます(ログインが必要)。大きさに上限があり(上限の KB は変数)、エラーがないかの確認が出ます。公開すると、すぐ一覧に載り、そのあと、スクリーンショットが自動で作られます(更新時は、最大 30 分ごと)。名前の変更、説明の編集、一覧から外す(Unlist)、再び載せる、新しい版のアップロード、削除ができます。削除しても、使っている人は自分の分を持ち続けます。管理者に消された場合は、本人にだけ見えます。ゲームの更新で動かなくなったパックは、直すまで隠されます。作り方の助けは、BloxdHub のサイトに案内されています。

「スクリーンショットが自動で作られる」は、文言の「generated」からの読みです。人気順の決まり方、1 人が公開できる数は、不明です。

確かさ: 文言は確実 / 画面の見た目は未確認
🏁
遊ぶ人

Frontline: ラウンド終了の画面(勝敗と表彰)

ラウンドの終わりに、Victory / Defeat / Draw / Comeback の表示と、MVP、2 位、3 位が出ます。「次の戦場: ○○ まで ○ 秒」の案内もあります。個人の活躍の発表は、倒した数、アシスト、拠点の占領を手伝った数、拠点での撃破数、与えたダメージ、連続キルの最高記録、乗り物を壊した数、の 7 種類です。HUD に「Round over」の表示も入りました。

どの活躍が、どの順で表彰されるかは、文言からは分かりません。

確かさ: 文言は確実
⚠️
更新ウォッチの見方

「約 2 万 6 千行の削除」は、見かけだけ(文言が別のファイルに移動)

今回のレポートの自動比較では、スカイブロック、Build a Factory 2、ワンブロック、99 Nights などの文言が、大量に「削除」と出ています。しかし、実際には、ゲームの文言が main.js から、別のチャンク(番号 24)に移っただけです。移動後の文言まで含めて、前回と比べ直すと、実際の変化は、追加 102 行、削除 3 行、変更 0 行でした。追加は、シェーダーパック一覧 80 行、Frontline のラウンド終了 20 行、シェーダー 1 行、スカイブロック 1 行です。削除 3 行は、シューティングの「無料の連続キルのパークを選ぼう」というヒント、スカイブロックの「閉じている間に入れる人」の表示、Frontline の HUD の 1 行です。Build a Factory 2 の「Conveyor Belt」「Assembler」などのアイテムも、文言は残っています(ゲームのチャンクで確認)。

この「文言の移動」で、更新ウォッチの自動比較は、今後、移動先のチャンクを見られなくなりました(main.js の約 2,000 行だけを比べる状態)。直す場合は、移動先のチャンクも比較に含める必要があります。

確かさ: 確認済み(新しいゲームの本体ファイルに、同じ文言が残っている)

    Place it on a Deposit. Digs twice as fast as a Burner Drill, and runs on power instead of fuel. Made at the Machine Bench.

  • －
    autoBenchDescription

    Makes parts and belts by itself. Tap it holding what it should make, then belt in the ingredients. Runs on power. Made at the Machine Bench.

  • －

  • －
    treeCutterDescription

    Cuts and replants the tree at its saw side. Logs come out the front. Runs on fuel. Made at the Machine Bench.

    sortingGateDescription

    storageSiloDescription

    chargeVaultDescription

    Lets your island store 8000 more power. Made at the Machine Bench.

  • －
    spencerDialogue1_1_1

    Welcome to the Painter's Guild!

  • －
    spencerDialogue1_1_2

    Every block is a canvas if you squint hard enough

  • －
    spencerDialogue5_1_1

    Need something painted? I'm your man.

  • －
    spencerDialogue5_1_2

    Just don't ask about the ceiling incident.

  • －
    spencerDialogue2_1_1

    Did I ever tell you I painted Maverick's house?

  • －
    spencerDialogue2_1_2

    He wanted 'Ocean Sunrise'.

  • －
    spencerDialogue2_1_3

    It came out more like 'Swamp at Dusk'.

  • －
    spencerDialogue3_1_1

    I see colours everywhere.

  • －
    spencerDialogue3_1_2

    It's a gift. Also a problem

  • －
    spencerDialogue3_1_3

    when trying to sleep.

  • －
    spencerDialogue4_1_1

    My art teacher said I had 'unique vision'.

  • －
    spencerDialogue4_1_2

    Pretty sure that was code for

  • －
    spencerDialogue4_1_3

    'please stop eating the paints'.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue1_1_1

    The name's Lorenzo.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue1_1_2

    Monster hunter by trade.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue1_1_3

    Mob drop seller... also by trade.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue1_1_4

    He's the one who told me to set up here.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue1_2_1

    Good thing too,

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue1_2_2

    this village could use someone with my expertise.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue2_1_1

    Back in my adventuring days,

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue2_1_2

    Maverick once teleported us

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue2_1_3

    into a chicken coop by accident.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue2_1_4

    We don't talk about it.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue3_1_1

    You want monsters dealt with?

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue3_1_2

    I'm your guy.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue3_1_3

    Reasonable rates. Unreasonable bravery.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue4_1_1

    People ask how I stay so calm

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue4_1_2

    around dangerous creatures.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue4_2_1

    The secret? I'm not calm at all.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue4_2_2

    I'm just very good at pretending.

  • －
    gillDialogue1_1_1

    Hey there! I'm Gill.

  • －
    gillDialogue1_1_2

    Fred's partner in crime.

  • －
    gillDialogue1_1_3

    Well, partner in farming, anyway.

  • －
    gillDialogue1_2_1

    He handles the animals,

  • －
    gillDialogue1_2_2

    I handle the crops.

  • －
    gillDialogue1_2_3

    We try not to swap.

  • －
    gillDialogue2_1_1

    Fred thinks he's the better farmer.

  • －
    gillDialogue2_1_2

    I let him believe that.

  • －
    gillDialogue2_1_3

    Keeps him motivated.

  • －
    gillDialogue3_1_1

    Come check out our finest produce!

  • －
    gillDialogue3_1_2

    Freshly grown, hand-picked,

  • －
    gillDialogue3_1_3

    and only slightly talked to.

  • －
    gillDialogue4_1_1

    Fred and I have been farming

  • －
    gillDialogue4_1_2

    since before Maverick showed up.

  • －
    gillDialogue4_2_1

    He brought all these magical portals.

  • －
    gillDialogue4_2_2

    I just wanted a quiet life

  • －
    gillDialogue4_2_3

    and some turnips.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue5_1_1

    Maverick and I used to adventure together.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue5_1_2

    He's the one who told me to set up here.

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue5_2_1

    Good thing too,

  • －
    lorenzoDialogue5_2_2

    this village could use someone with my expertise.

  • －
    redTulipKN

    The intense red color could signify anger or revenge, marking a vendetta that the killer is fulfilling through their crimes.

  • －
    dandelionKN

    Symbolizing resilience, the dandelion could represent the killer's ability to thrive in adversity, or their belief in a new beginning after every killing.

  • －
    pinkTulipKN

    This might symbolize an innocent love or affection, perhaps pointing to the killer's twisted perception of their relationship with the victim.

  • －
    whiteTulipKN

    The color white often symbolizes forgiveness or redemption. The killer might leave this flower to show remorse or to seek forgiveness for their actions, however misguided that sentiment might be.

  • －
    aspenSaplingKN

    The aspen tree is known for trembling leaves, which might symbolize fear or trepidation. The killer may see themselves as instilling fear in others or be driven by their own deep-seated fears.

  • －
    elmSaplingKN

    Elm trees are often associated with wisdom and communication. The killer could see their actions as delivering a profound message or a wisdom that others fail to comprehend.

  • －
    mossyMessyStoneKN

    The overgrown and disorderly aspect of this stone might hint at something neglected or a crime long-planned.

  • －
    diamondOreKN

    Symbolic of the victim being valuable or precious, or that they had something the killer wanted. Could hint at a motive of greed or envy.

  • －
    iceBricksKN

    Ice can symbolize coldness, both in terms of a cold-blooded killer and in terms of the victim being 'frozen out' or isolated.

  • －
    coalKN

    An item usually associated with punishment or judgment, perhaps left behind to symbolize the killer's perceived justice.

  • －
    vinesKN

    Possibly symbolizing the killer's reach, spreading like vines and impossible to escape.

  • －
    blackBedKN

    This could represent the eternal sleep that the killer has sentenced the victim to.

  • －
    redSandstoneKN

    This could symbolize the blood spilled and the desert-like emptiness left behind.

  • －
    glassKN

    Perhaps symbolizing the fragility of life, or a hint that the killer sees through people.

  • －
    engravedStoneKN

    This could include cryptic symbols or messages, leading investigators on a chase to decode the killer's next move.

  • －
    hyperCompressedMessyStoneKN

    The intense pressure used to create this stone could symbolize the stress or force that drives the killer.

  • －
    cactusKN

    The prickly and unforgiving nature of a cactus could symbolize the killer's personality or approach to their victims.

  • －
    protectorKN

    A very ironic item to leave at a murder scene, this could suggest a warped sense of justice on the part of the killer, or perhaps a desire to taunt law enforcement or other 'protectors'

  • －
    magmaKN

    This hot and dangerous substance could represent the killer's anger or intensity.

  • －
    cobwebKN

    A cobweb might signify the killer's ability to ensnare victims, possibly relating to a theme of manipulation or deceit.

    questCragrockMinesMailName

    questCragrockMinesMailDescription

    There you are! I've been watching for you. A huge meteor has just hit Cragrock Mines, and the dwarves there need help right now. Ruby's mum lives down there, so Ruby knows the way. Hurry to her!

  • －
    questWildInfernosMailDescription

    There you are! The portal to the Wild Infernos can finally be opened. One of my guild's mages went there to study its fire, and I haven't heard from them since. Lorenzo knows that desert better than anyone. Go and find him!

    Lovely work, neighbour! This island gets brighter every day.

    spencerQuestGreeting

    Hello, neighbour! Pop over here a moment!

  • －
    spencerInventoryFull

    Your pockets are packed! Make a little room and come back.

  • －
    spencerIronTrophyShelf

    That Iron Trophy [[Iron Trophy]] of yours still makes me smile, neighbour. You earned every bit of it!

  • －
    spencerGoldTrophyShelf

    Gold suits you, neighbour! Your Gold Trophy [[Gold Trophy]] makes the whole island feel grand.

  • －
    spencerDiamondTrophyShelf

    I still can't get over your Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]], neighbour. My finest work yet, and all thanks to you!

  • －
    spencerMoonstoneTrophyShelf

    Every night I peek at your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]], neighbour. It's like a little moon on your island!

  • －
    spencerMoonstoneTrophyShelfDay

    I can't wait for dark, neighbour. That's when your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] shines its brightest!

  • －
    spencerWheatHelperFullRemark

    Your Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]] is full to the brim, neighbour! Empty it and it'll get right back to work.

  • －
    spencerCarrotHelperFullRemark

    Your Carrot Helper [[Carrot Helper]] can't squeeze in another Carrot [[Carrot]], neighbour! Empty it and it'll get right back to work.

  • －
    spencerMelonHelperFullRemark

    Your Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]] is piled high with Melon Slices [[Melon Slice]], neighbour! Empty it and it'll get right back to work.

  • －
    spencerCoalSeamRemark

    Every speckle of Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] in your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] brightens my day, neighbour!

  • －
    spencerIronSeamRemark

    I'd love to bottle the colour of those warm little flecks of Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] in your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]], neighbour!

  • －
    spencerGoldSeamRemark

    Whenever Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] glints in your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]], I stop and stare, neighbour. No paint of mine shines like that!

  • －
    miniNothingToDo

    Lorenzo has a task for you. I'll spare you the speech about his cape. We both know who won the last bout.

  • －
    watchDogOverview

    The orange portal leads to a dangerous, twisted realm. Its dungeons must be kept contained so the Hub stays safe. Stay alert in there.

  • －
    questForagingLevelOneName

    Woodland Ways

  • －
    questForagingLevelOneDescription

    Ah, glad you're here. I found this axe at the back of my cupboard. It's yours to keep. Bring me 10 Maple Log [[Maple Log]], and we'll get you started.

  • －
    questForagingFirstDescription

    Chop 10 Maple Log [[Maple Log]] in my woods and bring them back to me. Take care of the woods.

  • －
    questForagingFirstReminder

    Back again. You need {{remaining}} more Maple Log [[Maple Log]] for this delivery. Keep your cuts careful.

  • －
    questForagingSecondReminder

    Still need {{remaining}} more Maple Log [[Maple Log]]. The Wooden Mapletwin is waiting.

  • －
    questForagingFirstDelivery

    Bring Timbertooth 10 Maple Log [[Maple Log]]

  • －
    questForagingFirstTurnIn

    Thank you. Clean work. Bring me 20 more Maple Log [[Maple Log]]. I've a Wooden Mapletwin for you.

  • －
    questForagingSecondDescription

    Chop 20 more Maple Log [[Maple Log]] in my woods. I will trade you a special axe of mine that you may find useful. Keep your cuts careful.

  • －
    questForagingSecondDelivery

    Bring Timbertooth 20 more Maple Log [[Maple Log]]

  • －
    questForagingCompleted

    Good work. Take this Wooden Mapletwin. It cuts Maple Log [[Maple Log]] faster, two at a time when they're touching. Make use of it, but mind the woods.

  • －
    questCombatLevelOneName

    A Duellist's First Steps

  • －
    questCombatLevelOneDescription

    Take my Practice Sword and face the Zombies in the Badlands! It adds a little bite to every blow. Bring me 4 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]] as proof of your escapades.

  • －
    questCombatFirstDescription

    Face the Zombies roaming the Badlands and bring me 4 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]] as proof of your courage!

  • －
    questCombatFirstReminder

    Back for an encore? Gather {{remaining}} more Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]] for this delivery. Chin up, duellist!

  • －
    questCombatSecondReminder

    Your next challenge needs {{remaining}} more Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]. A finer blade awaits your flourish!

  • －
    questCombatFirstDelivery

    Bring Lorenzo 4 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]

  • －
    questCombatFirstTurnIn

    Splendid! Thank you, brave duellist. Bring me 8 more Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]. Keep that courage, and I'll find you a finer blade!

  • －
    questCombatSecondDescription

    Bring me 8 more Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]] from the Badlands Zombies. A finer blade awaits your return!

  • －
    questCombatSecondDelivery

    Bring Lorenzo 8 more Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]

  • －
    questCombatCompleted

    Bravo! Thank you for thinning their ranks. Take this Iron Sword [[Iron Sword]]. Now that's a blade worthy of your flourish!

  • －
    questMiningLevelOneName

    Learning the Lode

  • －
    questMiningLevelOneDescription

    Take my Coal Pickaxe and bring me 10 Coal [[Coal]]. It'll cut through coal a little quicker. Stubborn rock? Be more stubborn!

  • －
    questMiningFirstDescription

    Mine 10 Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] here in Ruby's Rockpile and bring me the Coal [[Coal]]. Show that stubborn rock who's boss!

  • －
    questMiningFirstReminder

    Good to see you back! You need {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]] for this haul. Don't let the rocks win!

  • －
    questMiningSecondReminder

    Another {{remaining}} Coal [[Coal]] and this haul's done, friend. That better pickaxe is waiting!

  • －
    questMiningFirstDelivery

    Bring Ruby 10 Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questMiningFirstTurnIn

    Lovely haul, thank you! Bring me 20 more Coal [[Coal]]. I've got a better pickaxe for arms that won't quit.

  • －
    questMiningSecondDescription

    Mine 20 more Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] in Ruby's Rockpile and bring me the Coal [[Coal]], friend. There's a better pickaxe waiting for you!

  • －
    questMiningSecondDelivery

    Bring Ruby 20 more Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questMiningCompleted

    Thank you! That's a proper haul. This Cracked Rubellite Pickaxe [[Cracked Rubellite Pickaxe]] is yours. It swings like iron, even with that crack!

  • －
    questFarmingLevelOneName

    Seeds of Success

  • －
    questFarmingLevelOneDescription

    Take my hoe, dear. It harvests Wheat [[Wheat]] and Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] a little faster. Bring me 12 Wheat [[Wheat]] when you're ready.

  • －
    questFarmingFirstDescription

    Harvest 12 Wheat [[Wheat]] in my patch here in the hub, then bring it back to me when you're ready, dear.

  • －
    questFarmingFirstReminder

    Welcome back, dear. Gather {{remaining}} more Wheat [[Wheat]] for this harvest. There's no hurry.

  • －
    questFarmingSecondReminder

    Your next harvest needs {{remaining}} more Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]], dear. Your new hoe will be waiting.

  • －
    questFarmingFirstDelivery

    Bring Tillie 12 Wheat [[Wheat]]

  • －
    questFarmingFirstTurnIn

    Thank you, dear. A fine first harvest. Bring me 24 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] when you're ready, and I'll give you a hoe that harvests three crops at once, just right for your growing garden.

  • －
    questFarmingSecondDescription

    Harvest 24 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] in my patch here in the hub, dear, then bring them to me. Take your time. A hoe that harvests three crops at once will be waiting for you.

  • －
    questFarmingSecondDelivery

    Bring Tillie 24 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]]

  • －
    questFarmingCompleted

    Thank you, dear. You've tended that well. Take my Field Hoe to harvest three ripe crops in a row. May your garden keep growing.

  • －
    questFishingLevelOneName

    Learning the Lines

  • －
    questFishingLevelOneDescription

    Take my Old Rod and cast into water. The fish will bite a little sooner. Bring me 4 fish, matey.

  • －
    questFishingFirstDescription

    Cast into the water by my shack and catch 4 fish, matey, then bring them back to me. Any fish will do!

  • －
    questFishingFirstReminder

    Back aboard, matey? Catch {{remaining}} more fish for this delivery.

  • －
    questFishingSecondReminder

    Another {{remaining}} fish and this delivery's done, matey. Then that sturdier rod is yours.

  • －
    questFishingFirstDelivery

    Bring Blubberbeard 4 fish

  • －
    questFishingFirstTurnIn

    A fine catch. Thank you, matey. Bring me 8 more fish. There's a sturdier rod waiting for patient hands.

  • －
    questFishingSecondDescription

    Catch 8 more fish by my shack and bring them to me, matey. Any fish will do. A sturdier rod awaits.

  • －
    questFishingSecondDelivery

    Bring Blubberbeard 8 more fish

  • －
    questFishingCompleted

    Thank you, matey. Fine fishing. My Quick Rod is yours. Fish bite on it quicker than on my Old Rod.

  • －
    questMeetMaverickOnIslandName

    Meet Maverick at Your Island

  • －
    questMeetMaverickOnIslandDescription

    Your island could use a little adventure too! Meet me back there when you're ready.

  • －
    questMeetMaverickOnIslandSpencerDescription

    Your island's got a new neighbour! Meet me back there.

  • －
    maverickIntroduceSpencer

    Spencer's moved in to brighten your island up, and it's looking lovelier already!

  • －
    questReturnToIslandDescription

    Return to your island and speak to me beside the portal.

  • －
    questMapleGroveName

    Maple Grove

  • －
    questMapleGroveDescription

    Your island could use a little shade! Grow 5 Maple trees.

  • －
    questSpencerMapleGroveDescription

    Hi, I'm Spencer, your new neighbour! A painter needs a pretty view, so let's start with some shade. Grow 5 Maple trees!

  • －
    questCraftMapleSaplingName

    Craft a Maple Sapling [[Maple Sapling]]

  • －
    questCraftMapleSaplingDescription

    At the Workbench [[Workbench]] on your island, combine 1 Maple Log [[Maple Log]] and 1 Maple Leaves [[Maple Leaves]] to make a Maple Sapling [[Maple Sapling]]. Break the leaves on a Maple tree to collect Maple Leaves [[Maple Leaves]].

  • －
    questSpencerCraftMapleSaplingDescription

    Every grove starts with one! Break the leaves on a Maple tree to collect Maple Leaves [[Maple Leaves]], then combine 1 Maple Log [[Maple Log]] and 1 Maple Leaves [[Maple Leaves]] at the Workbench [[Workbench]] on your island to make a Maple Sapling [[Maple Sapling]].

  • －
    questGrowMapleTreesName

    Grow 5 Maple Trees

  • －
    questGrowMapleTreesDescription

    Plant new Maple Sapling [[Maple Sapling]] on your island and stay there while 5 of them grow into trees.

  • －
    questSpencerGrowMapleTreesDescription

    Plant Maple Saplings [[Maple Sapling]] on your island and stay there while 5 of them grow into trees. I can't wait to paint them!

  • －
    questCropCirclesName

    Crop Circles

  • －
    questCropCirclesDescription

    Try a little garden magic! Plant 9 Wheat Seeds [[Wheat Seeds]] in a 3 by 3 square on flat ground on your island, and stick around while they all grow. Need seeds? Harvest Wheat [[Wheat]] at Tillie's Patch in the Hub!

  • －
    questSpencerCropCirclesDescription

    A splash of gold would brighten this place right up! Plant 9 Wheat Seeds [[Wheat Seeds]] in a 3 by 3 square on flat ground on your island, and stick around while they all grow. Need seeds? Harvest Wheat [[Wheat]] at Tillie's Patch in the Hub!

  • －
    questGrowWheatSquareDescription

    Plant 9 Wheat Seeds [[Wheat Seeds]] in a 3 by 3 square on flat ground on your island, then stay on your island until all 9 are fully grown. Harvesting Wheat [[Wheat]] at Tillie's Patch in the Hub gives you seeds.

  • －
    questSpencerGrowWheatSquareDescription

    Plant 9 Wheat Seeds [[Wheat Seeds]] in a 3 by 3 square on flat ground on your island, then stay on your island until all 9 are fully grown. Harvest Wheat [[Wheat]] at Tillie's Patch in the Hub for seeds.

  • －
    questRemoteTradingName

    Trading from Home

  • －
    questSpencerRemoteTradingDescription

    I'm forever dashing to the Hub to buy paint! Up Dog sells a Trading Terminal [[Trading Terminal]] at his Market there. Get one, and we can trade right here at home!

  • －
    questBuyTradingTerminalName

    Buy a Trading Terminal [[Trading Terminal]] from Up Dog

  • －
    questSpencerBuyTradingTerminalDescription

    Buy a Trading Terminal [[Trading Terminal]] from Up Dog at the Market in the Hub for 100 [[Gold Coin]].

  • －
    questPlaceTradingTerminalName

    Place Your Trading Terminal [[Trading Terminal]] on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerPlaceTradingTerminalDescription

    Place your Trading Terminal [[Trading Terminal]] anywhere on your island. Somewhere with a nice view, please!

  • －
    questTerminalTradeName

    Sell Something at Your Trading Terminal [[Trading Terminal]]

  • －
    questSpencerTerminalTradeDescription

    Stand by your Trading Terminal [[Trading Terminal]] and open the Market. Sell something you've gathered with Instant Sell, or list it on the Market for other players to buy!

  • －
    questTerminalPurchaseName

    Buy or Order Something at Your Trading Terminal [[Trading Terminal]]

  • －
    questSpencerTerminalPurchaseDescription

    Buy something from the Market at your Trading Terminal [[Trading Terminal]], or place an order for something in its Orders tab. Treat yourself!

  • －
    questStoneSpringName

    A Spring of Stone

  • －
    questSpencerStoneSpringDescription

    I'm painting a stone path, but stone's so heavy to haul from the Hub! Bring me 32 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]], and I'll swap you something that grows its own.

  • －
    questStoneSpringGatherName

    Gather 32 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]]

  • －
    questSpencerStoneSpringGatherDescription

    Mine Stone [[Stone]] at Ruby's Rockpile in the Hub until you have 32 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]].

  • －
    questStoneSpringHandInName

    Bring 32 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerStoneSpringHandInDescription

    Bring the 32 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerStoneSpringHandedIn

    Wonderful, thank you! Here's a Stone Generator [[Stone Generator]]. Fresh Stone [[Stone]] grows right on top of it!

  • －
    questSpencerStoneSpringReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]] to go! Mine Stone [[Stone]] at Ruby's Rockpile in the Hub.

  • －
    questPlaceStoneGeneratorName

    Place the Stone Generator [[Stone Generator]] on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerPlaceStoneGeneratorDescription

    Place your Stone Generator [[Stone Generator]] on your island, with open air above it. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • －
    questMineGeneratedStoneName

    Mine 10 Stone [[Stone]] Grown by Your Stone Generator [[Stone Generator]]

  • －
    questSpencerMineGeneratedStoneDescription

    Stay on your island and mine 10 Stone [[Stone]] as it grows on top of your Stone Generator [[Stone Generator]]. Lost the generator? I've got another for you.

  • －
    questCosyCabinName

    Four Walls and a Window

  • －
    questSpencerCosyCabinDescription

    Neighbour, this island needs a cosy cabin, and I'm itching to paint one! Every cabin starts with a front door, so craft a Maple Door [[Maple Door]] at the Workbench [[Workbench]] on your island.

  • －
    questCraftCabinDoorName

    Craft 1 Maple Door [[Maple Door]] at the Workbench [[Workbench]] on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerCraftCabinDoorDescription

    Craft a Maple Door [[Maple Door]] at the Workbench [[Workbench]] on your island. Every cabin starts with a front door!

  • －
    questSmeltCabinGlassName

    Smelt 4 Glass [[Glass]] at a Furnace [[Furnace]]

  • －
    questSpencerSmeltCabinGlassDescription

    A cabin needs windows for the view! Dig Sand [[Sand]] on the beach by Blubberbeard's Shack in the Hub, then smelt 4 Glass [[Glass]] with a Coal [[Coal]] at a Furnace [[Furnace]].

  • －
    questBuildCosyCabinName

    Build a Cabin Around Your Maple Door [[Maple Door]] on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerBuildCosyCabinDescription

    Place your Maple Door [[Maple Door]] on your island and build a cabin around it, no more than 4 blocks from the door: 20 blocks of wood or stone wall, as tall as the door, 4 Glass [[Glass]] windows, 2 Torches [[Torch]] to light it and a wood or stone roof over 9 blocks of floor.

  • －
    questLighthouseName

    Light the Way

  • －
    questSpencerLighthouseDescription

    Your cabin looks wonderful, neighbour! Now I'd love a lighthouse to paint, shining out over the sky. First, set down that Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]] and craft a Lantern [[Lantern]] at it.

  • －
    questCraftLighthouseLanternName

    Craft 1 Lantern [[Lantern]] at an Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]] on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerCraftLighthouseLanternDescription

    Place your Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]] on your island and craft a Lantern [[Lantern]] at it. Its Iron Bar [[Iron Bar]] comes from Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]]: mine it at Ruby's Rockpile in the Hub with a Stone Pickaxe [[Stone Pickaxe]] or better.

  • －
    questBuildLighthouseName

    Build a Tower 10 Blocks Tall With Your Lantern [[Lantern]] on Top

  • －
    questSpencerBuildLighthouseDescription

    Build a wood or stone tower at least 10 blocks tall on your island and set your Lantern [[Lantern]] right on top. Somewhere everyone can see it, please!

  • －
    questCarrotPatchName

    The Carrot Patch

  • －
    questSpencerCarrotPatchDescription

    Your Wheat [[Wheat]] square was lovely, neighbour, but I'm dreaming of a bigger splash of orange! Gather 16 Carrot Seeds [[Carrot Seeds]] at Goldenroot Burrow in Manor Farm.

  • －
    questGatherCarrotSeedsName

    Gather 16 Carrot Seeds [[Carrot Seeds]] at Manor Farm

  • －
    questSpencerGatherCarrotSeedsDescription

    Harvest ripe Carrots [[Carrot]] at Goldenroot Burrow in Manor Farm until you have 16 Carrot Seeds [[Carrot Seeds]].

  • －
    questGrowCarrotSquareName

    Grow 16 Carrots [[Carrot]] in a 4 by 4 Square on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerGrowCarrotSquareDescription

    Plant 16 Carrot Seeds [[Carrot Seeds]] in a 4 by 4 square on flat ground on your island, then stay on your island until all 16 are fully grown. Harvest Carrots [[Carrot]] at Goldenroot Burrow in Manor Farm for more seeds.

  • －
    questFlowerBedsName

    Bloom and Grow

  • －
    questSpencerFlowerBedsDescription

    Those Carrots [[Carrot]] are a picture, neighbour! Now I'm longing for some colour. Gather 4 of each of these flowers at Goldenroot Burrow in Manor Farm: Red Tulip [[Red Tulip]], Pink Tulip [[Pink Tulip]] and Daisy [[Daisy]].

  • －
    questGatherRedTulipsName

    Gather 4 Red Tulips [[Red Tulip]] at Manor Farm

  • －
    questSpencerGatherRedTulipsDescription

    Pick 4 Red Tulips [[Red Tulip]] in Manor Farm. They grow all over, and Goldenroot Burrow has plenty.

  • －
    questGatherPinkTulipsName

    Gather 4 Pink Tulips [[Pink Tulip]] at Manor Farm

  • －
    questSpencerGatherPinkTulipsDescription

    Pick 4 Pink Tulips [[Pink Tulip]] in Manor Farm. They grow all over, and Goldenroot Burrow has plenty.

  • －
    questGatherDaisiesName

    Gather 4 Daisy [[Daisy]] at Manor Farm

  • －
    questSpencerGatherDaisiesDescription

    Pick 4 Daisy [[Daisy]] in Manor Farm. They grow all over, and Goldenroot Burrow has plenty.

  • －
    questBuildFlowerBedName

    Plant a Flower Bed of 12 Flowers, 3 Kinds or More, on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerBuildFlowerBedDescription

    Plant 12 flowers close together on your island, at least 3 different kinds, all within 3 blocks of one flower in the middle. A splash of colour for my next painting!

  • －
    questFishPondName

    A Splash of Blue

  • －
    questSpencerFishPondDescription

    A garden needs water, neighbour, and I'd love a pond to paint! Here are 3 more Buckets [[Bucket]]. With the one I gave you, fill 4 Water Buckets [[Water Bucket]] at the water by Blubberbeard's Shack in the Hub.

  • －
    questFillWaterBucketsName

    Fill 4 Water Buckets [[Water Bucket]] in the Hub

  • －
    questSpencerFillWaterBucketsDescription

    Use your Buckets [[Bucket]] on the water by Blubberbeard's Shack in the Hub until you hold 4 Water Buckets [[Water Bucket]]. Your island has no water of its own!

  • －
    questBuildPondName

    Pour 4 Water Buckets [[Water Bucket]] Side by Side for a Pond on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerBuildPondDescription

    Pour your 4 Water Buckets [[Water Bucket]] side by side on your island, all at the same height with ground under each. A hole 2 blocks wide, 2 long and 1 deep is perfect. My very own pond!

  • －
    questCatchPondFishName

    Catch 1 Fish in Your Pond on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerCatchPondFishDescription

    Cast your fishing rod into your new pond on your island and catch a fish. I've never painted a fish before!

  • －
    questOrchardName

    The Orchard

  • －
    questSpencerOrchardDescription

    A pond looks its best with fruit trees round it, neighbour! First, find a Palm Sapling [[Palm Sapling]] on the palm trees along the Hub's beach.

  • －
    questGatherPalmSaplingName

    Gather 1 Palm Sapling [[Palm Sapling]] on the Hub's Beach

  • －
    questSpencerGatherPalmSaplingDescription

    Break the leaves on the palm trees on the beach east of Blubberbeard's Shack in the Hub until a Palm Sapling [[Palm Sapling]] drops. Not every leaf has one, so keep at it!

  • －
    questGatherPearSaplingsName

    Gather 2 Pear Saplings [[Pear Sapling]] at Manor Farm

  • －
    questSpencerGatherPearSaplingsDescription

    Break the leaves on the pear trees at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm until you have 2 Pear Saplings [[Pear Sapling]]. Not every leaf has one, so keep at it!

  • －
    questGrowPalmTreeName

    Set your Gold Trophy [[Gold Trophy]] down on your island, next to your Iron Trophy [[Iron Trophy]] if you like. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • －
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyDescription

    Iron, gold... and now diamond, neighbour! For a Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]] I need 6 Diamonds [[Diamond]] from Shale's Goofy Golems, and 8 Fireballs [[Fireball]] to set a flame dancing inside it.

  • －
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyWaitingOn

    I've a sparkling idea for a Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]], neighbour! It needs Diamonds [[Diamond]] from Shale's Goofy Golems in Cragrock Mines, and Fireballs [[Fireball]] from the Wild Infernos. Help Shale with his herd, and Lorenzo at the Badlands in the Hub can show you the way to the Wild Infernos!

  • －
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyCompleted

    Three trophies to your name, neighbour! That's a sight to be proud of.

  • －
    questDiamondTrophyName

    Diamond Bright

  • －
    questDiamondTrophyDiamondsGatherName

    Shear 6 Diamonds [[Diamond]] from the Goofy Golems

  • －
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyDiamondsGatherDescription

    Shear Shale's Goofy Golems in Glimmerdeep Hollow, in Cragrock Mines, until you have 6 Diamonds [[Diamond]]. Set a Moonstone Explosive [[Moonstone Explosive]] down beside them and stand well back, or swing a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]]. Shale trades more explosives for Moonstone [[Moonstone]].

  • －
    questDiamondTrophyDiamondsHandInName

    Bring 6 Diamonds [[Diamond]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyDiamondsHandInDescription

    Bring the 6 Diamonds [[Diamond]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyDiamondsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Diamonds [[Diamond]] to go! Shale's Goofy Golems in Glimmerdeep Hollow have plenty.

  • －
    questDiamondTrophyFireballsGatherName

    Gather 8 Fireballs [[Fireball]] from Magma Golems

  • －
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyFireballsGatherDescription

    Knock the Magma Golems off the skeleton's ribs at the Shooting Gallery in the Wild Infernos until you have 8 Fireballs [[Fireball]]. Flint can show you how!

  • －
    questDiamondTrophyFireballsHandInName

    Bring 8 Fireballs [[Fireball]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyFireballsHandInDescription

    Bring the 8 Fireballs [[Fireball]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyFireballsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Fireballs [[Fireball]] to go! The Magma Golems at the Shooting Gallery drop them when they fall.

  • －
    questMakeDiamondTrophyName

    Get Your Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]] from Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerMakeDiamondTrophyDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll hand over your Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]].

  • －
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyMade

    Sparkling bright, with a flame dancing inside! Give your Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]] the best spot on your island, neighbour.

  • －
    questPlaceDiamondTrophyName

    Place the Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]] on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerPlaceDiamondTrophyDescription

    Set your Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]] down anywhere on your island. It'll look best beside your other trophies! Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • －
    questMoonstoneTrophyName

    Over the Moon

  • －
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyDescription

    Iron, gold, diamond... and now moonstone, neighbour! For a Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] I need 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] from across the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines, and 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] to make it glow like the moon.

  • －
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyWaitingOn

    I've a shining idea for a Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]], neighbour! Its Moonstone [[Moonstone]] grows past the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines, and only Grubnik's cannons can fire you over. Pay Grubnik his fee and he'll send you flying!

  • －
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyCompleted

    Four trophies, shining like the night sky! Your shelf is the talk of the islands, neighbour.

  • －
    questMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneGatherName

    Mine 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] Across the Broken Bridge

  • －
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneGatherDescription

    Ride Grubnik's cannon over the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines, and mine the Moonstone Ore [[Moonstone Ore]] on the far wall until you have 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]]. A Pure Moonstone Ore [[Pure Moonstone Ore]] is slower to mine but gives 9 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] at once. Your Cracked Rubellite Pickaxe [[Cracked Rubellite Pickaxe]] mines Moonstone [[Moonstone]] from both, as does an Iron Pickaxe [[Iron Pickaxe]] or better, but a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]] gives you the ore itself instead.

  • －
    questMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneHandInName

    Bring 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneHandInDescription

    Bring the 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Moonstone [[Moonstone]] to go! Grubnik's cannon fires you over the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines to the Moonstone Ore [[Moonstone Ore]].

  • －
    questMoonstoneTrophyLanternsGatherName

    Craft 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] at Your Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]]

  • －
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyLanternsGatherDescription

    Craft 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] at the Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]] on your island. A little light makes moonstone shine!

  • －
    questMoonstoneTrophyLanternsHandInName

    Bring 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyLanternsHandInDescription

    Bring the 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyLanternsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Lanterns [[Lantern]] to go! Craft them at the Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]] on your island.

  • －
    questMakeMoonstoneTrophyName

    Get Your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] from Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerMakeMoonstoneTrophyDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll hand over your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]].

  • －
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMade

    Pale as a full moon! Here's your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]], neighbour. It'll catch the moonlight all night long.

  • －
    questPlaceMoonstoneTrophyName

    Place the Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerPlaceMoonstoneTrophyDescription

    Set your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] down on your island, beside your other trophies. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • －
    questForgeBannerName

    Banner of the Forge

  • －
    questSpencerForgeBannerDescription

    My trophies show off what you gather, neighbour, but a real hero needs banners for the bosses they beat! Bring down the Forge Warden in Skullforge, or tell me if you already have, and I'll paint you a Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] to prove it.

  • －
    questBeatForgeBossName

    Beat the Forge Warden in Skullforge

  • －
    questSpencerBeatForgeBossDescription

    Go through the dungeon portal in the Hub, use Skullforge's statue in the dungeon hall, and beat the Forge Warden at the end of the dungeon. Any difficulty counts!

  • －
    questFetchForgeBannerName

    Get Your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] from Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerFetchForgeBannerDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll paint your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]].

  • －
    questSpencerForgeBannerPainted

    You beat the Forge Warden! Here's your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]], neighbour. Careful, the paint's still wet!

  • －
    questPlaceForgeBannerName

    Put Up the Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerPlaceForgeBannerDescription

    Hang your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] on a wall or stand it on the ground, anywhere on your island. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • －
    questSpencerForgeBannerCompleted

    Your first banner, flying high! Everyone who visits will know you beat the Forge Warden, neighbour.

  • －
    questFrostBannerName

    Banner of the Frost

  • －
    questSpencerFrostBannerDescription

    Your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] needs some company, neighbour! Beat the Frost Wraith in Frozen Hollow, or tell me if you already have, and I'll paint you a Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] to go with it. Fair warning: it's tougher than the Forge Warden!

  • －
    questBeatFrostBossName

    Beat the Frost Wraith in Frozen Hollow

  • －
    questSpencerBeatFrostBossDescription

    Go through the dungeon portal in the Hub, use Frozen Hollow's statue in the dungeon hall, and beat the Frost Wraith at the end of the dungeon. Any difficulty counts!

  • －
    questFetchFrostBannerName

    Get Your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] from Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerFetchFrostBannerDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll paint your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]].

  • －
    questSpencerFrostBannerPainted

    You beat the Frost Wraith! Here's your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]], neighbour. I painted it so frosty, I needed mittens!

  • －
    questPlaceFrostBannerName

    Put Up the Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerPlaceFrostBannerDescription

    Hang your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] on a wall or stand it on the ground, anywhere on your island. It'll look best beside your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]]! Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • －
    questSpencerFrostBannerCompleted

    Two banners flying! The Forge Warden and the Frost Wraith, both beaten. What a hero you are, neighbour!

  • －
    questWildBannerName

    Banner of the Wilds

  • －
    questSpencerWildBannerDescription

    Two banners up, neighbour, and the wilds are calling! The Tiki Terror in Wildwood Grove is the toughest boss yet! Beat it, or tell me if you already have, and I'll paint you a Green Banner [[Green Banner]] as leafy as the grove itself.

  • －
    questBeatWildBossName

    Beat the Tiki Terror in Wildwood Grove

  • －
    questSpencerBeatWildBossDescription

    Go through the dungeon portal in the Hub, use Wildwood Grove's statue in the dungeon hall, and beat the Tiki Terror at the end of the dungeon. Any difficulty counts!

  • －
    questFetchWildBannerName

    Get Your Green Banner [[Green Banner]] from Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerFetchWildBannerDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll paint your Green Banner [[Green Banner]].

  • －
    questSpencerWildBannerPainted

    You beat the Tiki Terror! Here's your Green Banner [[Green Banner]], neighbour, as green as a fresh spring leaf.

  • －
    questPlaceWildBannerName

    Put Up the Green Banner [[Green Banner]] on Your Island

  • －
    questSpencerPlaceWildBannerDescription

    Hang your Green Banner [[Green Banner]] on a wall or stand it on the ground, anywhere on your island, beside your other banners. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • －
    questSpencerWildBannerCompleted

    Three banners for three bosses! Your island looks like a real hall of heroes now, neighbour.

  • －
    questCoalSeamName

    A Seam of Coal

  • －
    questSpencerCoalSeamDescription

    Neighbour, what if your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grew Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] as well as Stone [[Stone]]? Old Smudge works the coal quarry in Cragrock Mines, and nobody knows coal like he does. Go and ask him how it gets into rock!

  • －
    questSpencerCoalSeamWaitingOn

    I've a bright idea for your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]], neighbour, but it needs coal from Cragrock Mines. Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile in the Hub can show you the way there!

  • －
    questSpencerCoalSeamCompleted

    Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] growing right here at home, neighbour! Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] are full of surprises now.

  • －
    questCoalSeamMeetSmudgeName

    Ask Old Smudge in Cragrock Mines About Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questSpencerCoalSeamMeetSmudgeDescription

    Find Old Smudge at the top of the coal quarry in Cragrock Mines' entrance yard, and ask him how coal gets into rock.

  • －
    questSpencerCoalSeamMeetSmudgeNext

    That's the coal sorted, neighbour! Now pop over to Old Smudge in Cragrock Mines and ask him how it gets into rock.

  • －
    questCoalSeamCoalGatherName

    Gather 32 Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questSpencerCoalSeamCoalGatherDescription

    Mine the Pure Coal Ore [[Pure Coal Ore]] in Old Smudge's coal quarry in Cragrock Mines until you have 32 Coal [[Coal]].

  • －
    questCoalSeamCoalHandInName

    Bring 32 Coal [[Coal]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerCoalSeamCoalHandInDescription

    Bring the 32 Coal [[Coal]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerCoalSeamCoalReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]] to go! Old Smudge's coal quarry in Cragrock Mines is full of it.

  • －
    questCoalSeamUpgradeName

    Have Spencer Seed Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questSpencerCoalSeamUpgradeDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll seed your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with the Coal [[Coal]].

  • －
    questSpencerCoalSeamUpgraded

    A sprinkle of Coal [[Coal]] in each, a good stir... done! Get mining, neighbour, and watch for the first dark speckles of Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]].

  • －
    questCoalSeamMineName

    Mine 4 Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] Grown by Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]]

  • －
    questSpencerCoalSeamMineDescription

    Stay on your island and mine 4 Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] as your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow it. About one block in five they grow is coal now! Lost your generators? I've got another for you.

  • －
    questIronSeamName

    Iron in the Stone

  • －
    questSpencerIronSeamDescription

    That coal was only the start, neighbour! Let's teach your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] to grow iron too. Bring me 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] to seed them with, and 16 Coal [[Coal]] to keep them warm.

  • －
    questSpencerIronSeamCompleted

    Iron and coal from your very own island! What a clever pair of generators you have, neighbour.

  • －
    questIronSeamIronBarsGatherName

    Smelt 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]

  • －
    questSpencerIronSeamIronBarsGatherDescription

    Mine Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] in Cragrock Mines, where a Pure Iron Ore [[Pure Iron Ore]] gives plenty, and smelt the Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]] into 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] with 16 more Coal [[Coal]].

  • －
    questIronSeamIronBarsHandInName

    Bring 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerIronSeamIronBarsHandInDescription

    Bring the 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerIronSeamIronBarsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] to go! Cragrock Mines has Pure Iron Ore [[Pure Iron Ore]] to spare.

  • －
    questIronSeamCoalGatherName

    Gather 16 Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questSpencerIronSeamCoalGatherDescription

    Mine the Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow until you have 16 Coal [[Coal]]. Coal [[Coal]] from the mines will do just as well!

  • －
    questIronSeamCoalHandInName

    Bring 16 Coal [[Coal]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerIronSeamCoalHandInDescription

    Bring the 16 Coal [[Coal]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerIronSeamCoalReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]] to go! Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] keep growing it, and Cragrock Mines has plenty too.

  • －
    questIronSeamUpgradeName

    Have Spencer Seed Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]

  • －
    questSpencerIronSeamUpgradeDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll seed your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with the Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]].

  • －
    questSpencerIronSeamUpgraded

    In go the Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]], a good shake... there! Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] takes its time to show, so keep mining those generators, neighbour.

  • －
    questIronSeamMineName

    Mine 4 Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] Grown by Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]]

  • －
    questSpencerIronSeamMineDescription

    Stay on your island and mine 4 Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] as your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow it. Iron is twice as rare as coal, about one block in ten, so keep at it! Lost your generators? I've got another for you.

  • －
    questGoldSeamName

    A Glint of Gold

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamDescription

    First coal, then iron... now picture your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] glinting with gold! Bring me 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] and 32 Coal [[Coal]], and I'll stir a little gold into the stone.

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamWaitingOn

    I'm dreaming of gold in your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]], neighbour, but the best gold is in the Gilded Gallery, past Elder Crag's mine door in Cragrock Mines. Prove yourself to him and he'll let you through!

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamCompleted

    Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow coal, iron and now gold! Not one island I've painted has generators as fine as these, neighbour.

  • －
    questGoldSeamGoldBarsGatherName

    Smelt 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamGoldBarsGatherDescription

    Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines, and smelt the Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] into 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] with 12 more Coal [[Coal]].

  • －
    questGoldSeamGoldBarsHandInName

    Bring 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamGoldBarsHandInDescription

    Bring the 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamGoldBarsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to go! Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines.

  • －
    questGoldSeamCoalGatherName

    Gather 32 Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamCoalGatherDescription

    Mine the Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow until you have 32 Coal [[Coal]]. Coal [[Coal]] from the mines will do just as well!

  • －
    questGoldSeamCoalHandInName

    Bring 32 Coal [[Coal]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamCoalHandInDescription

    Bring the 32 Coal [[Coal]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamCoalReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]] to go! Mine it at home or in Cragrock Mines, whichever's handier.

  • －
    questGoldSeamUpgradeName

    Have Spencer Seed Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamUpgradeDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll seed your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with the Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]].

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamUpgraded

    A pinch of gold in each... and they're glinting already! Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] is shy, so mine away and catch it when it peeks out.

  • －
    questGoldSeamMineName

    Mine 2 Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] Grown by Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]]

  • －
    questSpencerGoldSeamMineDescription

    Stay on your island and mine 2 Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] as your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow it. Gold is the rarest yet, about one block in twenty, so watch for the glint! Lost your generators? I've got another for you.

  • －
    questSmudgeCoalSeamMeeting

    Spencer's idea, is it? Rock grows coal by sitting still a few thousand years. He hasn't got that long. Seed his stone with 32 Coal [[Coal]] from my quarry instead.

  • －
    questSpencerStoneSpringWaitingOn

    I've got a plan for a spring of stone, neighbour, but you'll need to learn mining first. Help Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile in the Hub!

  • －
    questSpencerCarrotPatchWaitingOn

    I'm dreaming of a carrot patch, neighbour, but Carrot Seeds [[Carrot Seeds]] only come from Manor Farm. Help Tillie in the Hub, and she'll show you the way there!

  • －
    questSpencerFishPondWaitingOn

    I'd love a pond with fish in it, neighbour! Learn to fish with Blubberbeard at Blubberbeard's Shack in the Hub first.

  • －
    questSpencerPaintBoxDescription

    Neighbour, I've painted this island so often that my paint box is empty! I mix my own paints, so let's start with yellow and red. The pear trees and the Watermelon [[Watermelon]] at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm have just the colours I need.

  • －
    questSpencerPaintBoxCompleted

    Red and yellow, back in my paint box! Here's some Red Concrete [[Red Concrete]] and Yellow Concrete [[Yellow Concrete]] to build something bright, and Watermelon Seeds [[Watermelon Seeds]] so you can grow your own red.

  • －
    questSpencerPaintBoxPearGatherDescription

    Break the Pear Blocks [[Pear Block]] off the low branches of the pear tree at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm until you have 3. They grow back quickly!

  • －
    questSpencerPaintBoxPearHandInDescription

    Bring the 3 Pear Blocks [[Pear Block]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerPaintBoxPearHandedIn

    The perfect pear yellow! It's like sunshine in a paint pot.

  • －
    questSpencerPaintBoxPearReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Pear Blocks [[Pear Block]] to go! They grow back on the low branches of the pear tree at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm.

  • －
    questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonGatherDescription

    Harvest Watermelon [[Watermelon]] at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm until you have 32 Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]]. They'll make a lovely red!

  • －
    questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonHandInDescription

    Bring the 32 Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonHandedIn

    What a juicy red! Just right for my sunsets.

  • －
    questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]] to go! Harvest Watermelon [[Watermelon]] at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm.

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleDescription

    Neighbour, I'm painting a royal portrait, and royals wear purple and gold! Nothing beats Beetroot [[Beetroot]] juice for a deep purple, and Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] make the finest gold leaf for the frame. Both start out in Cragrock Mines.

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleWaitingOn

    I'm dreaming of a royal purple, neighbour, but Beetroot [[Beetroot]] only grows in Hearthdeep Village. Prove yourself to Elder Crag at his mine door in Cragrock Mines and he'll let you through. Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile in the Hub can show you the way there!

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleCompleted

    Purple and gold, fit for a king! Here's some Patterned Purple Glass [[Patterned Purple Glass]] for your windows, and Purple Torches [[Purple Torch]] to light them up at night.

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleBeetrootGatherDescription

    Pick 16 Beetroot [[Beetroot]] from the beetroot bed behind Sapphire's house in Hearthdeep Village, in Cragrock Mines.

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleBeetrootHandInDescription

    Bring the 16 Beetroot [[Beetroot]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleBeetrootHandedIn

    Ooh, look at that colour! My fingers are purple already.

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleBeetrootReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Beetroot [[Beetroot]] to go! Sapphire's bed in Hearthdeep Village has plenty.

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleRawGoldGatherDescription

    Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines until you have 4 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]].

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleGoldCraftDescription

    Craft your Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] into 8 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]].

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleGoldHandInDescription

    Bring the 8 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleGoldHandedIn

    Gold leaf! My frame is going to look so grand.

  • －
    questSpencerDeepPurpleGoldReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] to go! Craft them from Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]].

  • －
    questSpencerBoneWhiteDescription

    Every painting starts on a canvas, neighbour, and the best canvases are primed with bone white! The skeletons on the Scorched Flats in the Wild Infernos have the whitest Bones [[Bone]] around, and a Golem Eye [[Golem Eye]] ground up fine gives the white a pearly shine.

  • －
    questSpencerBoneWhiteWaitingOn

    I need bone white for my canvases, neighbour, and the best Bones [[Bone]] are in the Wild Infernos. Lorenzo at the Badlands in the Hub can show you the way there!

  • －
    questSpencerBoneWhiteCompleted

    A proper bone white with a pearly shine! My paint box is looking wonderful, neighbour, thanks to you. Plant these Cherry Saplings [[Cherry Sapling]] on your island, and just wait till you see the blossom!

  • －
    questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesGatherDescription

    Defeat the skeletons on the Scorched Flats, just outside the gate of Emberwatch Outpost in the Wild Infernos, until you have 20 Bones [[Bone]].

  • －
    questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesHandInDescription

    Bring the 20 Bones [[Bone]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesHandedIn

    Now that's a proper bone white, the perfect start for any painting!

  • －
    questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Bones [[Bone]] to go! The skeletons on the Scorched Flats in the Wild Infernos have plenty.

  • －
    questSpencerBoneWhiteGolemEyesGatherDescription

    Knock the Magma Golems off the skeleton's ribs at the Shooting Gallery in the Wild Infernos until you have 4 Golem Eyes [[Golem Eye]]. Flint in her booth there can show you how!

  • －
    questSpencerBoneWhiteGolemEyesHandInDescription

    Bring the 4 Golem Eyes [[Golem Eye]] back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerBoneWhiteGolemEyesHandedIn

    Look at that shine! Ground up fine, these will make my whites sparkle.

  • －
    questSpencerBoneWhiteGolemEyesReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Golem Eyes [[Golem Eye]] to go! The Magma Golems at the Shooting Gallery in the Wild Infernos drop one as they fall.

  • －
    questPaintBoxName

    Spencer's Paint Box

  • －
    questPaintBoxPearGatherName

    Break 3 Pear Blocks [[Pear Block]] off the pear tree

  • －
    questPaintBoxPearHandInName

    Bring 3 Pear Blocks [[Pear Block]] to Spencer

  • －
    questPaintBoxWatermelonGatherName

    Harvest 32 Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]]

  • －
    questPaintBoxWatermelonHandInName

    Bring 32 Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]] to Spencer

  • －
    questDeepPurpleName

    Deep Purple

  • －
    questDeepPurpleBeetrootGatherName

    Pick 16 Beetroot [[Beetroot]]

  • －
    questDeepPurpleBeetrootHandInName

    Bring 16 Beetroot [[Beetroot]] to Spencer

  • －
    questDeepPurpleRawGoldGatherName

    Mine 4 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]]

  • －
    questDeepPurpleGoldCraftName

    Craft 8 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]]

  • －
    questDeepPurpleGoldHandInName

    Bring 8 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] to Spencer

  • －
    questBoneWhiteName

    Bone White

  • －
    questBoneWhiteBonesGatherName

    Defeat skeletons for 20 Bones [[Bone]]

  • －
    questBoneWhiteBonesHandInName

    Bring 20 Bones [[Bone]] to Spencer

  • －
    questBoneWhiteGolemEyesGatherName

    Knock Magma Golems off for 4 Golem Eyes [[Golem Eye]]

  • －
    questBoneWhiteGolemEyesHandInName

    Bring 4 Golem Eyes [[Golem Eye]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerDailyName

    Island Order

  • －
    questSpencerDailyWheat

    I'm painting a harvest festival, neighbour, and I need a big golden pile of Wheat [[Wheat]] to copy! Could you bring me 32 from your island?

  • －
    questSpencerDailyWheatErrand

    Harvest the ripe Wheat [[Wheat]] on your island until you have 32. It grows back while you stay there.

  • －
    questSpencerDailyWheatCollect

    Harvest 32 Wheat [[Wheat]]

  • －
    questSpencerDailyWheatDelivery

    Bring 32 Wheat [[Wheat]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerDailyCarrots

    My orange paint's all gone, so I'm mixing my own from Carrots [[Carrot]]! Could you bring me 32 from your island?

  • －
    questSpencerDailyCarrotsErrand

    Harvest the ripe Carrots [[Carrot]] on your island until you have 32. They grow back while you stay there.

  • －
    questSpencerDailyCarrotsCollect

    Harvest 32 Carrots [[Carrot]]

  • －
    questSpencerDailyCarrotsDelivery

    Bring 32 Carrots [[Carrot]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerDailyMessyStone

    My paint pots keep tipping over in the grass, so I'm building a stone shelf for them! Could you bring me 32 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]?

  • －
    questSpencerDailyMessyStoneErrand

    Mine the Stone [[Stone]] that grows on your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] until you have 32 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]]. It keeps growing while you stay on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerDailyMessyStoneCollect

    Gather 32 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]]

  • －
    questSpencerDailyMessyStoneDelivery

    Bring 32 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerDailyMapleLogs

    My easel's gone all wobbly, neighbour! Bring me 16 Maple Logs [[Maple Log]] from your island and I'll build a sturdier one.

  • －
    questSpencerDailyMapleLogsErrand

    Chop the Maple trees on your island until you have 16 Maple Logs [[Maple Log]]. Each tree grows back from a sapling while you stay there.

  • －
    questSpencerDailyMapleLogsCollect

    Chop 16 Maple Logs [[Maple Log]]

  • －
    questSpencerDailyMapleLogsDelivery

    Bring 16 Maple Logs [[Maple Log]] to Spencer

  • －
    questSpencerDailyHandIn

    Bring today's order back to me on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerDailyReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more to go, neighbour! It all grows right here on your island.

  • －
    questSpencerDailyCompleted

    Thank you, neighbour! That's just what I needed.

  • －
    questSpencerDailyDone

    Your island's looking brighter already, neighbour! Pop back tomorrow and I'll have a new order.

  • －
    questSpeakToLorenzoName

    Speak to Lorenzo

  • －
    questSpeakToLorenzoDescription

    Lorenzo says you've mastered his challenges. Go ask him about a sparring partner for your island!

  • －
    questFindLorenzoDescription

    Find Lorenzo in the Hub and ask him about a sparring partner.

  • －
    questSparringPartnerName

    Bring Lorenzo 4 Rotten Brains

  • －
    questSparringPartnerDescription

    A duellist needs a worthy target! Bring me 4 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]], and I'll reward you with a Combat Dummy.

  • －
    questSparringPartnerDelivery

    Bring Lorenzo 4 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]

  • －
    questSparringPartnerDeliveryDescription

    Gather 4 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]] and bring them to me in the Hub to claim your Combat Dummy.

  • －
    questSparringPartnerReminder

    Still waiting on {{remaining}} Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]. Then the Combat Dummy is yours!

  • －
    questSparringPartnerCompleted

    Splendid! Take this Combat Dummy. Maverick has an eye for training grounds - meet him on your island.

  • －
    questPunchingBagName

    Sparring Partner

  • －
    questPunchingBagDescription

    Meet me on your island. I know the perfect place for that Combat Dummy!

  • －
    questPlaceCombatDummyName

    Place the Combat Dummy

  • －
    questPlaceCombatDummyDescription

    Now that is a sparring partner! Place the Combat Dummy anywhere on your island.

  • －
    maverickRescue

    Got you! Even adventurers need a lift. Through the portal—the Hub awaits!

  • －
    maverickNeedPlanks

    Whoa, not so fast! Craft 12 Maple Wood Planks [[Maple Wood Planks]] from your logs first, then bridge the gap to me.

  • －
    maverickNeedLogsForBridge

    Whoa, not so fast! Chop 3 Maple Log [[Maple Log]] from the tree and bring them to me, and I'll bridge the gap for you.

  • －
    maverickHandMeLogs

    Whoa, not so fast! Hand me those Maple Log [[Maple Log]] and I'll bridge the gap for you.

  • －
    maverickBridgeReminder

    Bring me {{remaining}} Maple Log [[Maple Log]] and I'll bridge that gap in a flash!

  • －
    maverickBridgeBuilt

    Stand back... ta-da! One bridge, built to last. The Hub portal is just across!

  • －
    miniWantsWoodHelmet

    We start at the top, and that helmet is wrong. Put on a Wood Helmet [[Wood Helmet]] and come back to me.

  • －
    miniWantsIronHelmet

    We start at the top, and that helmet is wrong. Put on an Iron Helmet [[Iron Helmet]] and come back to me.

  • －
    miniWantsWoodChestplate

    Helmet's right. The chestplate isn't. Swap it for a Wood Chestplate [[Wood Chestplate]].

  • －
    miniWantsIronChestplate

    Helmet's right. The chestplate isn't. Swap it for an Iron Chestplate [[Iron Chestplate]].

  • －
    miniWantsWoodGauntlets

    Head and chest are sorted. Your hands aren't. Wear Wood Gauntlets [[Wood Gauntlets]].

  • －
    miniWantsIronGauntlets

    Head and chest are sorted. Your hands aren't. Wear Iron Gauntlets [[Iron Gauntlets]].

  • －
    miniWantsWoodLeggings

    Good so far. The leggings are the problem. Wear Wood Leggings [[Wood Leggings]].

  • －
    miniWantsIronLeggings

    Good so far. The leggings are the problem. Wear Iron Leggings [[Iron Leggings]].

  • －
    miniWantsWoodBoots

    Everything but the boots. Wear Wood Boots [[Wood Boots]] and we're finished.

  • －
    miniWantsIronBoots

    Everything but the boots. Wear Iron Boots [[Iron Boots]] and we're finished.

  • －
    miniArmourApproved

    Every piece as I'd have it. Here's a chestplate with enough flourish to make Lorenzo jealous.

  • －
    questNightWatchName

    The Night Watch

  • －
    questNightWatchDescription

    Night patrol needs eyes that work in the dark. Take this Frost Shard [[Frost Shard]], recovered on duty, and make me a Night Vision Soup [[Night Vision Soup]].

  • －
    questNightWatchCarrotsName

    Pick 2 Carrots

  • －
    questNightWatchCarrots

    Pick 2 Carrots [[Carrot]] at Tillie's Patch, the farm in the hub. Good eyes start with good food.

  • －
    questNightWatchBowlName

    Craft a Bowl [[Bowl]]

  • －
    questNightWatchBowl

    Craft a Bowl [[Bowl]] from 3 Maple Wood Planks [[Maple Wood Planks]].

  • －
    questNightWatchCraftName

    Craft Night Vision Soup [[Night Vision Soup]]

  • －
    questNightWatchCraft

    Combine 2 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]], the Frost Shard [[Frost Shard]] and the Bowl [[Bowl]] to make the Night Vision Soup [[Night Vision Soup]]. Lost the shard? Report to me at the dungeon portal in the hub and I'll issue another.

  • －
    questNightWatchDelivery

    Bring Watch Dog 1 Night Vision Soup [[Night Vision Soup]]

  • －
    questNightWatchDeliver

    Bring the Night Vision Soup [[Night Vision Soup]] to me at the dungeon portal in the hub. If it's eaten or gone, report to me for a new Frost Shard [[Frost Shard]].

  • －
    questNightWatchReminder

    {{remaining}} more Night Vision Soup [[Night Vision Soup]] and the patrol is equipped. Do it properly.

  • －
    questNightWatchCompleted

    Patrol-ready. Wear this chestplate — it has kept three heads safe for years, and it will keep you standing longer.

  • －
    questNightWatchUnavailableHint

    Not now. Come back after dark, when the work is real. Bring 2 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] from Tillie's Patch.

  • －
    questNightWatchPreparingHint

    Give me a moment. I'm preparing the patrol.

  • －
    questNightWatchNudge

    Watch Dog is on duty at the dungeon portal. Go and see him.

  • －
    questFurRunName

    Spare Lining

  • －
    questFurRunDescription

    Tillie needs fur. My patrol coat has spare lining, and I keep the trimmings. Bring me 12 Carrots [[Carrot]] for the three of us and it's yours.

  • －
    questFurRunDelivery

    Bring Watch Dog 12 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]]

  • －
    questFurRunErrandDescription

    Pull 12 Carrots [[Carrot]] at Tillie's Patch, the farm in the hub. Bring them to me at the dungeon portal and the fur is yours.

  • －
    questFurRunReminder

    Not yet. {{remaining}} more Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]], then we trade.

  • －
    questFurRunCompleted

    Fair trade. Take the fur to Tillie, and stay warm out there.

  • －
    questAncientWoodlandName

    The Ancient Woodland

  • －
    questAncientWoodlandDescription

    Some of these maples still hold ancient wood. Look for logs that sparkle, low on the trunk. Bring me 16 Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]].

  • －
    questAncientWoodlandNotYet

    Not yet. Let the grove settle.

  • －
    questAncientWoodlandNudge

    Timbertooth has work in the grove. Go and see him.

  • －
    questAncientWoodlandErrandDescription

    Chop sparkling logs in Timbertooth Woods, behind me. Only you can see the sparkles. None near you? Try other trees.

  • －
    questAncientWoodlandReminder

    {{remaining}} more Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]]. Look low on the trunks for sparkles.

  • －
    questAncientWoodlandCompleted

    Good. Old wood, well cut. These leggings are made from it. Light on the feet.

  • －
    questAncientWoodlandDelivery

    Bring Timbertooth 16 Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]]

  • －
    questAllGearedUpName

    All Geared Up

  • －
    questAllGearedUpDescription

    Mini has strong opinions about armour. Put on a full set and let him look you over.

  • －
    questAllGearedUpInspection

    Wear 5 armour pieces that pass Mini's inspection

  • －
    questAllGearedUpErrand

    Dress for the duel! Wear a helmet, chestplate, gauntlets, leggings and boots, then show Mini.

  • －
    questAllGearedUpUnavailableHint

    A moment, my friend — Mini is still polishing his horns. Return shortly.

  • －
    questAllGearedUpNudge

    Lorenzo says Mini is ready to inspect your armour, over at The Badlands.

  • －
    questHardenedEvidenceName

    A Hardened Hunch

  • －
    questHardenedEvidenceDescription

    I've had troubling reports from the far end of The Badlands. Travellers say the Zombies there have skin like rock and fists that pound the ground hard enough to throw a person off their feet. Worse, they've made a camp. Zombies wander; they don't settle. A wise hunter learns his quarry before he draws his blade. Bring me proof, duellist!

  • －
    questHardenedEvidenceErrand

    Find the Hardened Zombies camped at the far end of The Badlands and take 3 Hardened Hearts from them. Step out of the ring when they pound the ground!

  • －
    questHardenedEvidenceCollect

    Defeat Hardened Zombies for 3 Hardened Hearts

  • －
    questHardenedEvidenceDelivery

    Bring Lorenzo 3 Hardened Hearts

  • －
    questHardenedEvidenceHandInDescription

    Bring those Hardened Hearts back to me, duellist. I must see them with my own eyes!

  • －
    questHardenedEvidenceReminder

    {{remaining}} more of those Hardened Hearts, duellist. If the travellers are right, I'd rather know sooner than later.

  • －
    questHardenedEvidenceCompleted

    Hard as rock, and still beating... The travellers were right. No ordinary Zombie grows a heart like this. Something out there is changing them, and I mean to find out what. Mini won't believe a word of it. You've done the Hub a real service, duellist.

  • －
    questHardenedResearchName

    Know Your Quarry

  • －
    questHardenedResearchDescription

    Those Hardened Hearts have kept me up all night, duellist. Skin like rock, fists like hammers... Whatever hardens those Zombies, I mean to understand it, and perhaps to borrow it. That calls for research! Bring me samples from the Hardened Zombies, and from ordinary Zombies to compare. Do this, and I'll forge you something special.

  • －
    questHardenedResearchIronFragmentCollect

    Defeat Hardened Zombies for 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]

  • －
    questHardenedResearchIronFragmentDelivery

    Bring Lorenzo 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]

  • －
    questHardenedResearchIronFragmentGather

    Defeat Hardened Zombies at the far end of The Badlands for 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]. They flake off that rock-hard skin, and no other Zombie carries them.

  • －
    questHardenedResearchIronFragmentDeliver

    Bring the 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]] back to me for study.

  • －
    questHardenedResearchIronFragmentReminder

    I still need {{remaining}} more Iron Fragment [[Iron Fragment]]. Only the Hardened Zombies drop them, duellist.

  • －
    questHardenedResearchIronFragmentCompleted

    Iron, flaked straight off their skin! But iron alone doesn't walk about. Something more is at work here.

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenBrainCollect

    Collect 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenBrainDelivery

    Bring Lorenzo 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenBrainGather

    Defeat Zombies in The Badlands for 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]. Any Zombie will do, though Hardened Zombies drop them more often.

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenBrainDeliver

    Bring the 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]] back to me. Whatever you do, don't eat them!

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenBrainReminder

    I still need {{remaining}} more Rotten Brain [[Rotten Brain]]. Any Zombie will do.

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenBrainCompleted

    Brains! Let's see what they've been thinking.

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenFleshCollect

    Collect 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenFleshDelivery

    Bring Lorenzo 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenFleshGather

    Defeat Zombies in The Badlands for 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]], hardened or not. I need plenty to compare.

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenFleshDeliver

    Bring the 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]] back to me. Hold your nose!

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenFleshReminder

    I still need {{remaining}} more Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]], duellist. Hardened or not, any Zombie will do.

  • －
    questHardenedResearchRottenFleshCompleted

    Every sample accounted for! Between these and those Hardened Hearts, I've learned the magic that hardens them, and worked it into good iron. Behold, the Hardened Sword! Land ten good strikes, and the next hits three times as hard.

  • －
    lorenzoTripleStrikeReady

    Triple strike ready!

  • －
    lorenzoSwordTripleStrike

    Triple strike!

  • －
    questCompressionObsessionName

    Compression Obsession

  • －
    questCompressionObsessionDescription

    I've a daft idea: squash stone until it squeaks. Bring me 4 Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]] and we'll see if it works.

  • －
    questCompressionFirstDescription

    Squash 9 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] into 1 Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]] on your island. Bring 4 of them back to me at Ruby's Rockpile, by the mines.

  • －
    questCompressionFirstReminder

    {{remaining}} more Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]] and we're away. The rock is losing, friend!

  • －
    questCompressionFirstDelivery

    Bring Ruby 4 Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionFirstTurnIn

    Ha, heavier than it looks! Now squash those together: 2 Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]], please.

  • －
    questCompressionSecondDescription

    Nine Compressed make one Extra Compressed at your island Workbench [[Workbench]]. Carry 2 down to me at Ruby's Rockpile, and mind your back.

  • －
    questCompressionSecondReminder

    Another {{remaining}} Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]] to go. Stubborn rock? Be more stubborn!

  • －
    questCompressionSecondDelivery

    Bring Ruby 2 Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionSecondTurnIn

    Grand! One more squeeze, then. A single Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]] is all I ask.

  • －
    questCompressionThirdDescription

    Nine Extra Compressed make one Super Compressed at your island Workbench [[Workbench]]. Just the one, brought down to me at Ruby's Rockpile, and I'll be happy.

  • －
    questCompressionThirdReminder

    Still {{remaining}} Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]] short. The stone isn't going anywhere.

  • －
    questCompressionThirdDelivery

    Bring Ruby 1 Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionCompleted

    Would you look at that! Take this fool's gold pickaxe — worth nothing, smashes stone like nothing else, and now and then it digs up a better ore than the one you hit.

  • －
    questCompressionUnavailableHint

    Give me a moment to clear my workbench, friend. Come back shortly.

  • －
    questCompressionAvailableNudge

    Ruby has a daft idea about squashing stone. Go and see her at Ruby's Rockpile, by the mines.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeName

    Flash Freeze

  • －
    questFlashFreezeDescription

    A cold snap is coming, dear, and my old bones feel it. Perhaps you can help me save my crops. Speak to Watch Dog. He may be willing to part with some of his fur, so I can stitch you something warm.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeNotYet

    Rest a while first, dear. I'll have something for you shortly.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeNudge

    Tillie has something for you, dear. Come and see her when you have a moment.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeFur

    Bring Tillie 3 Fur [[Fur]]

  • －
    questFlashFreezeFurDescription

    Watch Dog keeps spare fur, dear, and he stands guard at the dungeon portal in the hub. Ask him nicely and bring me 3.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeFurReminder

    I still need {{remaining}} more Fur [[Fur]], dear. Come and see me if you lose it; Watch Dog left me a little spare.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeFurTurnIn

    Lovely and soft, dear. Now bring me 3 Iron Bar [[Iron Bar]] and I'll stitch you a Worn Fur Chestplate.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeIron

    Bring Tillie 3 Iron Bar [[Iron Bar]]

  • －
    questFlashFreezeIronDescription

    Bring me 3 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]], dear. Mine Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] at Ruby's Rockpile with a Stone Pickaxe [[Stone Pickaxe]] or better, then smelt the Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]] with 3 Coal [[Coal]] in a Furnace [[Furnace]].

  • －
    questFlashFreezeIronReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Iron Bar [[Iron Bar]], dear, and your Worn Fur Chestplate is ready.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeIronTurnIn

    Here you are, dear: a Worn Fur Chestplate. Put it on, then harvest the frosty Wheat [[Wheat]] in my patch.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeHarvest

    Harvest 9 frosty Wheat [[Wheat]] while wearing the Worn Fur Chestplate

  • －
    questFlashFreezeHarvestDescription

    Frost is settling on the Wheat [[Wheat]] by the west fence of my patch, here in the hub. Wear the Worn Fur Chestplate and harvest 9 frosty Wheat [[Wheat]]. If you lose the chestplate, come back and I'll stitch you another.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeDelivery

    Bring Tillie 9 Wheat [[Wheat]]

  • －
    questFlashFreezeDeliverDescription

    Bring those 9 Wheat [[Wheat]] back to me at Tillie's Patch, dear, and we'll see what the frost spared.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeReminder

    Take your time, dear. I still need {{remaining}} more Wheat [[Wheat]] from that frosted patch.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeCompleted

    Thank you, dear. Saved from the frost, every one. That Worn Fur Chestplate is yours to keep. One more harvest, dear, and we'll be ready for Manor Farm.
