  • －
    farmingRabbitFeed

    Trade: 1 Carrot [[Carrot]]

  • －
    farmingCowHungry

    Feed a Cow 1 Wheat [[Wheat]] and 1 Melon Slice [[Melon Slice]] for Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]].

  • －
    farmingCowInventoryFull

    Make room in your inventory for the milk.

  • －
    farmingChefIdle

    A quiet kitchen. Best enjoy it while it lasts.

  • －
    farmingChefGreeting

    Oh, good! Another pair of hands.

  • －
    farmingChefInventoryFull

    Your bags are full! Make room and I'll hand this over.

  • －
    farmingChefIntroduction

    Tillie sent you? Thank goodness. The Gravy Court eats everything I cook, and if the plates run dry they'll wreck the inn. First things first: the pantry.

  • －
    guardianHit

    Guardian hit! Keep back!

  • －
    goofyGolemNeedsMoonstone

    Only a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]] or the blast of an explosive can loosen its diamonds.

  • －
    goofyGolemDormant

    This one's bare. Give it a moment to regrow.

  • －
    goofyGolemName

    Goofy Golem

  • －
    golemFarmerIdle

    Mind how you go round the herd. They spook easy, but there's not a mean bone in them.

  • －
    golemFarmerNotYet

    Easy now, the herd doesn't know you yet. Has Elder Crag sent you down? Go and see him at the mine door first.

  • －
    golemFarmerQuestGreeting

    There you are! How's the herd treating you?

  • －
    golemFarmerInventoryFull

    Your bags are full. Make some room and I'll hand you the gear.

  • －
    golemFarmerTraded

    Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]] and Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]], fresh off the shelf. Set an explosive down by the herd, and throw a grenade at any ore you want out of the rock. Stand well back!

  • －
    golemFarmerNeedsMoonstone

    Bring me 3 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] and I'll swap you 2 Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]] and 2 Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]]. Moonstone Ore [[Moonstone Ore]] grows in the cavern across the broken bridge. Once Grubnik's had his fee, his cannons will fire you over, and an Iron Pickaxe [[Iron Pickaxe]] digs it out.

  • －
    golemFarmerTradePrompt

    Trade 3 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] for 2 Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]] + 2 Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]], up to 10 times

  • －
    golemFarmerTradeFull

    Make room for your Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]] and Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]] before we trade.

  • －
    golemFarmerShearingOffer

    Meet my Goofy Golems! Their skin grows diamond, and they shed it like old scales. Take these Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]]: set one down by the herd, stand well back, and the blast shakes the loose diamond off without a scratch. Shear me 3 Diamonds [[Diamond]] worth and you can keep every one.

  • －
    golemFarmerShearingStepName

    Shear 3 Diamonds [[Diamond]] from the Goofy Golems

  • －
    golemFarmerShearingStep

    Shear the herd in Glimmerdeep Hollow: set a Moonstone Explosive [[Moonstone Explosive]] down beside them and stand well back, throw a Mining Grenade [[Mining Grenade]] at them, or swing a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]]. Every 9 flakes make 1 Diamond [[Diamond]]. Run out of explosives? I'll trade you 2 for every 3 Moonstone [[Moonstone]].

  • －
    golemFarmerShearingReminder

    The herd's still carrying plenty. Shear {{remaining}} more Diamond [[Diamond]] off them. Short on explosives? 3 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] buys 2.

  • －
    golemFarmerShearingReportName

    Return to Shale

  • －
    golemFarmerShearingReport

    That's 3 Diamonds [[Diamond]]! Come back to the cave door and tell me how the herd took it.

  • －
    golemFarmerShearingCompleted

    Not a scratch on them, and look, the shine's coming back already. You're a born golem shearer! Keep those Diamonds [[Diamond]], and take a couple of explosives for next season.

  • －
    questGolemShearingName

    Shearing Season

  • －
    golemFarmerPickaxeOffer

    Explosives are all very well, but a proper rancher shears by hand. A Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]] lifts the diamond off one clean flake at a time, and the herd hardly feels it. Get yourself one and I'll teach you the knack.

  • －
    golemFarmerPickaxeCraftName

    Craft a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]]

  • －
    golemFarmerPickaxeCraft

    Craft a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]]. Moonstone [[Moonstone]] grows in the cavern across the broken bridge, where Grubnik's cannons can fire you.

  • －
    golemFarmerPickaxeShearsName

    Shear the Goofy Golems 15 times with a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]]

  • －
    golemFarmerPickaxeShears

    Now for the fun part! Find the herd in Glimmerdeep Hollow and give them gentle taps with your Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]]. Every tap that knocks diamond loose counts. A golem gone all stone has nothing left to give, so move on to the next.

  • －
    golemFarmerPickaxeReminder

    Gentle taps, mind! Shear them {{remaining}} more times with your Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]] and you'll have the knack.

  • －
    golemFarmerPickaxeReportName

    Return to Shale

  • －
    golemFarmerPickaxeReport

    That's 15 clean shears! Come back to the cave door and tell me how the herd took it.

  • －
    golemFarmerPickaxeCompleted

    Fifteen shears and not one scratch. You've got a rancher's hands! Take these Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]] for the rock face, and come shear the herd whenever their shine grows back.

  • －
    questGolemPickaxeName

    Shearing by Hand

  • －
    miningForemanIdle

    Hearthdeep's still standing, more or less. Mind the rubble as you go.

  • －
    miningForemanNotYet

    Hearthdeep's in no state for visitors yet, friend. If Elder Crag sends you, that's different. Go and see him at the mine door.

  • －
    miningForemanNeighbours

    Bram, Gilda and Sapphire still need a hand, friend. Look in on them at their houses, and come back to me once all three are sorted.

  • －
    miningForemanQuestGreeting

    Good, you're back. How are my neighbours getting on?

  • －
    miningForemanInventoryFull

    Your bags are full. Make some room and I'll settle up.

  • －
    questMiningVillageAftermathName

    Hearthdeep in Ruins

  • －
    miningForemanAftermath

    That big meteor shook our cavern to bits, and half of Hearthdeep came down with it. Mending walls is my job, but three of my neighbours need help I can't give them. Will you go and see Bram, Gilda and Sapphire?

  • －
    miningForemanMeetFatherName

    Talk to Bram in his house

  • －
    miningForemanMeetFather

    Bram's house is the pink one past the golden pickaxe statue. He's in a terrible state, so go and hear him out.

  • －
    miningForemanMeetFundraiserName

    Talk to Gilda in her house

  • －
    miningForemanMeetFundraiser

    Gilda is raising gold for the rebuild from her house by the cavern wall. Go and see what she needs.

  • －
    miningForemanMeetBeetFarmerName

    Talk to Sapphire at her beetroot bed

  • －
    miningForemanMeetBeetFarmer

    Sapphire grows her beetroot out back, past her house. She's Ruby's mother, and just as tough. She's got work for a strong pair of arms.

  • －
    questMiningVillageRebuiltName

    Hearthdeep Stands

  • －
    miningForemanRebuilt

    Bram has his Pip back, Gilda's gold is in and Sapphire's stacking stone. Come and find me by the statue, would you?

  • －
    miningForemanRebuiltReportName

    Return to Dorrik

  • －
    miningForemanRebuiltReport

    Meet Dorrik by the golden pickaxe statue and tell him how the village is doing.

  • －
    miningForemanRebuiltCompleted

    Look at this place! Pip's home, the gold's in, and Sapphire's Andesite [[Andesite]] walls will stand up to the next big one. Hearthdeep owes you, friend. Take this, with all our thanks.

  • －
    miningFatherIdle

    Pip's not leaving my sight again. Well, not until supper.

  • －
    miningFatherWorried

    Have you seen my Pip? She ran off when the meteor hit, friend. Foreman Dorrik is getting help together by the statue.

  • －
    miningFatherQuestGreeting

    You're back! Any news?

  • －
    miningFatherInventoryFull

    Your bags are full, friend. Clear some space first.

  • －
    questMiningLostDaughterName

    Lost in the Rubble

  • －
    miningFatherLostDaughter

    My little Pip ran off when the meteor hit, and she hasn't come home. She'll be scared stiff, hiding somewhere in the village. Please, will you find her?

  • －
    miningFatherFindDaughterName

    Find Pip in the village

  • －
    miningFatherFindDaughter

    Search Hearthdeep for Pip. She loves to climb, so look up high.

  • －
    miningFatherReturnName

    Return to Bram

  • －
    miningFatherReturn

    Pip has run home. Go back to Bram's house and make sure she got there.

  • －
    miningFatherReunited

    Pip! Oh, thank goodness. She ran straight in and hasn't let go of my beard since. You've given me my whole world back. It's not much, but please take this.

  • －
    miningDaughterHiding

    Shh! I'm hiding. Another meteor might hit!

  • －
    miningDaughterHome

    I'm staying right next to Dad from now on.

  • －
    miningDaughterQuestGreeting

    Who are you? Did Dad send you?

  • －
    miningDaughterInventoryFull

    Your pockets are stuffed! Make some room.

  • －
    miningDaughterFound

    Dad sent you? He's not cross? I'm running home right now!

  • －
    miningFundraiserIdle

    Not now, I've a ruined village to count up. Foreman Dorrik by the statue will tell you what happened.

  • －
    miningFundraiserQuestGreeting

    Back again? Hearthdeep thanks you!

  • －
    miningFundraiserInventoryFull

    Your bags are full. Make some room first.

  • －
    questMiningGoldDriveName

    Gold for Hearthdeep

  • －
    miningFundraiserGoldDrive

    The meteor cost us nearly everything, and gold buys timber, tools and food. I'm collecting 100 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] for the rebuild. For every bar you give, I'll bless you with a minute of Miner's Goodwill, and stone will break faster for you.

  • －
    miningFundraiserDonateName

    Give Gilda 100 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • －
    miningFundraiserDonate

    Bring Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to Gilda and talk to her to give them. Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery and smelt its Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] in a Furnace [[Furnace]], with a Coal [[Coal]] for each bar.

  • －
    miningFundraiserDonateReminder

    {{remaining}} more Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] and Hearthdeep can rebuild. Every one counts!

  • －
    miningFundraiserThanks

    {{amount}} Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] for the rebuild! That's {{total}} from you so far. May your pickaxe swing true.

  • －
    miningFundraiserNeedsGold

    Bring me Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] for the rebuild. Each one earns you a minute of Miner's Goodwill.

  • －
    miningFundraiserGoldSpokenFor

    Hold on, you might need those Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] for the job you're on. Bring me whatever's left once it's done.

  • －
    miningFundraiserGoldDriveCompleted

    That's the 100 we needed! With this much gold we can buy timber, tools and food enough for everyone. You've a heart of gold yourself. I'll still take any bars you can spare, mind.

  • －
    miningGoodwillEffect

    Miner's Goodwill

  • －
    elderCragMarkEffect

    Elder Crag's Mark

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerIdle

    The beets came through the big one just fine. Tougher than they look, like us.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerQuestGreeting

    Back to help? Good.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerInventoryFull

    Your bags are full. Make room, then come back.

  • －
    questMiningBeetrootName

    Food and Stone

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerBeetroot

    Half my stores went under the rubble, and folk need feeding. Pick 10 Beetroot [[Beetroot]] from my bed out back.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerGatherName

    Pick 10 Beetroot [[Beetroot]]

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerGather

    Pick 10 Beetroot [[Beetroot]] from the beetroot bed behind Sapphire's house.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerDeliverName

    Give Sapphire 10 Beetroot [[Beetroot]]

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerDeliver

    Take the 10 Beetroot [[Beetroot]] to Sapphire.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerBeetrootReminder

    {{remaining}} more Beetroot [[Beetroot]]. The bed's right outside.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerBeetrootTurnIn

    Good, firm roots. The next job is heavy work, so eat 3 Beetroot [[Beetroot]] first. Tired arms build crooked walls.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerEatName

    Eat 3 Beetroot [[Beetroot]]

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerEat

    Pick more Beetroot [[Beetroot]] from Sapphire's bed and eat 3 of them.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerEatReminder

    Eat {{remaining}} more Beetroot [[Beetroot]] first. You can't swing a pickaxe on an empty belly.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerAndesiteName

    Mine 100 Andesite [[Andesite]]

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerAndesite

    Mine 100 Andesite [[Andesite]] from the cavern's north wall. Sapphire will rebuild the houses with it, stronger than before.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerAndesiteDeliverName

    Give Sapphire 100 Andesite [[Andesite]]

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerAndesiteDeliver

    Take the 100 Andesite [[Andesite]] to Sapphire.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerAndesiteReminder

    {{remaining}} more Andesite [[Andesite]] and we can start building. The cavern's north wall is full of it.

  • －
    miningBeetFarmerCompleted

    Andesite [[Andesite]] walls, thick as a dwarf's skull! When the next big one hits, these houses won't budge. I taught Ruby her swing, and I can see she's taught you yours. You've earned this.

  • －
    landmarkMiningVillage

    Hearthdeep Village

    Halt. Passage requires Tillie's approval and a paid toll. Speak to me beside the portal.

    Halt. Passage requires Tillie's approval.

  • －
    portalGuardianIdle

    I report to Watch Dog. Passage rules apply equally to everyone.

  • －
    portalGuardianGreeting

    State your business.

  • －
    portalGuardianInventoryFull

    Make room in your inventory before proceeding.

    Pay the toll to the Manor Farm Portal Guardian

  • －

    Speak to Portal Guardian beside the grey portal at Tillie's Patch to pay {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] from your purse. Withdraw banked [[Gold Coin]] from Bling Bling, or sell spare resources at the hub's Market to earn more.

  • －
    questPortalTollReminder

    The toll is {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]]. Your purse needs {{remaining}} more [[Gold Coin]]. Withdraw any you have banked from Bling Bling, or sell spare resources at the Market, then return.

  • －
    questPortalTollPaid

    Payment recorded. Go through the yellow portal to Manor Farm.

  • －

  • －
    miningPortalGuardianFreeBlocked

    Make room in your inventory before proceeding.

    Speak to Portal Guardian beside the grey portal at the back of Ruby's Rockpile to pay {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] from your purse. Withdraw banked [[Gold Coin]] from Bling Bling, or sell spare resources at the hub's Market to earn more.

  • －
    questMiningPortalTollReminder

    The toll is {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]]. Your purse needs {{remaining}} more [[Gold Coin]]. Withdraw any you have banked from Bling Bling, or sell spare resources at the Market, then return.

  • －

    Speak to the Portal Guardian beside the grey portal at the far end of The Badlands to pay {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] from your purse. Withdraw banked [[Gold Coin]] from Bling Bling, or sell spare resources at the hub's Market to earn more.

    The toll is {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]]. Your purse needs {{remaining}} more [[Gold Coin]]. Withdraw any you have banked from Bling Bling, or sell spare resources at the Market, then return.

    Halt. Passage requires Blubberbeard's approval and a paid toll. Speak to me beside the portal.

    I report to Watch Dog. Passage rules apply equally to everyone.

  • －

    Speak to the Portal Guardian beside the grey portal at the west end of Blubberbeard's path to pay {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] from your purse. Withdraw banked [[Gold Coin]] from Bling Bling, or sell spare resources at the hub's Market to earn more.

  • －
    questFishingPortalTollReminder

    The toll is {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]]. Your purse needs {{remaining}} more [[Gold Coin]]. Withdraw any you have banked from Bling Bling, or sell spare resources at the Market, then return.

  • －
    questFishingPortalTollPaid

    Payment recorded. Go through the blue portal to the Lantern Reach.

  • －
    farmingBaronIdle

    The table is ready. Why is my next course not? Such fine plates. It would be a shame if they broke.

  • －
    farmingTraderIdle

    Fresh milk for fresh truffles. A fair bargain.

  • －
    farmingTraderTrade

    Four Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] for one Truffle [[Truffle]]. Bling Bling's family; that greedy Gravy Court isn't.

  • －
    farmingTraderMissingMilk

    Bring 4 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] for 1 Truffle [[Truffle]].

  • －
    farmingTraderFeedCow

    No milk? Feed a cow 1 Wheat [[Wheat]] and 1 Melon Slice [[Melon Slice]] and it pays you a Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]]. That's a fairer bargain than the Gravy Court offers.

  • －
    farmingTraderInventoryFull

    Make room for your Truffle [[Truffle]] before we trade.

  • －
    farmingTraderQuestTrade

    One Truffle [[Truffle]], as promised. Take it to Clatter before the Gravy Court starts grumbling.

  • －
    questFinalHarvestName

    One Final Harvest

  • －
    questFinalHarvestDescription

    One final harvest from this patch before we head to Manor Farm, dear. Bring me a full stack of Wheat [[Wheat]] and a full stack of Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]]: 999 of each.

  • －
    questFinalHarvestWheatCollect

    Collect 999 Wheat [[Wheat]]

  • －
    questFinalHarvestWheatDelivery

    Bring Tillie 999 Wheat [[Wheat]]

  • －
    questFinalHarvestWheatGather

    Harvest 999 Wheat [[Wheat]] at Tillie's Patch in the hub.

  • －
    questFinalHarvestWheatDeliver

    Bring 999 Wheat [[Wheat]] to Tillie beside her patch in the hub.

  • －
    questFinalHarvestWheatReminder

    I still need {{remaining}} Wheat [[Wheat]], dear.

  • －
    questFinalHarvestWheatCompleted

    Lovely Wheat [[Wheat]], dear. That will keep the store well stocked.

  • －
    questFinalHarvestPotatoesCollect

    Collect 999 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]]

  • －
    questFinalHarvestPotatoesDelivery

    Bring Tillie 999 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]]

  • －
    questFinalHarvestPotatoesGather

    Harvest 999 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] at Tillie's Patch in the hub.

  • －
    questFinalHarvestPotatoesDeliver

    Bring 999 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] to Tillie beside her patch in the hub.

  • －
    questFinalHarvestPotatoesReminder

    I still need {{remaining}} Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]], dear.

  • －
    questFinalHarvestPotatoesCompleted

    A fine crop, dear. Here's some gold towards the journey. Manor Farm's portal has a toll, so come and talk to me about it.

  • －
    questFinalHarvestPotatoesFreeCompleted

    A fine crop, dear. Here's some gold for the journey. The Portal Guardian will let you through to Manor Farm.

  • －
    questFarmingTableName

    A Table in Trouble

  • －
    questFarmingTableDescription

    Manor Farm has a {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] portal toll, dear. Visit Up Dog at the hub's Market first; he can help you sell your spare harvest.

  • －
    questFarmingTableMarket

    Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub

  • －
    questFarmingTableMarketDescription

    Visit Up Dog at the hub's Market. He'll show you how to sell spare resources for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.

  • －
    questFarmingTableLearnedDescription

    Manor Farm has a {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] portal toll, dear. I can smell Up Dog on your coat, so you already know your way round the Market. Sell what you can spare there and pay the Portal Guardian.

  • －
    questFarmingTableFreeDescription

    You've earned your way to Manor Farm, dear. The Portal Guardian will let you through the yellow portal beside my patch.

  • －
    questFarmingTableMarketLearned

    There's a whiff of Up Dog on your coat, dear, so you know the Market already. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].

  • －
    questFarmingTableMarketIntroduction

    Welcome to the Market! Use Instant Sell to turn spare resources into [[Gold Coin]], or trade with other players. Talk to me again to open the Market and earn your {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] toll.

  • －
    questFarmingTablePortal

    Use the yellow portal to Manor Farm

  • －
    questFarmingTablePortalDescription

    Go through the yellow portal beside Tillie's Patch, dear. It leads to Manor Farm.

  • －
    questFarmingTableChef

    Speak to Clatter at Hog's Gut Inn

  • －
    questFarmingTableChefDescription

    Find Clatter in the kitchen of Hog's Gut Inn in Manor Farm, dear. Tell him Tillie sent you.

  • －
    questFarmingPigsMilk

    Collect 4 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]]

  • －
    questFarmingPigsMilkDescription

    Feed the Cows in Snoutmeadow 1 Wheat [[Wheat]] and 1 Melon Slice [[Melon Slice]] for each Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]]. Collect 4. Wheat [[Wheat]] grows in the hub's fields.

  • －
    questFarmingPigsTrade

    Trade 4 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] for 1 Truffle [[Truffle]]

  • －
    questFarmingPigsTradeDescription

    Take 4 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] to Truff in Snoutmeadow. Interact to exchange the milk for 1 Truffle [[Truffle]], then bring it to me.

  • －
    questFarmingPantryName

    Stock the Pantry

  • －
    questFarmingPantryDescription

    The Gravy Court ate my pantry bare! Fill it before they get restless: 100 Watermelon Slice [[Watermelon Slice]], 100 Carrot [[Carrot]], 50 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] and 100 Melon Slice [[Melon Slice]].

  • －
    questFarmingPantryWatermelonCollect

    Collect 100 Watermelon Slice [[Watermelon Slice]]

  • －
    questFarmingPantryWatermelonDelivery

    Bring Clatter 100 Watermelon Slice [[Watermelon Slice]]

  • －
    questFarmingPantryWatermelonGather

    Harvest ripe Watermelon [[Watermelon]] at Stagstep Gardens until you have 100 Watermelon Slice [[Watermelon Slice]].

  • －
    questFarmingPantryWatermelonDeliver

    Bring 100 Watermelon Slice [[Watermelon Slice]] to Clatter in the kitchen at Hog's Gut Inn.

  • －
    questFarmingPantryWatermelonReminder

    I still need {{remaining}} more Watermelon Slice [[Watermelon Slice]]. Bring them to me at Hog's Gut Inn.

    There you are, adventurer! Come and talk to me.

  • －
    miniQuestGreeting

    You again. Come on, then. Let's talk.

  • －
    watchDogHallOverview

    You're in the dungeon hall. Choose your boss at a dungeon's statue, clear its creatures, and defeat the boss. Stay alert—we keep this danger from reaching the Hub.

  • －
    watchDogQuestGreeting

    Resident. If you have business with me, step up and report.

  • －
    questNightWatchPotatoesName

    Dig up 2 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]]

  • －
    questNightWatchPotatoes

    Dig up 2 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] at Tillie's Patch, the farm in the hub. Good eyes start with good food.

  • －
    questFurRunHandInDescription

    Bring the 12 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] to Watch Dog at the dungeon portal, and his spare fur is yours in trade.

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceName

    Cleared for Duty

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceDescription

    Halt, resident. These dungeons are no place for the untested, and nobody fights in them without my clearance.

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceDescriptionArmed

    Halt, resident. These dungeons are no place to wander in unarmed, and nobody should fight in them without my clearance.

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceReportName

    Report to Watch Dog

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceReport

    Report to me between the hall's first two boss statues.

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceBriefing

    Each statue in this hall seals a dungeon, with a boss waiting at its heart. Skullforge's is the Forge Warden, a stone golem that would flatten a new recruit. Once you can hold your own against the Zombies in the Hub's Badlands, I'll clear you to face it.

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceBriefingArmed

    Each statue in this hall seals a dungeon, with a boss waiting at its heart. Skullforge's is the Forge Warden, a stone golem that flattens careless recruits. You're cleared to face it, but not empty-handed. Take my old patrol club. It hits harder than it looks.

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceTrainName

    Train to Combat Level 3

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceTrain

    Fight the Zombies in the Hub's Badlands until you can hold your own. Skullforge's statue opens to you once you can.

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceBossName

    Defeat the Forge Warden in Skullforge

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceBoss

    You're cleared. Use Skullforge's statue in the dungeon hall, fight through to its heart and bring down the Forge Warden.

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceBossArmed

    You're cleared. Take my club to Skullforge's statue in the dungeon hall, fight through to its heart and bring down the Forge Warden. Lost the club? I keep a spare.

  • －
    questDungeonClearanceClubAgain

    Nobody goes into those dungeons empty-handed. Here, take my spare club.

    Bring today's wood back to me. I'll check the cuts.

  • －
    questForagingDailyReminder

  • －

    That's today's work done. Come back tomorrow.

  • －
    questForagingDailyLogPileDelivery

    questCombatSecondHandInDescription

    Bring your trophies back to me, and claim the finer blade you've earned!

    questCombatSecondCollect

  • －
    questCombatDailyName

    Daily Hunt

  • －
    questCombatDailyErrand

    Face the Zombies roaming the Badlands and bring me your spoils, duellist!

  • －
    questCombatDailyHandIn

    Return and present today's spoils to me, duellist!

  • －
    questCombatDailyReminder

    Today's hunt needs {{remaining}} more. Chin up, duellist!

  • －
    questCombatDailyCompleted

    Splendid work, duellist! Here's your purse for today's hunt.

  • －
    questCombatDailyDone

    Today's hunt is done, brave duellist! Return tomorrow for another.

  • －
    questCombatDailyHunt

    A new day, a new hunt! Bring me 6 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]] from the Badlands Zombies.

    Collect 6 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]

  • －
    questCombatDailyHuntDelivery

    Bring Lorenzo 6 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]

  • －
    questCombatDailyGrandHunt

    A grand hunt today, duellist! Bring me 10 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]] from the Badlands Zombies.

  • －
    questCombatDailyGrandHuntCollect

    Collect 10 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]

  • －
    questCombatDailyGrandHuntDelivery

    Bring Lorenzo 10 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]

  • －
    questCombatDoubleStrikeCompleted

    Bravo! Thank you for thinning their ranks. Take my Duelling Sword. Land ten good strikes, then the next hits twice as hard!

  • －
    lorenzoDoubleStrikeReady

    Double strike ready!

  • －
    lorenzoSwordDoubleStrike

    Double strike!

    Haul that Coal [[Coal]] back to me, friend. Let's see what the rock gave up!

  • －
    questMiningSecondHandInDescription

    Bring the whole haul back to me, and that better pickaxe is yours!

    Mine 20 more Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questMiningDailyHandIn

    Haul today's ore back to me, friend!

  • －
    questMiningDailyReminder

    Another {{remaining}} and today's haul is done, friend. Don't let the rocks win!

  • －
    questMiningDailyCompleted

    Lovely haul, thank you! Here's your share for today.

  • －
    questMiningDailyDone

    That's today's haul in, friend! The rocks will keep till tomorrow.

    Morning, friend! The forge is hungry. Bring me 10 Coal [[Coal]].

  • －
    questMiningDailyCoalCollect

    Mine 10 Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questMiningDailyCoalDelivery

    Bring Ruby 10 Coal [[Coal]]

    questMiningDailyIron

    I've a hankering for iron today. Bring me 4 Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]] from the Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] here, friend!

  • －
    questMiningDailyIronCollect

    Mine 4 Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]] from Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]]

  • －
    questMiningDailyIronDelivery

    Bring Ruby 4 Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]]

  • －
    questMiningDailyOre

    Bring me 8 Coal [[Coal]] or Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]] today, friend. Any mix you like!

  • －
    questMiningDailyOreCollect

    Mine 8 Coal [[Coal]] or Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]]

  • －
    questMiningDailyOreDelivery

    Bring Ruby 8 Coal [[Coal]] or Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]]

  • －
    questCompressionCompressedName

    Squeezing Rocks

  • －
    questCompressionCompressedDescription

    I've a daft idea: squash stone until it squeaks. Bring me 1 Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]] and we'll see if it works.

  • －
    questCompressionCompressedGatherName

    Collect 9 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionCompressedGather

    Mine Stone [[Stone]] at Ruby's Rockpile until you have 9 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]].

  • －
    questCompressionCompressedCraftName

    Craft 1 Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionCompressedCraft

    Squash 9 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] into 1 Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]]. You can do it right from your inventory!

  • －
    questCompressionCompressedDeliver

    Bring your Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]] to Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile.

  • －
    questCompressionCompressedReminder

    {{remaining}} Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]] and we're away. The rock is losing, friend!

  • －
    questCompressionCompressedDelivery

    Bring Ruby 1 Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionCompressedCompleted

    Ha, heavier than it looks! It works, friend. Take these Iron Bar [[Iron Bar]]. Now, don't run off: I've had worrying news from home.

  • －
    questCompressionExtraName

    Double The Squeeze

  • －
    questCompressionExtraDescription

    When the mine can spare you, let's squeeze harder: bring me 1 Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]].

  • －
    questCompressionExtraGatherName

    Collect 81 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionExtraGather

    Mine Stone [[Stone]] at Ruby's Rockpile until you have 81 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]. Squashed stone counts too, so squash as you go!

  • －
    questCompressionExtraCraftName

    Craft 1 Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionExtraCraft

    Squash 9 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] into each Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]], then squash 9 of those into 1 Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]]. You can do it right from your inventory!

  • －
    questCompressionExtraDeliver

    Bring your Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]] to Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile.

  • －
    questCompressionExtraReminder

    Still {{remaining}} Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]] to go. Stubborn rock? Be more stubborn!

  • －
    questCompressionExtraDelivery

    Bring Ruby 1 Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionExtraCompleted

    Grand! That's a whole heap of stone in one little block. Have these Iron Bar [[Iron Bar]]. I've something shiny in mind for the next squeeze.

  • －
    questCompressionSuperName

    Compression Obsession

  • －
    questCompressionSuperDescription

    Let's squeeze harder still. Bring me 1 Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]]. That's 729 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] squashed small, a proper dig this time, but there's a special pickaxe in it for you. Show that rock who's stubborn!

  • －
    questCompressionSuperGatherName

    Collect 729 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionSuperGather

    Mine Stone [[Stone]] at Ruby's Rockpile until you have 729 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]. Squashed stone counts too, so squash as you go!

  • －
    questCompressionSuperCraftName

    Craft 1 Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionSuperCraft

    Squash 9 Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]] into 1 Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]].

  • －
    questCompressionSuperDeliver

    Bring your Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]] to Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile.

  • －
    questCompressionSuperReminder

    Still {{remaining}} Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]] short. The stone isn't going anywhere.

  • －
    questCompressionSuperDelivery

    Bring Ruby 1 Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionSuperCompleted

    Would you look at that! Thanks, friend. Take this Fool's Gold Pickaxe: the gold's fake, but it smashes stone quick, and now and then an ore coughs up a bonus. Squeeze harder next time and I've a pickaxe that chases whole veins.

  • －
    questCompressionHyperName

    Under Pressure

  • －
    questCompressionHyperDescription

    Now we're getting serious. Bring me 1 Hyper Compressed Messy Stone [[Hyper Compressed Messy Stone]]. That's a mountain of stone, so keep that Fool's Gold Pickaxe swinging!

  • －
    questCompressionHyperGatherName

    Collect 6,561 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionHyperGather

    Mine Stone [[Stone]] at Ruby's Rockpile until you have 6,561 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]. Squashed stone counts too, so squash as you go!

  • －
    questCompressionHyperCraftName

    Craft 1 Hyper Compressed Messy Stone [[Hyper Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionHyperCraft

    Squash 9 Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]] into 1 Hyper Compressed Messy Stone [[Hyper Compressed Messy Stone]].

  • －
    questCompressionHyperDeliver

    Bring your Hyper Compressed Messy Stone [[Hyper Compressed Messy Stone]] to Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile.

  • －
    questCompressionHyperReminder

    {{remaining}} Hyper Compressed Messy Stone [[Hyper Compressed Messy Stone]] still to bring me. Keep at it, friend. That rock is starting to sweat!

  • －
    questCompressionHyperDelivery

    Bring Ruby 1 Hyper Compressed Messy Stone [[Hyper Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionHyperCompleted

    Ha! Heavy as a hill and twice as stubborn, and you beat it anyway. Take this Vein Chaser Pickaxe, friend. Break one stone here in the hub and the stone touching it comes tumbling out too, and so do matching ores!

  • －
    questCompressionUltraName

    Ultra Crush

  • －
    questCompressionUltraDescription

    You've got arms like a dwarf now! Bring me 1 Ultra Compressed Messy Stone [[Ultra Compressed Messy Stone]]. It's a huge pile of stone, so let that Vein Chaser Pickaxe tear through it. I know you can do it.

  • －
    questCompressionUltraGatherName

    Collect 59,049 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionUltraGather

    Mine Stone [[Stone]] at Ruby's Rockpile until you have 59,049 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]. Squashed stone counts too, so squash as you go!

  • －
    questCompressionUltraCraftName

    Craft 1 Ultra Compressed Messy Stone [[Ultra Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionUltraCraft

    Squash 9 Hyper Compressed Messy Stone [[Hyper Compressed Messy Stone]] into 1 Ultra Compressed Messy Stone [[Ultra Compressed Messy Stone]].

  • －
    questCompressionUltraDeliver

    Bring your Ultra Compressed Messy Stone [[Ultra Compressed Messy Stone]] to Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile.

  • －
    questCompressionUltraReminder

    Still {{remaining}} Ultra Compressed Messy Stone [[Ultra Compressed Messy Stone]] to bring me. Carry it carefully, friend. It's heavier than a hill!

  • －
    questCompressionUltraDelivery

    Bring Ruby 1 Ultra Compressed Messy Stone [[Ultra Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionUltraCompleted

    Well, I never! I've mined for years and never held one of these. Take this Compactor Pickaxe, friend. Stone [[Stone]] you dig here in the hub comes out already squashed, and now and then twice over!

  • －
    questCompressionMegaName

    Mega Squash

  • －
    questCompressionMegaDescription

    Right, the big one: 1 Mega Compressed Messy Stone [[Mega Compressed Messy Stone]]. Only the most stubborn miner could make it. Lucky for me, that's you! Keep that Compactor Pickaxe swinging.

  • －
    questCompressionMegaGatherName

    Collect 531,441 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionMegaGather

    Mine Stone [[Stone]] at Ruby's Rockpile until you have 531,441 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]]. Squashed stone counts too, so squash as you go!

  • －
    questCompressionMegaCraftName

    Craft 1 Mega Compressed Messy Stone [[Mega Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionMegaCraft

    Squash 9 Ultra Compressed Messy Stone [[Ultra Compressed Messy Stone]] into 1 Mega Compressed Messy Stone [[Mega Compressed Messy Stone]].

  • －
    questCompressionMegaDeliver

    Bring your Mega Compressed Messy Stone [[Mega Compressed Messy Stone]] to Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile.

  • －
    questCompressionMegaReminder

    {{remaining}} Mega Compressed Messy Stone [[Mega Compressed Messy Stone]] and you've done it. Don't let the rock win now!

  • －
    questCompressionMegaDelivery

    Bring Ruby 1 Mega Compressed Messy Stone [[Mega Compressed Messy Stone]]

  • －
    questCompressionMegaCompleted

    You did it! I've never held stone squashed this tight, and you made it. Stubborn rock? You were more stubborn! You've earned my own prized pickaxe, friend. It breaks whole chunks of stone and ore at once, and some of that stone comes out squashed. Look after it for me!

  • －
    questFarmingFirstHandInDescription

    Bring the Wheat [[Wheat]] back to me when you're ready, dear. There's no rush.

    Bring the Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] to me, dear. Your field hoe is waiting.

    Harvest 24 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]]

  • －

    Thank you, dear. A lovely harvest. Here's a little something for your help.

  • －

    That's today's harvest in, dear. Come and see me again tomorrow.

  • －
    questGroundworkName

    Groundwork

  • －
    questGroundworkDescription

    I'd like to mend the edges of my patch, dear. Take this Stone Spade [[Stone Spade]] and gather 10 Grass Block [[Grass Block]] from the ground around my crops.

  • －
    questGroundworkGrassCollect

    Gather 10 Grass Block [[Grass Block]]

  • －
    questGroundworkGrassDescription

    Dig up 10 Grass Block [[Grass Block]] around Tillie's Patch here in the hub, dear. The bare soil they leave will grow back into grass in a few moments.

  • －
    questGroundworkGrassDelivery

    Bring Tillie 10 Grass Block [[Grass Block]]

  • －
    questGroundworkGrassHandIn

    Bring your 10 Grass Block [[Grass Block]] back to me at Tillie's Patch, dear.

  • －
    questGroundworkGrassReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Grass Block [[Grass Block]] from around my patch, dear.

  • －
    questGroundworkGrassTurnIn

    Those will make a lovely green edge. Now gather 20 Dirt [[Dirt]] from the bare ground beside me, dear, so I can fill the low spots.

  • －
    questGroundworkDirtCollect

    Gather 20 Dirt [[Dirt]]

  • －
    questGroundworkDirtDescription

    Dig up 20 Dirt [[Dirt]] from the bare ground beside me at Tillie's Patch in the hub. Leave the rough ground to settle, dear; fresh Dirt [[Dirt]] will return in a few moments.

  • －
    questGroundworkDirtDelivery

    Bring Tillie 20 Dirt [[Dirt]]

  • －
    questGroundworkDirtHandIn

    Bring your 20 Dirt [[Dirt]] back to me at Tillie's Patch, dear.

  • －
    questGroundworkDirtReminder

    I still need {{remaining}} more Dirt [[Dirt]] from the bare ground beside me, dear.

  • －
    questGroundworkCompleted

    Thank you, dear. That will give my patch a little room to grow. Keep the spade for your own garden.

  • －
    miningGoblinGreeting

    Oi, pal! Come to gawp at my beauties? Gawping's free. Riding ain't.

  • －
    miningGoblinIdle

    A deal's a deal, pal. My beauties are yours to ride, as often as you like.

  • －
    miningGoblinNotYet

    Oi, pal! Old Crag says who works in his mine, and he hasn't said you. Get his say-so at the mine door, then come and talk business.

  • －
    miningGoblinInventoryFull

    Your pockets are stuffed, pal! Make some room before I pay you.

  • －
    questMiningCannonsName

    Over the Gap

  • －
    questMiningCannonsDescription

    When that meteor hit, this bridge dropped right into the lava, pal. Now all that lovely Moonstone Ore [[Moonstone Ore]] is stuck on the far side. Lucky for you, I've set up two cannons, one on each side of the gap! My beauties need powder, though. Fetch me 20 Coal [[Coal]].

  • －
    questMiningCannonsCoalCollect

    Gather 20 Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questMiningCannonsCoal

    Mine 20 Coal [[Coal]] for me at Ruby's Rockpile in the hub, or by the entrance to this mine, pal.

  • －
    questMiningCannonsCoalDelivery

    Bring Grubnik 20 Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questMiningCannonsCoalHandIn

    Bring your 20 Coal [[Coal]] to me by the broken bridge, pal.

  • －
    questMiningCannonsCoalReminder

    {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]], pal. No powder, no boom!

  • －
    questMiningCannonsCoalTurnIn

    That's my powder sorted! Now for my fee. Cannons don't fire for free, pal, and I only take gold. Go and mine me 50 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] in the Gilded Gallery.

  • －
    questMiningCannonsGoldName

    Mine 50 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]]

  • －
    questMiningCannonsGold

    Break Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery, high up in this mine, until you've got 50 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]], pal. Any Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] you already have count too.

  • －
    questMiningCannonsGoldReminder

    {{remaining}} more Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]], pal. I can almost smell it!

  • －
    questMiningCannonsSmeltName

    Smelt 50 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • －
    questMiningCannonsSmelt

    Smelt your Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] into 50 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] with 50 Coal [[Coal]] in a Furnace [[Furnace]]. There are a few about this mine. I only take my gold shiny, pal!

  • －
    questMiningCannonsBarsDelivery

    Bring Grubnik 50 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • －
    questMiningCannonsBarsHandIn

    Bring the 50 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to me by the broken bridge, pal. No spending them on the way!

  • －
    questMiningCannonsBarsReminder

    {{remaining}} more Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]], pal. A deal's a deal!

  • －
    questMiningCannonsCompleted

    Ooh, look at them gleam! Paid in full, pal, and a deal's a deal. My beauties are yours. Climb into either cannon and it'll fling you clean over the lava, there and back, as often as you like.

  • －
    miningCannonName

    Grubnik's Cannon

  • －
    miningCannonPrompt

    Climb in

  • －
    miningCannonLocked

    Pay Grubnik his fee to ride his cannons.

  • －
    miningCannonNotYet

    Talk to Elder Crag at the mine door, then ask Grubnik about his cannons.

  • －
    questFlashFreezePotatoes

    Dig up 12 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]]

  • －
    questFlashFreezePotatoesDescription

    Dig up 12 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] in my patch, dear, and take them to Watch Dog at the dungeon portal. He'll trade his spare Fur [[Fur]] for them.

  • －
    questFlashFreezePotatoesReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]], dear, then take them to Watch Dog.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeFurHandInDescription

    Bring the Fur [[Fur]] back to me, dear, and I'll start stitching. If you lose it, come and see me; Watch Dog left me a little spare.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeIronCollect

    Smelt 3 Iron Bar [[Iron Bar]]

  • －
    questFlashFreezeIronHandInDescription

    Bring me the Iron Bar [[Iron Bar]], dear, and I'll finish your chestplate.

  • －
    questFlashFreezeWearCoat

    Put the Worn Fur Chestplate on first, dear. Frosty Wheat [[Wheat]] only counts while you wear it.

  • －
    questFishingFirstHandInDescription

    Bring your catch back to me, matey.

  • －
    questFishingFirstCollect

    Catch 4 fish

  • －
    questFishingSecondHandInDescription

    Bring your catch to me, matey, and the sturdier rod is yours.

  • －
    questFishingSecondCollect

    Catch 8 more fish

    Daily Catch

  • －

    Cast into the water by my shack, then bring the catch back to me.

  • －
    questFishingDailyHandIn

    Bring today's catch back to me, matey.

  • －
    questFishingDailyReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more for today's catch, matey.

  • －
    questFishingDailyCompleted

    That's a fine catch, matey. Here's a little something for your trouble.

  • －
    questFishingDailyDone

    That's today's catch landed, matey. The fish'll be biting again tomorrow.

  • －
    questFishingDailyAny

    Back for more, matey? Bring me 4 fish today. Any kind will do.

  • －
    questFishingDailyAnyCollect

    Catch 4 fish

  • －
    questFishingDailyAnyDelivery

    Bring Blubberbeard 4 fish

  • －
    questFishingDailyWheatfish

    I've a craving for Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]] today, matey. Catch me one?

  • －
    questFishingDailyWheatfishCollect

    Catch a Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]]

  • －
    questFishingDailyWheatfishDelivery

    Bring Blubberbeard a Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]]

  • －
    questFishingDailyDarter

    Today I'm after a Darter [[Darter]], matey. Quick little thing. Catch me one?

  • －
    questFishingDailyDarterCollect

    Catch a Darter [[Darter]]

  • －
    questFishingDailyDarterDelivery

    Bring Blubberbeard a Darter [[Darter]]

  • －
    questFishingDailySunsetMinnow

    I fancy a Sunset Minnow [[Sunset Minnow]] for supper. Catch me one, matey?

  • －
    questFishingDailySunsetMinnowCollect

    Catch a Sunset Minnow [[Sunset Minnow]]

  • －
    questFishingDailySunsetMinnowDelivery

    Bring Blubberbeard a Sunset Minnow [[Sunset Minnow]]

  • －
    questFishingDailyNoWheatfish

    Bring me 3 fish today, matey. Anything but Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]]. I've had my fill of those.

  • －
    questFishingDailyNoWheatfishCollect

    Catch 3 fish other than Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]]

  • －
    questFishingDailyNoWheatfishDelivery

    Bring Blubberbeard 3 fish other than Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]]

  • －
    questFishingDailyNoDarter

    Bring me 3 fish today, matey. No Darters [[Darter]], mind. Too bony by half.

  • －
    questFishingDailyNoDarterCollect

    Catch 3 fish other than Darters [[Darter]]

  • －
    questFishingDailyNoDarterDelivery

    Bring Blubberbeard 3 fish other than Darters [[Darter]]

  • －
    questFirstKnotName

    The First Knot

  • －
    questFirstKnotDescription

    Every angler learns their first fish by heart. Catch a Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]], a Sunset Minnow [[Sunset Minnow]], a Red Strongfish [[Red Strongfish]] and a Boomerang Fish [[Boomerang Fish]] in any water here in the hub, matey.

  • －
    questKnotHandIn

    Thank you, matey! Straight into my bucket.

  • －
    questFirstKnotWheatfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]]. The commonest bite in these waters, and the first worth knowing.

  • －
    questFirstKnotSunsetMinnowDescription

    Catch or bring a Sunset Minnow [[Sunset Minnow]]. Small and quick, and coloured like the evening sky.

  • －
    questFirstKnotRedStrongfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Red Strongfish [[Red Strongfish]]. It pulls hard, so hold your line firm.

  • －
    questFirstKnotBoomerangFishDescription

    Catch or bring a Boomerang Fish [[Boomerang Fish]]. Odd-shaped thing, and the shyest of these four, so keep casting, matey.

  • －
    questFirstKnotReportDescription

    Got all four? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.

  • －
    questFirstKnotCompleted

    All four fish, and your first knot tied. Thank you, matey. Take this Knotted Rod. Now and then it brings up two fish at once.

  • －
    questFirstKnotWheatfish

    Catch or bring a Wheatfish [[Wheatfish]]

  • －
    questFirstKnotSunsetMinnow

    Catch or bring a Sunset Minnow [[Sunset Minnow]]

  • －
    questFirstKnotRedStrongfish

    Catch or bring a Red Strongfish [[Red Strongfish]]

  • －
    questFirstKnotBoomerangFish

    Catch or bring a Boomerang Fish [[Boomerang Fish]]

  • －
    questKnotReport

    Report back to Blubberbeard

  • －
    questBowlineName

    The Bowline

  • －
    questBowlineDescription

    You have the feel of the line now, matey. Next: a Darter [[Darter]], a Root Flounder [[Root Flounder]], a Greenfin Loach [[Greenfin Loach]], a Green Strongfish [[Green Strongfish]] and a shy Seahorse [[Seahorse]]. Cast in any water here in the hub.

  • －
    questBowlineDarterDescription

    Catch or bring a Darter [[Darter]]. Quick as an arrow, but it bites often.

  • －
    questBowlineRootFlounderDescription

    Catch or bring a Root Flounder [[Root Flounder]]. Flat as a plank and brown as an old root.

  • －
    questBowlineGreenfinLoachDescription

    Catch or bring a Greenfin Loach [[Greenfin Loach]]. Slippery, so reel it in quickly.

  • －
    questBowlineGreenStrongfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Green Strongfish [[Green Strongfish]]. Cousin to the Red, and it puts up a real fight.

  • －
    questBowlineSeahorseDescription

    Catch or bring a Seahorse [[Seahorse]]. The shyest bite yet, so be patient, matey.

  • －
    questBowlineReportDescription

    Got all five? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.

  • －
    questBowlineCompleted

    Five more fish, and a fine Bowline tied. Thank you, matey. Take this Bowline Rod. Fish bite on it sooner, and it brings up two at once more often.

  • －
    questBowlineDarter

    Catch or bring a Darter [[Darter]]

  • －
    questBowlineRootFlounder

    Catch or bring a Root Flounder [[Root Flounder]]

  • －
    questBowlineGreenfinLoach

    Catch or bring a Greenfin Loach [[Greenfin Loach]]

  • －
    questBowlineGreenStrongfish

    Catch or bring a Green Strongfish [[Green Strongfish]]

  • －
    questBowlineSeahorse

    Catch or bring a Seahorse [[Seahorse]]

  • －
    questAnchorBendName

    The Anchor Bend

  • －
    questAnchorBendDescription

    Now for some stronger fish, matey, and shyer ones too, so settle in for a longer wait: a Spined Stickleback [[Spined Stickleback]], a Moon Strongfish [[Moon Strongfish]], a Boulder Bass [[Boulder Bass]] and a Grass Snapper [[Grass Snapper]]. Cast in any water here in the hub.

  • －
    questAnchorBendSpinedSticklebackDescription

    Catch or bring a Spined Stickleback [[Spined Stickleback]]. Prickly little thing, so hold on tight.

  • －
    questAnchorBendMoonStrongfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Moon Strongfish [[Moon Strongfish]]. Pale as the moon, and strong as its cousins.

  • －
    questAnchorBendBoulderBassDescription

    Catch or bring a Boulder Bass [[Boulder Bass]]. Heavy as a rock, so pull with all you have.

  • －
    questAnchorBendGrassSnapperDescription

    Catch or bring a Grass Snapper [[Grass Snapper]]. It snaps quickly, so be ready.

  • －
    questAnchorBendReportDescription

    Got all four? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.

  • －
    questAnchorBendCompleted

    Four strong fish, and the Anchor Bend tied. Thank you, matey. Take this Anchor Rod. Fish bite on it a touch sooner, and rare fish bite on it far more often.

  • －
    questAnchorBendSpinedStickleback

    Catch or bring a Spined Stickleback [[Spined Stickleback]]

  • －
    questAnchorBendMoonStrongfish

    Catch or bring a Moon Strongfish [[Moon Strongfish]]

  • －
    questAnchorBendBoulderBass

    Catch or bring a Boulder Bass [[Boulder Bass]]

  • －
    questAnchorBendGrassSnapper

    Catch or bring a Grass Snapper [[Grass Snapper]]

  • －
    questFishermansKnotName

    The Fisherman's Knot

  • －
    questFishermansKnotDescription

    In all my years I've seen a Crystalized Wheatfish [[Crystalized Wheatfish]] and a Moonstone Pupfish [[Moonstone Pupfish]] only a handful of times. Catch me one of each, matey.

  • －
    questFishermansKnotCrystalizedWheatfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Crystalized Wheatfish [[Crystalized Wheatfish]]. It can slip off the hook, so hold on tight.

  • －
    questFishermansKnotMoonstonePupfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Moonstone Pupfish [[Moonstone Pupfish]], the rarest fish in these waters. Be quick when it bites.

  • －
    questFishermansKnotReportDescription

    Got them both? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.

  • －
    questFishermansKnotCompleted

    Both of them! Few anglers ever see those, matey. Thank you. Take this Fisherman's Rod. Fish bite on it quicker than on any rod I've given you, one catch in four brings up a second fish, and rare fish bite on it just as often as on your Anchor Rod.

  • －
    questFishermansKnotCrystalizedWheatfish

    Catch or bring a Crystalized Wheatfish [[Crystalized Wheatfish]]

  • －
    questFishermansKnotMoonstonePupfish

    Catch or bring a Moonstone Pupfish [[Moonstone Pupfish]]

  • －
    woodyQuestGreeting

    You're back. Come and talk when you're ready.

  • －
    catnissQuestGreeting

    Ah, my favourite challenger returns! Come, let us talk.

  • －
    digoryQuestGreeting

    There you are, friend! Come and have a word.

  • －
    gillQuestGreeting

    Hello again, dear. Come and have a chat when you're ready.

  • －
    blubberbeardQuestGreeting

    Ahoy, matey! Come and have a word with old Blubberbeard.

  • －
    grimbaldQuestGreeting

    You. Human. Over here.

  • －
    grimbaldInventoryFull

    Your pack's full. Make room, then talk to me.

  • －
    questTroubleBelowName

    Trouble Below

  • －
    questTroubleBelowDescription

    Meteors fall on Cragrock Mines all the time, but a big one has just struck. My mum Sapphire lives there, and they need every pair of hands. The old portal at the back of my Rockpile has a Portal Guardian charging {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head. Go and see Up Dog at the hub's Market first; he'll help you sell your way there.

  • －
    questTroubleBelowLearnedDescription

    Meteors fall on Cragrock Mines all the time, but a big one has just struck. My mum Sapphire lives there, and they need every pair of hands. The old portal at the back of my Rockpile has a Portal Guardian charging {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head. I can smell Up Dog on you from here, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare and pay him!

  • －
    questTroubleBelowFreeDescription

    Meteors fall on Cragrock Mines all the time, but a big one has just struck. My mum Sapphire lives there, and they need every pair of hands. The Portal Guardian at the back of my Rockpile will let you through the old portal. Go on, they're waiting!

  • －
    questTroubleBelowMarket

    Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub

  • －
    questTroubleBelowMarketDescription

    Visit Up Dog at the hub's Market. He'll show you how to sell spare ore for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.

  • －
    questTroubleBelowMarketLearned

    You smell like Up Dog, friend, so you've found the Market already. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].

  • －
    questTroubleBelowPortal

    Use the cyan portal to Cragrock Mines

  • －
    questTroubleBelowPortalDescription

    Toll paid! Step through the cyan portal at the back of my Rockpile to reach Cragrock Mines.

  • －
    questTroubleBelowFreePortalDescription

    Step through the cyan portal at the back of my Rockpile to reach Cragrock Mines.

  • －
    questTroubleBelowGrimbald

    Speak to Elder Crag at the mine entrance

  • －
    questTroubleBelowGrimbaldDescription

    Find Elder Crag by the mine entrance and tell him I sent you. Don't take his grumbling to heart!

  • －
    questTroubleBelowMeeting

    Ruby sent me a human? Hmph. I asked for help, not sightseers. That big meteor took half our tunnels and most of our nerve, so you'll have to do.

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosName

    Into the Wild Infernos

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosDescription

    You've earned this, duellist. Past the old frame at the far end of The Badlands lie the Wild Infernos, the desert where Mini and I grew up. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, so see Up Dog at the hub's Market first. He'll help you sell your way there.

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosLearnedDescription

    You've earned this, duellist. Past the old frame at the far end of The Badlands lie the Wild Infernos, the desert where Mini and I grew up. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, and you know the Market already. Sell your spoils and pay him!

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosFreeDescription

    You've earned this, duellist. Past the old frame at the far end of The Badlands lie the Wild Infernos, the desert where Mini and I grew up. Its Portal Guardian will let you through. Go on, the desert awaits!

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosMarket

    Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosMarketDescription

    Visit Up Dog at the hub's Market. He'll show you how to sell your spoils for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosMarketLearned

    You've met Up Dog already, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosPortal

    Use the red portal to the Wild Infernos

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosPortalDescription

    Toll paid! Step through the red portal at the far end of The Badlands to reach the Wild Infernos.

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosFreePortalDescription

    Step through the red portal at the far end of The Badlands to reach the Wild Infernos.

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosAshhorn

    Speak to Elder Ashborn in the outpost

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosAshhornDescription

    Find Elder Ashborn in Emberwatch Outpost, beside the portal, and tell him I sent you. He taught Mini and me everything we know, so mind your manners!

  • －
    questIntoTheInfernosMeeting

    Lorenzo's student? Then you are welcome here, traveller. Humans and minotaurs share this outpost, the only safe ground for miles. The desert beyond our walls is cruel, but its fire is sacred. Walk it with respect.

  • －
    questIntoTheReachName

    Into the Lantern Reach

  • －
    questIntoTheReachDescription

    You've a real angler's hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I've never been back. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, so see Up Dog at the hub's Market first. He'll help you sell your way there.

  • －
    questIntoTheReachLearnedDescription

    You've a real angler's hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I've never been back. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, and you know the Market already. Sell what you can spare and pay him!

  • －
    questIntoTheReachFreeDescription

    You've a real angler's hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I've never been back. The Portal Guardian will let you through. Go and see it for me.

  • －
    questIntoTheReachMarket

    Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub

  • －
    questIntoTheReachMarketDescription

    Visit Up Dog at the hub's Market. He'll show you how to sell spare resources for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.

  • －
    questIntoTheReachMarketLearned

    You've met Up Dog already, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].

  • －
    questIntoTheReachPortal

    Use the blue portal to the Lantern Reach

  • －
    questIntoTheReachPortalDescription

    Toll paid! Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.

  • －
    questIntoTheReachFreePortalDescription

    Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.

  • －
    questIntoTheReachKeeper

    Speak to Stinky at the lighthouse

  • －
    questIntoTheReachKeeperDescription

    Follow the jetty from the harbour to the lighthouse on its rock. You'll smell old Stinky before you see him! Tell him Blubberbeard sent you, and that I'm sorry.

  • －
    questIntoTheReachMeeting

    Blubberbeard sent you? My old apprentice... Tell him there's nothing to forgive. Welcome to the Lantern Reach, friend. Everyone here calls me Stinky, and you'll soon smell why! The Lamp has been dark a long while, and the fish sleep deep without its light. But a good angler might just wake them.

  • －
    keeperWickNothingToDo

    Sit a while and watch the water, friend. Upwind of me, if you like. Every ripple has a story.

  • －
    keeperWickQuestGreeting

    Ah, a visitor! Come into the light, such as it is. Don't mind the flies, they're old friends.

  • －
    keeperWickInventoryFull

    Your pack is full to the brim, friend. Make some room and come back.

  • －
    lanternReachHush

    This water is still. Only small fry bite here until Stinky's lens shines on it.

  • －
    questKeeperWickLensHandIn

    Ah, look at it glow! Thank you, friend.

  • －
    questKeeperWickLensReport

    Report back to Stinky

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensName

    The Kelpwood Lens

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensDescription

    The lagoon fish still carry a little of the old light. Catch me a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]], a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]], an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]] and a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]] here in the lagoon, and their glow will relight the lens that faces Kelpwood.

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensReportDescription

    Got all four? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.

  • －
    questNothingToForgiveName

    Nothing to Forgive

  • －
    questNothingToForgiveDescription

    The Lamp is waking at last, and its light reaches further every day. Would you carry a message for an old Keeper, friend? My apprentice never heard my answer. Tell Blubberbeard there's nothing to forgive, and that the Lamp burns again.

  • －
    questNothingToForgiveTell

    Tell Blubberbeard in the Hub

  • －
    questNothingToForgiveTellDescription

    Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and give him Stinky's answer.

  • －
    questNothingToForgiveCompleted

    He said that? Nothing to forgive... I've carried that guilt since I was a lad, matey. And the Lamp burns again! Here, take these two Glowtide Flares I've kept since I left. Light one over Reach water and think of an old Keeper.

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensCompleted

    Look, friend! The west lens is burning again, and its beam has reached Kelpwood. The fish there are waking already. Take my old Tidelight Rod. Its line still holds a little of the Lamp's light, so fish bite on it quicker and two at a time more often.

  • －
    questAmethystLensName

    The Amethyst Lens

  • －
    questAmethystLensDescription

    Kelpwood is waking, and its big fish glow brighter than anything in the lagoon. Catch me a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]], a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]], a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]], a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]] and an Oarfish [[Oarfish]] in Kelpwood's water, west across the bridge, and we'll light the lens that faces the Amethyst shoals.

  • －
    questAmethystLensReportDescription

    Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.

  • －
    questAmethystLensCompleted

    Two lenses lit! The east beam has reached the Amethyst shoals, and the crystals are humming. This Glowglass Rod has a chip of the Kelpwood lens for a float, and fish come to it sooner.

  • －
    questMoonwellLensName

    The Moonwell Lens

  • －
    questMoonwellLensDescription

    Now the lens that faces the Moonwell, where the oldest fish sleep. It needs the brightest catches in the Reach. Catch me an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]], a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]], a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]], a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]] and a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]] in the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge.

  • －
    questMoonwellLensReportDescription

    Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.

  • －
    questMoonwellLensCompleted

    Three beams across the water, friend! The Moonwell is stirring at last. Take the Moonwell Rod. It's cut from amethyst and cooled in that very pool, and the deepest fish rise to it.

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensHatchetfish

    Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensHatchetfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]. A thin silver thing that glints when it turns. The lagoon is full of them.

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensPolarflash

    Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensPolarflashDescription

    Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]. It still sparks a little in the lagoon's dark water. Quick on the hook!

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnow

    Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnowDescription

    Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]. Pale as mist, and the gentlest bite in the lagoon.

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouper

    Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]

  • －
    questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouperDescription

    Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]. It hides on the lagoon floor and rarely bites, so be patient.

  • －
    questAmethystLensArapaima

    Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]

  • －
    questAmethystLensArapaimaDescription

    Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]. Big and slow, with a back as green as the kelp it hides in.

  • －
    questAmethystLensStingray

    Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]

  • －
    questAmethystLensStingrayDescription

    Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]. It glides low through the mangrove roots. Reel it in steadily.

  • －
    questAmethystLensSawfish

    Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]

  • －
    questAmethystLensSawfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]. Mind its nose! It fights hard all the way in from Kelpwood's channels.

  • －
    questAmethystLensSturgeon

    Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]

  • －
    questAmethystLensOarfish

    Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]

  • －
    questAmethystLensSturgeonDescription

    Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]. The oldest fish in Kelpwood, and a shy one.

  • －
    questAmethystLensOarfishDescription

    Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]. Long as a jetty and rarely seen. Keep casting in Kelpwood's water, and it will come.

  • －
    questMoonwellLensEel

    Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]

  • －
    questMoonwellLensEelDescription

    Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]. It crackles with light of its own down in the shoals. Just the thing for a lens!

  • －
    questMoonwellLensDarter

    Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]

  • －
    questMoonwellLensDarterDescription

    Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]. Quick as a shadow between the crystals. Watch your float closely.

  • －
    questMoonwellLensMoray

    Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]

  • －
    questMoonwellLensMorayDescription

    Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]. It hides in the crystal cracks and bites hard when it does.

  • －
    questMoonwellLensDragonfish

    Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]

  • －
    questMoonwellLensGiantMoray

    Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]

  • －
    questMoonwellLensDragonfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]. It shines like moonlight on the Amethyst shoals.

  • －
    questMoonwellLensGiantMorayDescription

    Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]. The biggest hunter in the shoals, and the rarest bite of all. Patience, friend.

  • －
    questTheHushName

    The Hush

  • －
    questTheHushDescription

    Three lenses lit, and still the Lamp won't wake fully. That's the Hush, friend. It's no curse, only a great old fish that fell asleep in the Moonwell when the light went out, and the whole Reach went quiet with it. Will you call it up for me? Gently, now. It only needs waking.

  • －
    questTheHushCall

    Wait for the Hush in the Moonwell without reeling in

  • －
    questTheHushCallDescription

    Cast into the Moonwell, north across the bridge from the Lamp, and keep still while you wait: a tap or click reels the line in. When the Hush rises, tap to bring it up and it will swim home.

  • －
    questTheHushReturn

    Return to Stinky

  • －
    questTheHushReturnDescription

    The Hush is home in the deep again. Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.

  • －
    questTheHushCompleted

    There! Do you see it? The whole Lamp is shining, friend, brighter than I've seen it since I was young. The Hush was never our enemy. It only needed someone patient enough to call it up and let it be. Take these five Glowtide Flares, and fish the Moonwell whenever you like. That old fish may come up to say hello.

  • －
    questLanternReachMailName

    News of the Lantern Reach

  • －
    questLanternReachMailDescription

    There you are! The portal to the Lantern Reach can finally be opened. Blubberbeard grew up out there, and he's been staring at that portal all week. Go and ask him about it!

  • －
    questAskBlubberbeardAboutReach

    Ask Blubberbeard about the Lantern Reach

  • －
    questAskBlubberbeardAboutReachDescription

    Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and take on his task to reach the Lantern Reach.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentQuestGreeting

    There you are, dear. I was hoping you'd drift by.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentInventoryFull

    Your pockets are full, dear. Make a little room, and I'll give you what I owe you.

  • －
    questLostPoolName

    The Lost Pool

  • －
    questLostPoolDescription

    When I was young, dear, there was a pool hidden among these roots, where the kelp meets the cliff. The wisps still whisper of it. Would you find it and catch 3 fish there? I'd so like to know it's still alive.

  • －
    questLostPoolCatch

    Catch 3 fish in Kelpwood's hidden pool

  • －
    questLostPoolCatchDescription

    Search Kelpwood's west rim, behind the trees on the far side from its bridge, for a crack of hidden water. Cast into it and land 3 fish.

  • －
    questLostPoolReturn

    Return to Auntie Glenda

  • －
    questLostPoolReturnDescription

    The old pool is still full of fish. Go and tell Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood's roots.

  • －
    questLostPoolCompleted

    Still full of fish, after all these years... Thank you, dear. I feel a little lighter, as if the mist has thinned. Take these Glowtide Flares, and the [[Gold Coin]] that washed into my roots.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentLampFestivalInvited

    A festival at the Lamp? Oh, dear, I haven't been to one in a hundred years. I'll drift across the water as soon as the lanterns are lit.

  • －
    amethystResidentQuestGreeting

    You came back! I've got a really important job for you.

  • －
    amethystResidentInventoryFull

    Your bag's too full! Make some room, then come back. I've got something for you!

  • －
    questPerfectPitchName

    Perfect Pitch

  • －
    questPerfectPitchDescription

    When the Lamp's beam shines on my crystals, the fish swim up to listen! I want to hear them sing. Catch 3 fish where the beam touches the Amethyst water, and I'll tune to their song.

  • －
    questPerfectPitchCatch

    Catch 3 fish where the Lamp's beam touches the Amethyst water

  • －
    questPerfectPitchCatchDescription

    Find the column of light where the Lamp's beam touches the Amethyst water. It drifts across the water and rests now and then, so cast into it and keep your float in its light until the bite. Land 3 fish bitten there.

  • －
    questPerfectPitchReturn

    Return to Urchin

  • －
    questPerfectPitchReturnDescription

    The shoal sang in the beam's light. Go and tell Urchin by his dock hut.

  • －
    questPerfectPitchCompleted

    Listen... every crystal is singing the same song! You did it! Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]]. And tell Stinky he still hums flat. Don't say it was me!

  • －
    amethystResidentLampFestivalInvited

    A festival? With music?! I'll tune every crystal on the shoals. Can I stay up for the lanterns?

  • －
    moonwellResidentQuestGreeting

    Softly... oh, it's you. Come and sit by the well.

  • －
    moonwellResidentInventoryFull

    Your pack is full... make a little room, and I'll give you what I promised.

  • －
    questGlowtideLullabyName

    Glowtide Lullaby

  • －
    questGlowtideLullabyDescription

    When the glowtide drifts over the Moonwell, the sleeping fish rise to dream in its glow. Would you catch 40 of them there for me? Then I'll know what they're dreaming, and what to sing.

  • －
    questGlowtideLullabyCatch

    Catch 40 fish in a glowtide bloom on the Moonwell

  • －
    questGlowtideLullabyCatchDescription

    Find a glowing glowtide bloom on the Moonwell's water, cast into it and land 40 fish while your float is in its glow. A Glowtide Flare calls up a bloom of your own.

  • －
    questGlowtideLullabyReturn

    Return to Hesper

  • －
    questGlowtideLullabyReturnDescription

    The Moonwell's fish rose to the glow. Go and tell Hesper at the Moonwell.

  • －
    questGlowtideLullabyCompleted

    They dream of the light... every one of them. I'll sing them something new tonight. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and keep the Moonwell glowing.

  • －
    moonwellResidentLampFestivalInvited

    A festival at the Lamp... I'll bring my lantern, and sing the fish to sleep after. Wake me if I doze off.

  • －
    pimLampFestivalInvited

    A festival?! At the Lamp?! I'll hang the bunting! I'll bake! Oh, I've waited my whole life for this!

  • －
    questLampFestivalInvitedBlubberbeard

    A festival at the Lamp, and old Stinky asked for me? ...Tell him I'll be there, matey. It's high time I went home.

  • －
    questLampFestivalName

    The Lamp Festival

  • －
    questLampFestivalDescription

    The whole Lamp is shining, friend, and every island is awake again. Time we had a Lamp Festival, like the ones I knew as a boy! Will you invite everyone for me? Start with Auntie Glenda, over on Kelpwood.

  • －
    questLampFestivalRose

    Invite Rose to the Lamp Festival

  • －
    questLampFestivalRoseDescription

    Back to the harbour now. Find Rose by her Tide Ledger and invite her to the Lamp Festival. She'll want to bake.

  • －
    questLampFestivalGlenda

    Invite Auntie Glenda to the Lamp Festival

  • －
    questLampFestivalGlendaDescription

    Find Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood's roots, west across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.

  • －
    questLampFestivalChime

    Invite Urchin to the Lamp Festival

  • －
    questLampFestivalChimeDescription

    Find Urchin by his dock hut on the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge, and invite him to the Lamp Festival.

  • －
    questLampFestivalHesper

    Invite Hesper to the Lamp Festival

  • －
    questLampFestivalHesperDescription

    Find Hesper at the Moonwell, north across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.

  • －
    questLampFestivalBlubberbeard

    Invite Blubberbeard to the Lamp Festival

  • －
    questLampFestivalBlubberbeardDescription

    Everyone in the Reach is coming. Go back through the portal to the Hub, find Blubberbeard by his shack, and invite him home to the Lamp Festival.

  • －
    questLampFestivalReturn

    Return to Stinky

  • －
    questLampFestivalReturnDescription

    Blubberbeard is coming home! Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.

  • －
    questLampFestivalCompleted

    Blubberbeard's coming home? Oh, friend... I never stopped keeping a light on for him. Look at the Reach tonight: every island lit, and all of us together again. You did this. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and come to every festival we ever have.

  • －
    keeperWickHushWaitShh

    Shh... Keep still and let the line rest, friend.

  • －
    keeperWickHushWaitStill

    Still now. Something old is stirring...

  • －
    keeperWickHushWaitNearly

    Nearly... It's rising to you.

  • －
    keeperWickHushWaitAbandoned

    Shh... it's still close. Cast again and keep still.

  • －
    keeperWickHushReelLost

    Oh! It slipped back down, friend. Cast again, it's still close.

  • －
    keeperWickHushWaitInterrupted

    The Hush is still close, friend. Cast again when you're ready.

  • －
    keeperWickKeepersChairLocked

    Not yet, friend. The Keeper's Chair waits until the whole Lamp is awake.

  • －
    keeperWickKeepersChairWelcome

    Sit a while, friend. Turn the Lamp toward any water you've lit, and it will shine a little kinder there, just for you.

  • －
    keepersChairTitle

    Keeper's Chair

  • －
    keepersChairClose

    Close the Keeper's Chair

  • －
    keepersChairPrompt

    Sit in the Keeper's Chair

  • －
    keepersChairRopeUp

    Climb to the lantern room

  • －
    keepersChairRopeDown

    Climb down

  • －
    keepersChairKelpwood

    Kelpwood

  • －
    keepersChairAmethyst

    Amethyst Shoals

  • －
    keepersChairMoonwell

    Moonwell

  • －
    keepersChairAim

    Aim the Lamp

  • －
    keepersChairAimLabel

    Aim the Lamp at {{island}}

  • －
    keepersChairAimed

    Lamp aimed

  • －
    keepersChairRest

    Rest the Lamp

  • －
    keepersChairDark

    Lens still dark

  • －
    keepersChairTideNotice

    Today's Tide Notice

  • －
    keepersChairFavour

    Aimed water: blooms hold more rares and last longer, and the Tide Notice fish bites more often.

  • －
    keepersChairAimedStatus

    The Lamp shines on {{island}}.

  • －
    keepersChairRestedStatus

    The Lamp rests, shining on every island alike.

  • －
    keepersChairTooFar

    Climb to the lantern room to aim the Lamp.

  • －
    keepersChairNotRelit

    Relight that island's lens first.

  • －
    keeperWickReachLogWelcome

    My old logbook, friend. It smells of bait, like me! Land the biggest of each fish and I'll ink it in, bright as a beam.

  • －
    keeperWickReachLogPageGold

    A whole page in gold! Not even the Lamp shines that bright. Take these three Glowtide Flares, friend.

  • －
    keeperWickLampLightWelcome

    Every fish you let go leaves a little light behind, friend. The Lamp keeps it safe for you.

  • －
    keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseKelpwood

    A Kelpwood fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight Kelpwood's lens and they'll swim home.

  • －
    keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseAmethyst

    An Amethyst Shoals fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight their lens and they'll swim home.

  • －
    keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseMoonwell

    A Moonwell fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight the Moonwell's lens and they'll swim home.

  • －
    keeperWickHiddenWatersAllFound

    Every hidden water in the Reach! Even I'd forgotten one or two. Take this Glowtide Flare [[Radiant Spark]], friend.

  • －

    Lamp Light

  • －
    lampLightChairTab

    The Lamp
