  • －
    lampLightCharmQuickLine

    Quick Line

  • －
    lampLightCharmQuickLineEffect

    Faster bites, but fewer rares on each.

  • －
    lampLightCharmSteadfast

    Steadfast

  • －
    lampLightCharmSteadfastEffect

    Bloom catches fill the Glow meter faster, but fewer rares bite on their own.

  • －
    lampLightCharmTideReader

    Tide Reader

  • －
    lampLightCharmTideReaderEffect

    Today's Tide Notice fish bites far more often on every lens island.

  • －
    lampLightCharmStillWater

    Stillwater

  • －
    lampLightCharmStillWaterEffect

    Away from blooms, slower bites with more rares; in a bloom, fewer rares.

  • －
    lampLightCharmSoftWake

    Soft Wake

  • －
    lampLightCharmSoftWakeEffect

    Your flare blooms last longer, but blooms hold fewer rares.

  • －
    lampLightTintEmberGold

    Ember Gold

  • －
    lampLightTintRoseTide

    Rose Tide

  • －
    lampLightTintSeaGlass

    Seafoam

  • －
    lampLightTintStarlight

    Starlight

  • －
    lampLightTintRegularFlicker

    Flicker Blue

  • －
    lampLightTintRegularBarnaby

    Captain's Brass

  • －
    lampLightTintRegularMossy

    Mossy Green

  • －
    lampLightTintRegularGleam

    Gleam Violet

  • －
    lampLightTintRegularFizz

    Fizz Spark

  • －
    lampLightTintRegularPith

    Professor's Ink

  • －
    lampLightTintRegularSnowdrop

    Snowdrop White

  • －
    lampLightTintRegularSterling

    Sterling Shine

  • －
    lampLightTintRegularBertha

    Bertha's Deep

  • －
    lampLightCharmKelpwoodKnot

    Kelpwood Knot

  • －
    lampLightCharmKelpwoodKnotEffect

    A gift from Kelpwood's Regulars. Faster bites, but fewer rares on each.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentHome

    Feel that, dear? The moment that beam touched the kelp, the mist lifted, and I'm warm right through for the first time in years.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentGreeting

    Oh! Don't be frightened, dear. I'm only tall.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentAsleepGreeting

    Oh! Don't be frightened, dear. I'm only tall, and a touch misty while the water sleeps.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentAsleepTalk

    The kelp water has slept since the Lamp went dark, and the roots have grown so cold. Stinky at the Lamp knows how to relight Kelpwood's lens.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentWork

    I've drifted through these roots for centuries. Some nights I can almost see the way on... then the mist closes again.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentFavouriteFish

    Ever landed a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]? Its green is the kelp of the first morning I remember, centuries ago.

  • －
    amethystResidentHome

    Listen! The crystals are ringing again! I knew they would. Ding!

  • －
    amethystResidentGreeting

    Oh! Hello! Tiptoe, please. The crystals are tuning.

  • －
    amethystResidentAsleepGreeting

    Oh! Hello! Shh... the crystals haven't rung once since the light went out.

  • －
    amethystResidentAsleepTalk

    My crystals won't ring without the Lamp's beam, and the fish won't come up to listen. It's sooo quiet! Ask Stinky how to relight the Amethyst lens. Please?

  • －
    amethystResidentWork

    I tune all the crystals. All by myself! Hmm... that one's a teeny bit flat.

  • －
    amethystResidentFavouriteFish

    An Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]] hums the perfect note! I tune my crystals to it. Bzzzz!

  • －
    moonwellResidentHome

    Softly now... I stayed by the well through all the dark. Now the light's back, I can sing in it again.

  • －
    moonwellResidentGreeting

    Softly now... the old fish are dreaming.

  • －
    moonwellResidentAsleepGreeting

    Softly now... the whole Moonwell is asleep while the Lamp is dark.

  • －
    moonwellResidentAsleepTalk

    I sing to the Moonwell every night, but its fish won't wake without the light. Perhaps Stinky could help you relight its lens...

  • －
    moonwellResidentWork

    Lullay, little fins... The oldest fish sleep deep down there. I hum to them each night so they dream of the light.

  • －
    moonwellResidentFavouriteFish

    A Glacial Lanternfish [[Glacial Lanternfish]] glows just like a little lamp. On dark nights, I wish I had one to sing by.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentLoanAsk

    Lend me your next Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]] from Kelpwood? I'll keep it a day for its warmth, then let it go.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentLoanAskPopup

    Lend Auntie Glenda your next Mossback Arapaima? It comes back with a gift once the day turns over.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentLoanAccepted

    Thank you, dear. Land one on Kelpwood and it will find its way to me.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentLoanWaiting

    Still hoping for that Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]. From Kelpwood water, mind.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentLoanWithMe

    Your fish is circling my roots, not a bit afraid of me. Come and see me once the day's turned over.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentLoanBusy

    Oh, I've gone a little misty. Ask me again in a moment.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentLoanSpokenFor

    Spoken for: Auntie Glenda will love this one.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentLoanThanksSmall

    A little one, {{kg}} kg, but so warm and lively! It's back among the reeds. This is yours.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentLoanThanksFine

    A fine {{kg}} kg! It kept me company all night, and now it's swimming free. Take this, with my thanks.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentLoanThanksBig

    {{kg}} kg! I haven't felt so much life in a century. It swam off proud. For you.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentSplashJarTipped

    A full jar, dear! I watched over it while it filled. Straight into your net.

  • －
    amethystResidentLoanAsk

    Can I borrow your next Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]] from the shoals? Its hum will fix my flat crystal, then it can swim home.

  • －
    amethystResidentLoanAskPopup

    Lend Urchin your next Electric Eel? It comes back with a gift once the day turns over.

  • －
    amethystResidentLoanAccepted

    Yay! Land one in Amethyst water and it comes to me. I'll get my tuning fork!

  • －
    amethystResidentLoanWaiting

    No Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]] yet? It has to be from the shoals! My crystal is still all wonky.

  • －
    amethystResidentLoanWithMe

    Your eel is humming lovely and I'm still tuning. Come back when the day has turned over, okay?

  • －
    amethystResidentLoanBusy

    Shh, I'm holding a note! Ask me again in a bit.

  • －
    amethystResidentLoanSpokenFor

    Spoken for: Urchin will love this one.

  • －
    amethystResidentLoanThanksSmall

    A tiny eel, {{kg}} kg, but what a big voice! My crystal rings true, and the eel is back in the shoals. Yours!

  • －
    amethystResidentLoanThanksFine

    {{kg}} kg of perfect humming! I tuned three crystals with it, then let it go. Here, take this!

  • －
    amethystResidentLoanThanksBig

    A {{kg}} kg eel! It hummed like a harbour bell, and my whole shelf rang along! It swam home singing. This is yours!

  • －
    amethystResidentSplashJarTipped

    Did you hear that? Splish, splash, plop! That's three notes!

  • －
    moonwellResidentLoanAsk

    Could I borrow your next Glacial Lanternfish [[Glacial Lanternfish]] from the Moonwell? One lullaby, then it swims free.

  • －
    moonwellResidentLoanAskPopup

    Lend Hesper your next Glacial Lanternfish? It comes back with a gift once the day turns over.

  • －
    moonwellResidentLoanAccepted

    Thank you... Land one in the Moonwell, and it will find its way to me.

  • －
    moonwellResidentLoanWaiting

    I'm still listening for a Glacial Lanternfish [[Glacial Lanternfish]] from the Moonwell.

  • －
    moonwellResidentLoanWithMe

    Shh... your lanternfish is dozing by my lantern. Visit me once the day has turned over.

  • －
    moonwellResidentLoanBusy

    Hush a moment... the verse isn't done. Ask me again soon.

  • －
    moonwellResidentLoanSpokenFor

    Spoken for: Hesper will love this one.

  • －
    moonwellResidentLoanThanksSmall

    Your little lanternfish, {{kg}} kg, dozed off by the second verse. It drifted down to the deep. Something for you.

  • －
    moonwellResidentLoanThanksFine

    I sang to your {{kg}} kg lanternfish all night; it glowed with every note. It glides in the dark water now. Here.

  • －
    moonwellResidentLoanThanksBig

    Such a big one, {{kg}} kg... its glow lit the whole well while I sang. It sank away slowly, still shining. Thank you.

  • －
    moonwellResidentSplashJarTipped

    Softly now... that one was dozing in the jar. Off you go, little fins.

  • －
    pimResidentLoanKelpwood

    Auntie Glenda's glowing over at Kelpwood! Sounds like she has something for you.

  • －
    pimResidentLoanAmethyst

    Urchin's waving from the Amethyst shoals! Something about a crystal, and something for you.

  • －
    pimResidentLoanMoonwell

    Hesper's lantern is swinging over at the Moonwell. She has something for you!

  • －
    pimResidentLoanSeveral

    Your friends on the isles are waving! Some of them have something for you.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentReturnerNoteTitle

    From Auntie Glenda

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentReturnerTrinketA

    Auntie Glenda's lost locket

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentReturnerTrinketB

    Auntie Glenda's lost hair comb

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentReturnerThanksA

    My locket, dear! Caught on {{name}}'s fin all these years? I lost it before the Lamp was built. Here's {{coins}} [[Gold Coin]], with my thanks.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentReturnerThanksB

    Is that my old comb? On {{name}}, of all fish! You clever thing. {{coins}} [[Gold Coin]] for you, dear, and not a word of argument.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentFeatPageGold

    Stinky says every Kelpwood fish in your Reach Log has a Gold mark now. I've not seen the like in three hundred years, dear!

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentFeatReturner

    The roots are still whispering about that giant {{fish}} you hooked!

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentFeatHaloA

    Your {{fish}} came up in the beam's light, didn't it? It shone right through me!

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentFeatHaloB

    A {{fish}} touched by the Lamp's beam! That light felt almost warm.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentFeatHiddenWater

    You found the crack through the west rim? Clever dear. I drift through there on quiet nights.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentFeatGoldFishA

    A Gold mark for your {{fish}}! I've watched anglers for centuries, and that's among the finest.

  • －
    kelpwoodResidentFeatGoldFishB

    Word drifted to my roots about your Gold {{fish}}. Well done, dear. Now sit a while with an old ghost.

  • －
    amethystResidentReturnerNoteTitle

    From Urchin

  • －
    amethystResidentReturnerTrinketA

    Urchin's lost bell

  • －
    amethystResidentReturnerTrinketB

    Urchin's spare tuning fork

  • －
    amethystResidentReturnerThanksA

    My bell! I'd know that ding anywhere. {{name}} was ringing it under the water all this time! {{coins}} [[Gold Coin]] for you!

  • －
    amethystResidentReturnerThanksB

    My spare tuning fork! It's back from the deep and still perfectly in tune! {{name}} looked after it. Here's {{coins}} [[Gold Coin]]!

  • －
    amethystResidentFeatPageGold

    Gold on every Amethyst fish in your Reach Log! The crystals rang a whole chord when I told them.

  • －
    amethystResidentFeatReturner

    That giant {{fish}} you landed! The crystals are still humming about it.

  • －
    amethystResidentFeatHaloA

    A {{fish}} caught in the beam's light! I bet it rang like a bell!

  • －
    amethystResidentFeatHaloB

    Your beam-touched {{fish}}! I heard it from here. Ding!

  • －
    amethystResidentFeatHiddenWater

    You found the crack past my spires? That's my secret echo spot! Hellooo!

  • －
    amethystResidentFeatGoldFishA

    A Gold {{fish}}? Wow! That needs a fanfare. Ta-da-daaa!

  • －
    amethystResidentFeatGoldFishB

    I heard about your Gold {{fish}}. That's pitch perfect, that is!

  • －
    moonwellResidentReturnerNoteTitle

    From Hesper

  • －
    moonwellResidentReturnerTrinketA

    Hesper's lost moon locket

  • －
    moonwellResidentReturnerTrinketB

    Hesper's lost star hairpin

  • －
    moonwellResidentReturnerThanksA

    My moon locket... {{name}} kept it safe in the dark. Thank you, softly. Here are {{coins}} [[Gold Coin]].

  • －
    moonwellResidentReturnerThanksB

    My star hairpin, home at last. I'll sing {{name}} a lullaby tonight. These {{coins}} [[Gold Coin]] are for you.

  • －
    moonwellResidentFeatPageGold

    Softly now... every Moonwell fish in your Reach Log has a Gold mark. They're dreaming of you.

  • －
    moonwellResidentFeatReturner

    That great {{fish}} you hooked... the old fish whisper about it in their sleep.

  • －
    moonwellResidentFeatHaloA

    Your {{fish}} rose in the beam's light... like the moon on the water.

  • －
    moonwellResidentFeatHaloB

  • －

    Someone ordered 8 sparkly fish! Polarflash Electrons [[Polarflash Electron]] or Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]], please. Do they glow like the blooms, do you think?

  • －

    12 Glacial Lanternfish [[Glacial Lanternfish]] or Frozen Grenadiers [[Frozen Grenadier]] for the Ledger! I bet the lanternfish shine like the blooms.

  • －
    questLedgerIcefishMoonfishDelivery

  • －
    questLedgerErrandShallows

    Cast off the harbour jetty into the Shallows. Any mix of the fish on the order counts!

  • －
    questLedgerErrandLagoon

    Fish the lagoon around the Lamp. Any mix of the fish on the order counts!

  • －
    questLedgerErrandKelpwood

    Fish the water at Kelpwood. Any mix of the fish on the order counts!

  • －
    questLedgerErrandAmethyst

    Fish the Amethyst shoals. Any mix of the fish on the order counts!

  • －
    questLedgerErrandMoonwell

    Fish the Moonwell's icy water. Any mix of the fish on the order counts!

  • －
    questLedgerHandIn

    Bring the catch back to me at the harbour for the Ledger!

  • －
    questLedgerReminder

    {{remaining}} more to go for the Ledger! Good luck out there!

  • －
    questLedgerHarbourCompleted

    Order filled! Here's your pay, and a Glowtide Flare. Hold it up over the water and a bloom of your very own will rise. I've never seen one up close, so tell me everything!

  • －
    questLedgerKelpwoodCompleted

    Another order filled! Two Glowtide Flares for you. Is a bloom warm when you fish in it? I've always wondered.

  • －
    questLedgerAmethystCompleted

    The Amethyst orders are my favourite! Two Glowtide Flares for you. I wonder what colour a bloom is out there.

  • －
    questLedgerMoonwellCompleted

    The Moonwell order, filled! Three Glowtide Flares, since it's so cold out there. Light one for me!

  • －
    questLedgerDone

    Every order's filled for today! The Ledger turns a fresh page tomorrow.

  • －
    ashhornNothingToDo

    I keep a fire lit at the gate for our missing mage. May it bring them home.

  • －
    ashhornQuestGreeting

    Welcome, traveller. Rest a while in the shade.

  • －
    ashhornInventoryFull

    Your pack is full, traveller. Make room first.

  • －
    questMissingMageName

    What Ward Saw

  • －
    questMissingMageDescription

    A mage from Maverick's guild came to us to study the desert's sacred fire, and has not come back. Ward keeps watch at our gate. Go and ask her what she saw.

  • －
    questMissingMageWarden

    Speak to Ward at the outpost gate

  • －
    questMissingMageWardenDescription

    Walk north up the street to the outpost gate and ask Ward what she saw.

  • －
    sableNothingToDo

    The mage? Went north, towards the volcano, and never came back. Quiet out there since. I don't trust it.

  • －
    sableQuestGreeting

    Keep your voice down. Sound carries on the plains.

  • －
    sableInventoryFull

    Your pack's full. Clear some room and come back.

  • －
    questEldersBonesName

    Bones for the Elder

  • －
    questEldersBonesDescription

    The fire mage walked out through this gate towards the volcano and never came back. No ordinary armour survives that heat, but the old Magmaward does. The skeletons on the plains carry bones baked hard by the desert fire. Bring Elder Ashborn 40 Bones [[Bone]] and he will forge you its helmet.

  • －
    questEldersBonesErrand

    Defeat the skeletons on the plains outside the outpost gate and gather 40 Bones [[Bone]] for Elder Ashborn at the outpost.

  • －
    questEldersBonesCollect

    Gather 40 Bones [[Bone]] from the plains' skeletons

  • －
    questEldersBonesDelivery

    Bring Elder Ashborn 40 Bones [[Bone]]

  • －
    questEldersBonesHandIn

    Bring the 40 Bones [[Bone]] to Elder Ashborn at the outpost. His forge will be hot when you arrive.

  • －
    questEldersBonesCollectReminder

    {{remaining}} more Bones [[Bone]]. The skeletons are out on the plains, past the guards. Watch their arrows.

  • －
    questEldersBonesReminder

    {{remaining}} more Bones [[Bone]], traveller. The skeletons on the plains have plenty to spare.

  • －
    questEldersBonesCompleted

    Hold still... There. A Magmaward Helmet, forged the old way, the first piece of its set. The others went out beyond the plains long ago, each to a keeper who makes you earn it.

  • －
    kadeNothingToDo

    The tower's quiet. That's never good.

  • －
    kadeQuestGreeting

    Climbing, or just looking?

  • －
    kadeInventoryFull

    Your pack's full. Empty it before you climb.

  • －
    grizzlefuseNothingToDo

    Hear that? That's the sound of nothing exploding. Tragic!

  • －
    grizzlefuseQuestGreeting

    A visitor! Mind the powder, spotter!

  • －
    grizzlefuseInventoryFull

    Your pack's stuffed, spotter! Make room, then come back!

  • －
    flintNothingToDo

    Wind's dropped. Perfect shooting weather.

  • －
    flintQuestGreeting

    Steady hands? Good. Come in.

  • －
    flintInventoryFull

    Your pack's full. Clear some space first.

  • －
    mobDoomWarlord

    Doom Warlord

  • －
    doomWarlordTauntLaugh

    Ha! Ha! Ha!

  • －
    doomWarlordTauntTimeUp

    Your time is up!

  • －
    doomWarlordTauntAllYouGot

    Is that all you've got?

  • －
    doomWarlordTauntKneel

    Kneel before the Warlord!

  • －
    doomWarlordTauntGlass

    Hold still. You'll look lovely behind glass!

  • －
    doomWarlordTauntCollection

    Another piece for my collection!

  • －
    doomWarlordTauntHeat

    Feel the heat!

  • －
    doomWarlordTauntBurn

    Ha! Ha! Ha! Burn!

  • －
    doomWarlordTauntDance

    Dance for me!

  • －
    doomWarlordTauntWard

    Enough! Your time is up!

  • －
    doomWarlordTauntUnwarded

    Ha! Ha! Ha! Now we fight!

  • －
    questMagmawardDescription

    The rest of the Magmaward is out beyond the plains. Kade keeps watch at the Tower of Doom, Grizzlefuse holds the fort above the Scorp Pit, Flint runs the Shooting Gallery in the lava basin, and Mortimus keeps the Shuffling Crypt by the Ashen Fort. Each keeps a piece. Win any you are missing, then come back to me.

  • －
    questMagmawardPlateDescription

    Cross the bridge east of the plains to the Tower of Doom. Kade waits at its door.

  • －
    questMagmawardReportDescription

    You hold every piece the lands could give. Bring them back to Elder Ashborn at the outpost.

  • －
    questMagmawardCompleted

    Every piece, earned. Wear all five and the armour burns Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] to keep the lava off you, one flask at a time. Ward, Kade, Grizzlefuse, Flint and Mortimus each have a flask for you now. Then hear me out about that volcano.

  • －
    questMagmawardName

    The Magmaward

  • －
    questMagmawardPlate

    Win the Magmaward Chestplate at Kade's Tower of Doom

  • －
    questMagmawardReport

    Return to Elder Ashborn

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomDescription

    See that roof? The Doom Warlord took my tower, and it wears the Magmaward Chestplate. Every floor is held by its retinue: squires, brutes and curators, and their seals keep the way to the roof shut. Beat one of each on your way up.

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomSquireDescription

    Cinder Squires hold the Tower of Doom's ground hall. When one lifts its burning hammer, step out of the ring before it comes down, and keep out of the fire it leaves.

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomBruteDescription

    A Gauntlet Brute waits on the mezzanine above the Tower of Doom's hall. When it claps, jump the shockwave as it rolls across the floor.

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomCuratorDescription

    Glass Curators keep the Tower of Doom's library, further up. If one shuts you in a glass case, hit the glass to break out.

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomClimbDescription

    The seals are broken. Climb the rest of the stairs to Holt in the wizard room, beside the grey portal to the roof.

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomRoofDescription

    Take the red portal beside Holt up to the roof and defeat the Doom Warlord.

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomReportDescription

    The Warlord is down! Go back to Holt in the Tower of Doom's wizard room. The roof's portal takes you straight to him.

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomCompleted

    Back in one piece, and with the Warlord's own Chestplate. Not many walk off that roof. The Warlord'll be back up there by tomorrow, mind. It always is.

  • －
    questDailyTowerDescription

    The Doom Warlord's back on my roof. It always comes back. Climb up and knock it down again.

  • －
    questDailyTowerClimbDescription

    Climb the Tower of Doom, or Holt's rope if it's yours, and take the red portal beside Holt up to the roof. Defeat the Doom Warlord.

  • －
    questDailyTowerReportDescription

    Down it goes again! Take the roof's portal back down and tell Kade at the tower door.

  • －
    questDailyTowerCompleted

    Good. That holds it for a day. Same again tomorrow?

  • －
    questDailyTowerDone

    You've done your climb for today. The Warlord's still licking its wounds.

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomName

    The Tower of Doom

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomClimb

    Defeat the Doom Warlord on the Tower of Doom's roof

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomSquire

    Defeat a Cinder Squire

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomBrute

    Defeat a Gauntlet Brute

  • －

    Defeat a Glass Curator

    questTowerOfDoomMeetHolt

    Climb the Tower of Doom to Holt in the wizard room

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomReport

    Return to Kade at the Tower of Doom

  • －
    questTowerOfDoomReportHolt

    Return to Holt in the wizard room

  • －
    questDailyTowerName

    Back on the Roof

    Climb Up to Holt

  • －
    towerRopeDownPrompt

    Climb Down to Kade

  • －
    holtNothingToDo

    Roof's through that portal. I'll mind the stairs.

  • －
    holtQuestGreeting

    Over here. A word, if you've a moment.

  • －
    holtSealsFirst

    Not so fast. You've left some of the Warlord's guards standing below. Beat them first, then come back up.

  • －
    holtInventoryFull

    Your pack's full. Clear some room first.

  • －
    holtTowerCheckpoint

    There you are. The seals are broken, so this portal behind me takes you to the roof. The Doom Warlord's waiting up there.

  • －
    questHoltsRopeName

    Holt's Rope

  • －
    questHoltsRopeDescription

    Those stairs are a long walk. I gave up on them, and nobody should have to do them twice. I'll pin a rope from up here to Kade's door, but rope needs rivets. The Warlord's guards on the stairs are full of Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]. Bring me 20.

  • －
    questHoltsRopeRivetsCollect

    Collect 20 Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]

  • －
    questHoltsRopeRivetsErrand

    Defeat the Warlord's guards on the Tower of Doom's stairs for Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]. Collect 20.

  • －
    questHoltsRopeRivetsDelivery

    Bring Holt 20 Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]

  • －
    questHoltsRopeRivetsHandIn

    Bring Holt the 20 Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]] in the Tower of Doom's wizard room.

  • －
    questHoltsRopeRivetsReminder

    {{remaining}} more Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]] and the rope holds.

  • －
    questHoltsRopeRivetsTurnIn

    That'll pin it. Now, my fee: one Doom Crest [[Doom Crest]]. The Warlord dropped you one, didn't it?

  • －
    questHoltsRopeCrestCollect

    Get a Doom Crest [[Doom Crest]]

  • －
    questHoltsRopeCrestErrand

    Get a Doom Crest [[Doom Crest]] for Holt. Spent the one the Doom Warlord dropped? Defeat it again; its spoils can hold another.

  • －
    questHoltsRopeCrestDelivery

    Bring Holt a Doom Crest [[Doom Crest]]

  • －
    questHoltsRopeCrestHandIn

    Bring Holt the Doom Crest [[Doom Crest]] in the Tower of Doom's wizard room.

  • －
    questHoltsRopeCrestReminder

    Still {{remaining}} Doom Crest [[Doom Crest]] short. Fair's fair.

  • －
    questHoltsRopeCompleted

    Pleasure doing business. The rope's hung beside Kade's door. Give it a tug and up you come, straight to me, no stairs.

  • －
    questWordOfATraderName

    Word of a Trader

  • －
    questWordOfATraderDescription

    Rope's yours, so here's something for nothing. Climbers talk of a trader out at the edge of the world who sells things you won't find anywhere else. Word is, one of this tower's windows lets out that way. Have a look on your way down.

  • －
    questWordOfATraderWindow

    Find the window out of the Tower of Doom

  • －
    questWordOfATraderWindowDescription

    One of the Tower of Doom's windows, a few floors up, has a way out. Look around for it.

  • －
    questWordOfATraderSmuglyn

    Find Smuglyn, the trader at the edge of the world

  • －
    questWordOfATraderSmuglynDescription

    The way out leads to the edge of the world. Find Smuglyn and see what he sells.

  • －
    questWordOfATraderCompleted

    Ah, someone who knows the back way in. Here, 5 Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]] on the house, to start you off. My wares change every day. Do take a look.

  • －

    Crypt Dread

    cryptShifting

    cryptEscaped

    You escaped the crypt in {{time}}!

  • －
    questMagmawardGauntletsDescription

    Cross the bridge east of the plains to the Scorp Pit. Grizzlefuse holds the fort on its south lip.

  • －
    questMagmawardGauntlets

    Win the Magmaward Gauntlets from Grizzlefuse at the Scorp Pit

  • －
    questScorpPitDescription

    Spotter! After the MAGMAWARD GAUNTLETS? They're mine to give! Earn 'em! The pit's crawling with scorpions. Take these Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]]: chuck one in and my mortar does the rest. BOOM! Thin out 50 for me!

  • －
    questScorpPitHuntDescription

    Throw a Mortar Strike [[Red Firecracker Pebble]] into the Scorp Pit to bring Grizzlefuse's mortar down on it, or fight with your own weapon. Defeat 50 scorpions.

  • －
    questScorpPitReportDescription

    That's 50! Step on the grey portal in the pit's floor to get back up to the fort, and tell Grizzlefuse.

  • －
    questScorpPitCompleted

    KA-BOOM! Did you see 'em fly? Beautiful! Here, spotter: the Magmaward Gauntlets. Dug 'em out of the pit after a big one. Still warm! And take these Interdimensional Mortar Strikes [[Purple Firecracker Pebble]]. Throw one anywhere, ANYWHERE, and my shells come raining down through a rift right over it!

  • －
    questDailyScorpDescription

    They've bred back, spotter! Fresh Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]], same job. You mark 'em, I shell 'em!

  • －
    questDailyScorpHuntDescription

    Defeat 10 scorpions in the Scorp Pit, with Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]] or your own weapon.

  • －
    questDailyScorpReportDescription

    Pit's thinned! Take the grey portal in the pit's floor back up and tell Grizzlefuse.

  • －
    questDailyScorpCompleted

    Ha ha! Lovely shooting, spotter. Here, more Interdimensional Mortar Strikes [[Purple Firecracker Pebble]]. Same again?

  • －
    questScorpPitName

    The Scorp Pit

  • －
    questScorpPitHunt

    Defeat 50 scorpions in the Scorp Pit

  • －
    questDailyScorpHunt

    Defeat 10 scorpions in the Scorp Pit

  • －
    questGrizzlefuseFuelName

    The Pit's Flask

  • －
    questGrizzlefuseFuelDescription

    Spotter! Those thieving scorpions nicked my Splash Poison Potions [[Splash Poison Potion]] and buried 'em in their egg piles! Find me 5 and my spare Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] is yours. Deal? DEAL!

  • －
    questGrizzlefuseFuelFind

    Find 5 Splash Poison Potions [[Splash Poison Potion]] in the Scorp Pit's egg piles

  • －
    questGrizzlefuseFuelFindDescription

    Jump down into the Scorp Pit and dig a whole stack of eggs out of its big egg piles. Green bubbles rise off each pile that still hides a Splash Poison Potion [[Splash Poison Potion]] at its bottom. Find 5.

  • －
    questGrizzlefuseFuelReportDescription

    That's 5! Take the grey portal in the pit's floor back up to the fort, and tell Grizzlefuse.

  • －
    questGrizzlefuseFuelCompleted

    All 5 found? Ha ha! Those scorpions'll be fuming! Here, spotter: one Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. Wear the whole set and it burns up the second lava touches you. FWOOSH!

  • －
    questScorpPitReport

    Return to Grizzlefuse at his fort

  • －
    questDailyScorpName

    Fresh Scorpions

  • －
    questWardFuelName

    Ward's Spare Flask

  • －
    questWardFuelDescription

    The Magmaward burns Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]], one flask for every lick of lava it keeps off you. I keep a spare at the gate. Bring me 30 Bones [[Bone]] off the plains' skeletons and it's yours.

  • －
    questWardFuelErrand

    Defeat the skeletons on the plains outside the outpost gate and gather 30 Bones [[Bone]] for Ward.

  • －
    questWardFuelCollect

    Gather 30 Bones [[Bone]] from the plains' skeletons

  • －
    questWardFuelDelivery

    Bring Ward 30 Bones [[Bone]]

  • －
    questWardFuelHandIn

    Bring the 30 Bones [[Bone]] back to Ward at the outpost gate.

  • －
    questWardFuelCollectReminder

    {{remaining}} more Bones [[Bone]]. Out past the guards, and mind their arrows.

  • －
    questWardFuelReminder

    {{remaining}} more Bones [[Bone]], then the flask is yours.

  • －
    questWardFuelCompleted

    Good haul. Here's the flask: one Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. Wear the whole set and it burns the moment lava touches you. Don't waste it on a swim.

  • －
    questKadeFuelName

    Kade's Flask

  • －
    questKadeFuelDescription

    You'll want Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] for that armour. I have one flask. Earn it. The Warlord's retinue keeps crawling back into my tower. Put down 15 of them.

  • －
    questKadeFuelHunt

    Defeat 15 of the Warlord's retinue in the Tower of Doom

  • －
    questKadeFuelHuntDescription

    Climb the Tower of Doom and defeat 15 of the Doom Warlord's retinue: Cinder Squires, Gauntlet Brutes or Glass Curators.

  • －
    questKadeFuelReport

    Return to Kade

  • －
    questKadeFuelReportDescription

    Head back down to Kade at the Tower of Doom's door.

  • －
    questKadeFuelCompleted

    Fifteen. Good. Here. One Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. Burn it well.

  • －
    questMortimusFuelName

    The Keeper's Flask

  • －
    questMortimusFuelDescription

    The crypt's Mummies wake restless, and the crypt grows uneasy with them. Lay 10 of them back to rest, and I shall part with a flask of Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] I have kept for longer than you would believe.

  • －
    questMortimusFuelHunt

    Defeat 10 Mummies in the Shuffling Crypt

  • －
    questMortimusFuelHuntDescription

    Speak to Mortimus to go down into the Shuffling Crypt, and defeat 10 Mummies as they climb out of its floors.

  • －
    questMortimusFuelReport

    Return to Mortimus

  • －
    questMortimusFuelReportDescription

    Return to Mortimus in the crypt's hall.

  • －
    questMortimusFuelCompleted

    The crypt sleeps easier. As promised: one Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. It burned in these halls before your outpost had a gate.

  • －
    magmawardFuelBurned

    Burn blocked! {{fuel}} fuel left

  • －
    magmawardFuelLast

    Burn blocked! That was your last fuel!

  • －
    magmawardFuelEmpty

    Out of Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]! The lava burns!

  • －

    Wear all 5 pieces to block lava ({{worn}}/5)

  • －
    magmawardHudNoFuel

    No fuel: lava will burn you

  • －
    volcanoTooHot

    The heat throws you back out! Wear the full Magmaward to survive Cinderfall's crater.

  • －
    questIntoCinderfallDescription

    Our mage was headed for Cinderfall, the volcano north of the plains. Put on every piece of the Magmaward and jump into its crater. Its fire cannot burn you then, but the lava below will once your Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] runs out. Go, traveller. Find our mage.

  • －
    questIntoCinderfallJumpDescription

    Climb Cinderfall, north of the plains, to the lookout on its crater's rim. Wear all five Magmaward pieces, then jump in.

  • －
    questIntoCinderfallMageDescription

    Find Ember, the fire mage from Maverick's guild, in the Molten Rift below Cinderfall's crater.

  • －
    questIntoCinderfallName

    Into Cinderfall

  • －
    questIntoCinderfallJump

    Jump into Cinderfall's crater wearing the full Magmaward

  • －
    questIntoCinderfallMage

    Find Ember in the Molten Rift

  • －
    ignusNothingToDo

    The crack is quiet. I'll keep an eye on it.

  • －
    ignusQuestGreeting

    Mind the edge. That isn't water down there.

  • －
    ignusInventoryFull

    Your pack's full. Make some room, then come back to me.

  • －
    outpostGuardNothingToDo

    Eyes on the plains. The Warden's orders.

  • －
    outpostGuardQuestGreeting

    Traveller. Mind the road out there.

  • －
    mortimusNothingToDo

    The crypt is stirring, and will not take you yet. Ask me again in a moment, traveller.

  • －
    mortimusQuestGreeting

    Another traveller. The crypt has been expecting you.

  • －
    mortimusInventoryFull

    Your pack is full, traveller. Make some room, then come back to me.

  • －
    mortimusIncantation

    Vesh nakhu, oru semet... Khaba telluret, an sheru dav!

  • －
    questShufflingCryptName

    The Shuffling Crypt

  • －
    questShufflingCryptDescription

    Beneath us lies the Shuffling Crypt. In the vault at its far end rest the Magmaward Boots, and they are yours if you can reach them. Speak to me when you are ready, and I will send you down.

  • －
    questShufflingCryptEscape

    Claim the Magmaward Boots from the Shuffling Crypt's vault

  • －
    questShufflingCryptEscapeDescription

    Speak to me, and I will send you down. The rooms will shift to lose you, so follow my ghostly fennec to the vault at the far end. The Boots wait there.

  • －
    questDailyCryptName

    The Crypt Stirs

  • －
    questDailyCryptDescription

    The crypt has shifted in the night, and its vault holds fresh spoils. Speak to me when you are ready, traveller, and I will send you down to claim them.

  • －
    questDailyCryptEscape

    Claim the spoils from the Shuffling Crypt's vault

  • －
    questDailyCryptEscapeDescription

    Speak to me, and I will send you down. Follow my ghostly fennec through the shifting rooms to the vault, and claim what waits there.

  • －
    questDailyCryptReport

    Return to Mortimus

  • －
    questDailyCryptReportDescription

    The crypt has let you go. Return to Mortimus in its hall.

  • －
    questDailyCryptCompleted

    You walked out of the dark once more. By tomorrow, the crypt will have shifted again.

  • －
    questDailyCryptDone

    You have done what I asked of you today, traveller. The crypt is stirring, but ask me again in a moment and I will send you down once more.

  • －
    questSlayVulcanDescription

    You came through the fire? I'm Ember. I felt a crack open in the world and followed it down. It's Lord Vulcan's doing, a wizard gone bad. He's been tearing it open from his tower at the bottom of the rift, and my fire only feeds him. His spells come in time, like a drum. Learn the beat and you can beat him. Bring friends if you can.

  • －
    questSlayVulcanFightDescription

    Defeat Lord Vulcan in the ring at the bottom of the Molten Rift. His big spells come in time: step with the beat, or get out of the ring until they pass. Anyone fighting him beside you shares the win.

  • －
    questSlayVulcanReportDescription

    Lord Vulcan is beaten! Tell Ember at the rift's southern edge.

  • －
    questSlayVulcanCompleted

    You did it! Lord Vulcan is beaten, and the crack has gone quiet. But it isn't the only one. More are opening all over the land, and he wasn't working alone. When the next one opens, I'll need you again.

  • －
    questSlayVulcanName

    Lord Vulcan

  • －
    questSlayVulcanFight

    Defeat Lord Vulcan in the Molten Rift

  • －
    questSlayVulcanReport

    Return to Ember

  • －

    Kneel, and I may let you watch the world burn.

  • －
    lordVulcanTauntTower

    You stand in my tower now.

  • －
    lordVulcanTauntPatience

    Patience. The fire always comes.

  • －

  • －

    Enough! Behold my true power!

  • －

    You think you've hurt me? I've only begun!

  • －

    Keep time, little one!

  • －

    In, out, in, out!

  • －

    Let the world split open!

  • －

  • －

    Find the light, if you can!

  • －

    Nowhere to hide!

  • －

    Trades rare goods for Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]

  • －

  • －
    questMagmawardGreavesDescription

    Follow the skull's tunnel west of the plains to the Shooting Gallery in the lava basin. Flint keeps the booth there.

  • －
    questMagmawardGreaves

    Win the Magmaward Leggings from Flint at the Shooting Gallery

  • －
    questMagmawardTreadsDescription

    Head north-west of the plains to the Ashen Fort. Mortimus keeps the Shuffling Crypt there.

  • －
    questMagmawardTreads

    Win the Magmaward Boots from Mortimus at the Shuffling Crypt

  • －
    questShootingGalleryDescription

    I keep the Magmaward Leggings, old armour made for wading through lava. Earn them the way I did, starting small. Magma Golems climb those ribs out there. Take these 25 Pebbles [[Pebble]] and knock 3 of them into the lava.

  • －
    questShootingGalleryPebblesDescription

    Throw Pebbles [[Pebble]] at the Magma Golems standing on the ends of the skeleton's ribs in the lava basin. Knock 3 of them off. Run out? Flint has more.

  • －
    questShootingGalleryShootDescription

    Flint's Gallery Bow and Arrows [[Arrow]] are yours now. Shoot the Magma Golems on the skeleton's ribs and knock 6 of them off. Lost the bow? Flint has another.

  • －
    questShootingGalleryPunchDescription

    Throw a Fireball [[Fireball]] at your feet to blast yourself up onto one of the skeleton's ribs, then knock 3 Magma Golems off up close, with your fists or a sword. Every golem that falls drops Fireballs [[Fireball]].

  • －
    questShootingGalleryReportDescription

    Three rounds, three ways. Head back to Flint in her booth at the end of the skull's tunnel.

  • －
    questShootingGalleryCompleted

    Up on the ribs, toe to toe with them. Bold. The Magmaward Leggings are yours. They've waded through that lava more times than I can count.

  • －
    questDailyGalleryDescription

    The golems are back on the ribs. Fresh Arrows [[Arrow]], same targets. Let's see if you've gone rusty.

  • －
    questDailyGalleryShootDescription

    Knock 6 Magma Golems off the skeleton's ribs in the lava basin, by shot, throw or punch. Lost Flint's Gallery Bow? She has another.

  • －
    questDailyGalleryReportDescription

    That's six. Tell Flint in her booth.

  • －
    questDailyGalleryCompleted

    Not bad at all. Same time tomorrow.

  • －
    questDailyGalleryDone

    That's your practice done for today. Rest your arm.

  • －
    questShootingGalleryName

    The Shooting Gallery

  • －
    questShootingGalleryShoot

    Knock 6 Magma Golems off the skeleton's ribs

  • －
    questShootingGalleryPebbles

    Knock 3 Magma Golems off with Pebbles [[Pebble]]

  • －
    questShootingGalleryArrows

    Knock 6 Magma Golems off with Arrows [[Arrow]]

  • －
    questShootingGalleryPunch

    Blast up onto a rib and knock 3 Magma Golems off up close

  • －
    questShootingGalleryReport

    Return to Flint at the Shooting Gallery

  • －
    questDailyGalleryName

    Target Practice

  • －
    questGalleryFuelName

    Fireballs for Fuel

  • －
    questGalleryFuelDescription

    Those golems drop Fireballs [[Fireball]] when they fall. Bring me 50 and I'll trade you a flask of Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. I've one to spare each day.

  • －
    questGalleryFuelErrand

    Knock Magma Golems off the skeleton's ribs in the lava basin and gather 50 Fireballs [[Fireball]] from them for Flint.

  • －
    questGalleryFuelCollect

    Gather 50 Fireballs [[Fireball]]

  • －
    questGalleryFuelDelivery

    Bring Flint 50 Fireballs [[Fireball]]

  • －
    questGalleryFuelHandIn

    Bring the 50 Fireballs [[Fireball]] back to Flint in her booth at the end of the skull's tunnel.

  • －
    questGalleryFuelCollectReminder

    {{remaining}} more Fireballs [[Fireball]]. The golems carry them, so knock a few more off.

  • －
    questGalleryFuelReminder

    {{remaining}} more Fireballs [[Fireball]], then the flask's yours.

  • －
    questGalleryFuelCompleted

    Fifty, and not one gone off in your pack. Here's your flask: one Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]].

  • －
    questGalleryFuelDone

    That's today's flask gone. Bring more Fireballs [[Fireball]] tomorrow.

  • －
    questGlassBroProteinName

    Hit the Protein

  • －
    questGlassBroProteinDescription

    Bro, I haven't hit my protein in days. I'd go get some, but everything out there wants to eat me. Bring me 100 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]]? I'll make it worth it, bro.

  • －
    questGlassBroProteinErrand

    Feed the Cows in Snoutmeadow 1 Wheat [[Wheat]] and 1 Melon Slice [[Melon Slice]] for each Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] until you have 100. Wheat [[Wheat]] grows in the hub's fields, and Melons [[Melon]] at Meloncloak Grove.

  • －
    questGlassBroProteinCollect

    Collect 100 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]]

  • －
    questGlassBroProteinDelivery

    Bring Glass Bro 100 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]]

  • －
    questGlassBroProteinHandIn

    Bring the 100 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] up to Glass Bro, hiding in the notch on Cinderfall's north face.

  • －
    questGlassBroProteinCollectReminder

    {{remaining}} more Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]], bro. My gains are wasting away up here.

  • －
    questGlassBroProteinReminder

    {{remaining}} more Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]], bro. So close to hitting my protein.

  • －
    questGlassBroProteinCompleted

    A hundred? Bro. That's a whole day of protein. You're a legend, and you didn't even get eaten.

  • －
    questGlassBroProteinDone

    Protein's hit for today, bro. Same again tomorrow? Watch out for the scorpions.

  • －
    questProveYourselfName

    Prove Yourself

  • －
    questProveYourselfDescription

    Nobody gets past my ward without my mark. Show me you can handle a pickaxe and you'll earn it. Bring me 50 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]], from iron mined out here.

  • －
    questProveYourselfIronCollect

    Smelt 50 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]

  • －
    questProveYourselfIronDelivery

    Bring Elder Crag 50 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]

  • －
    questProveYourselfIronGather

    Smelt that Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]] into 50 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] with 50 Coal [[Coal]] in the Furnace [[Furnace]] by my door.

  • －
    questProveYourselfIronHandIn

    Let's see those Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]], then.

  • －
    questProveYourselfIronReminder

    {{remaining}} more Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]. I can count, human.

  • －
    questProveYourselfIronMineName

    Mine 50 Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]]

  • －
    questProveYourselfIronMine

    Break Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] in the cavern west of my door until you've got 50 Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]]. Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] you already have count too.

  • －
    questProveYourselfIronMineReminder

    {{remaining}} more Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]]. Keep digging, human.

  • －
    questProveYourselfIronCompleted

    Hm. Not bad. Now 50 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]]. Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] is harder to find and harder to break.

  • －
    questProveYourselfGoldCollect

    Mine 50 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]]

  • －
    questProveYourselfGoldDelivery

    Bring Elder Crag 50 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]]

  • －
    questProveYourselfGoldGather

    Mine 50 Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] outside the mine and bring me the Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]].

  • －
    questProveYourselfGoldHandIn

    Hand over the Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]].

  • －
    questProveYourselfGoldReminder

    {{remaining}} more Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]]. Keep at it.

  • －
    questProveYourselfCompleted

    Fine. You've a miner's arms, if not a miner's beard. Hold still. There: my mark. The ward will let you through now. Don't make me regret it.

  • －
    drillboNothingToDo

    Hear her purr? Best drill in the deep, on the finest gold vein in the mountain!

  • －
    drillboNotYet

    Ho there, friend! Has Elder Crag sent you? He likes to know who's poking about his mine. Go and see him at the door first!

  • －
    drillboQuestGreeting

    Ho there, friend! Come and see my gold vein!

  • －
    drillboInventoryFull

    Your pockets are fuller than my vein! Make some room, then come back.

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldName

    Heart of Gold

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldDescription

    Oh, a helping hand! The meteor cracked my drill's engine clean through, and I can't leave my lovely gold vein to fetch parts. Gather 16 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] and 8 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] and we'll build her a new heart. Only the finest gold for my girl!

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldGoldCollect

    Gather 16 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldGold

    Gather 16 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] for the engine's golden heart.

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldIronCollect

    Gather 8 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldIron

    Gather 8 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] for the engine's casing.

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldCraftName

    Craft a Goldheart Engine [[Goldheart Engine]] at a Workbench

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldCraft

    Craft a Goldheart Engine [[Goldheart Engine]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]] from your Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] and Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]].

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldDelivery

    Bring the Goldheart Engine [[Goldheart Engine]] to Gabbro

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldDeliver

    Bring the Goldheart Engine [[Goldheart Engine]] to Gabbro at his gold vein.

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldReminder

    Still waiting on {{remaining}} Goldheart Engine [[Goldheart Engine]]! My poor drill's pining for her heart.

  • －
    questHeartOfGoldCompleted

    Would you look at that! Gold right through her heart, just like my vein. She'll purr now, but she still can't bite.

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepName

    A Bite of the Deep

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepDescription

    An engine's no use without teeth! The meteor knocked my old drill tip as blunt as a spoon. Gather 24 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] and 8 Coal [[Coal]] and we'll give her a bite again.

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepIronCollect

    Gather 24 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepIron

    Gather 24 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] for the drill tip.

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepCoalCollect

    Gather 8 Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepCoal

    Gather 8 Coal [[Coal]] to harden the drill tip's point.

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepCraftName

    Craft a Deepbite Drill Tip [[Deepbite Drill Tip]] at a Workbench

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepCraft

    Craft a Deepbite Drill Tip [[Deepbite Drill Tip]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]] from your Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] and Coal [[Coal]].

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepDelivery

    Bring the Deepbite Drill Tip [[Deepbite Drill Tip]] to Gabbro

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepDeliver

    Bring the Deepbite Drill Tip [[Deepbite Drill Tip]] to Gabbro at his gold vein.

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepReminder

    Still waiting on {{remaining}} Deepbite Drill Tip [[Deepbite Drill Tip]]! She can't chew rock with her gums.

  • －
    questBiteOfTheDeepCompleted

    Sharp as a dragon's tooth! Now all she needs is something to eat.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireName

    Fuel for the Fire

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireDescription

    One more thing! She runs on a fuel cell, and hers cracked when the meteor hit. Gather 12 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] and 4 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] for a new one. Gold seals it tight, you see!

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireIronCollect

    Gather 12 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireIron

    Gather 12 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] for the fuel cell's casing.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireGoldCollect

    Gather 4 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireGold

    Gather 4 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to seal the fuel cell.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCraftName

    Craft an Empty Fuel Cell [[Empty Fuel Cell]] at a Workbench

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCraft

    Craft an Empty Fuel Cell [[Empty Fuel Cell]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]] from your Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] and Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]].

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCoalCollect

    Gather 25 Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCoal

    Only Old Smudge can pack a fuel cell without it going bang. Gather 25 Coal [[Coal]] for him to pack it with. He works the top of the coal quarry in the entrance yard.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCoalGatherReminder

    Old Smudge won't budge without coal! Gather {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]] for him.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCoalDelivery

    Give Old Smudge 25 Coal [[Coal]]

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCoalHandIn

    Give Old Smudge 25 Coal [[Coal]] at the top of the coal quarry.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCoalTurnIn

    Good coal. That'll do.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCoalReminder

    {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]]. Then we talk.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCellDelivery

    Give Old Smudge the Empty Fuel Cell [[Empty Fuel Cell]]

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCellHandIn

    Give Old Smudge your Empty Fuel Cell [[Empty Fuel Cell]] at the top of the coal quarry.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCellTurnIn

    Decent casing. Gabbro's gold, I'd wager.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCellReminder

    {{remaining}} Empty Fuel Cell [[Empty Fuel Cell]]. Can't fill what isn't there.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireFillName

    Have Old Smudge fill the fuel cell

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireFill

    Talk to Old Smudge so he can pack the fuel cell with coal.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireFilled

    Packed in. Lid on. There. Don't drop it, and don't sneeze on it.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireDelivery

    Bring the Blackfire Fuel Cell [[Blackfire Fuel Cell]] to Gabbro

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireDeliver

    Bring the Blackfire Fuel Cell [[Blackfire Fuel Cell]] to Gabbro at his gold vein. Lost it? Old Smudge left Gabbro a spare.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireReminder

    Just {{remaining}} Blackfire Fuel Cell [[Blackfire Fuel Cell]] and she'll roar again! Careful, now, it's hot.

  • －
    questFuelForTheFireCompleted

    Listen to her! Purring like a cat on a pile of gold! You've a miner's heart, friend, and you've earned every bit of your pay.

  • －
    questGoldRushName

    Gold Rush

  • －
    questGoldRushDescription

    She's running again, and she's itching to bite! Climb in and she'll take you past the boards into the gallery behind me, chewing a Gold Fragment [[Gold Fragment]] out of every bit of Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] she passes, and two out of Pure Gold Ore [[Pure Gold Ore]]. Dig up 200 before her fuel runs low, and every 4 after that make a Gold Bar [[Gold Bar]] for you.

  • －
    questGoldRushDriveName

    Dig up 200 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] with Gabbro's drill in 45 seconds

  • －
    questGoldRushDrive

    Climb into the mended drill and she'll take you past the boards into the gallery. Each Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] she mines gives a Gold Fragment [[Gold Fragment]], and each Pure Gold Ore [[Pure Gold Ore]] two. Dig up 200 before the 45 seconds run out. Short of it? Climb in again for another go.

  • －
    questGoldRushReportName

    Keep drilling until the time runs out

  • －
    questGoldRushReport

    That's the 200! Keep her going until the clock stops: every 4 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] past 200 make a Gold Bar [[Gold Bar]] for you. Climbed out? Climb in again.

  • －
    questGoldRushCompleted

    Two hundred Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] in one go! Did you hear her sing? That's the finest run this vein has seen since the meteor. Here's your pay, friend!

  • －
    questGabbroDailyName

    Gabbro's Gold Order

  • －
    questGabbroDailyGold100

    Ho, friend! A buyer up top wants gold today. Take my drill into the gallery and dig me 100 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] in one run. Every 4 past that make a Gold Bar [[Gold Bar]] for you!

  • －
    questGabbroDailyGold100Drive

    Dig up 100 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] with Gabbro's drill in 45 seconds

  • －
    questGabbroDailyGold150

    Busy day, friend! The smiths want 150 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] from my vein. Dig them up in one run of my drill, and every 4 past that make a Gold Bar [[Gold Bar]] for you!

  • －
    questGabbroDailyGold150Drive

    Dig up 150 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] with Gabbro's drill in 45 seconds

  • －
    questGabbroDailyGold200

    Big order today, friend! The jewellers want 200 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]], all in one run of my drill. Every 4 past that make a Gold Bar [[Gold Bar]] for you!

  • －
    questGabbroDailyGold200Drive

    Dig up 200 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] with Gabbro's drill in 45 seconds

  • －
    questGabbroDailyDrive

    Climb into my drill and she'll take you into the gallery. Each Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] she mines gives a Gold Fragment [[Gold Fragment]], and each Pure Gold Ore [[Pure Gold Ore]] two. Dig up today's order before the 45 seconds run out. Short of it? Climb in again for another go.

  • －
    questGabbroDailyReportName

    Drill until the clock stops

  • －
    questGabbroDailyReport

    That's today's order! Keep her going until the clock stops: every 4 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] past the order make a Gold Bar [[Gold Bar]] for you. Climbed out? Climb in again.

  • －
    questGabbroDailyCompleted

    Order filled, and she ran like a dream! Here's your pay, friend.

  • －
    questGabbroDailyDone

    That's today's order filled, friend! Come back tomorrow for the next one. Can't wait that long? Take my drill for a run anyway! The first 160 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] she digs up are my fee, and the rest are yours.

  • －
    goldRushTalkFirst

    Talk to Gabbro about his drill.

  • －
    drillRunGo

    Go! Gabbro's fee is the first {{fee}} Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] you dig up. Every 4 after that make a Gold Bar [[Gold Bar]] for you!

  • －
    drillRunFeeLine

    Gabbro's fee: {{fragments}}/{{fee}}

  • －
    drillRunBarsLine

    Your Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]: {{bars}}

  • －
    drillRunFeeMet

    That's Gabbro's fee of {{fee}}! Every 4 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] from now on make a Gold Bar [[Gold Bar]] for you!

  • －
    drillRunTimeUp

    Time's up!

  • －
    drillRunOver

    Run over!

  • －
    drillRunLeftGallery

    The drill can't go that way!

  • －
    drillRunPaid

    The drill dug up {{fragments}} Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]]. Past Gabbro's fee of {{fee}}, every 4 make a Gold Bar [[Gold Bar]] for you, and any spare count towards your next run.

  • －
    drillRunFeeOnly

    The drill dug up {{fragments}} Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]], just enough for Gabbro's fee.

  • －
    drillRunShort

    The drill dug up {{fragments}} Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]], short of Gabbro's fee of {{fee}}, so there's nothing for you this time.

  • －
    drillRunName

    Gabbro's Drill

  • －
    drillRunDescription

    Dig up all the Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] you can before time runs out. The first {{fee}} are Gabbro's fee, and every 4 after that make a Gold Bar [[Gold Bar]] for you.

  • －
    drillRunMine

    Dig up Gabbro's fee of {{fee}} Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]]

  • －
    drillRunMineDescription

    Drive into the gold. Each Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] gives a Gold Fragment [[Gold Fragment]] and each Pure Gold Ore [[Pure Gold Ore]] two, and past Gabbro's fee every 4 make a Gold Bar [[Gold Bar]] for you when the run ends.

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesName

    Save the Mines

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesDescription

    Swinging a pick doesn't make you one of us, human. I've a broken mine to hold up and no time to mind you. Gabbro, Grubnik, Shale and Dorrik all need a pair of hands. Go and make yourself useful to them.

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesMeetGabbroName

    Talk to Gabbro in the Gilded Gallery

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesMeetGabbro

    Gabbro works the gold vein in the Gilded Gallery. The meteor broke his drill, and he won't stop talking about it. Go and listen.

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesMeetGrubnikName

    Talk to Grubnik by the broken bridge

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesMeetGrubnik

    A goblin called Grubnik has set up by the broken moonstone bridge. I don't trust him, but he wants something doing. Find out what.

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesMeetShaleName

    Talk to Shale at Glimmerdeep Hollow

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesMeetShale

    Shale keeps the golems in Glimmerdeep Hollow, at the very bottom of the mine. See what Shale needs.

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesMeetDorrikName

    Talk to Dorrik in Hearthdeep Village

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesMeetDorrik

    Dorrik is mending Hearthdeep Village by the golden pickaxe statue. The meteor brought half of it down. Go and help him.

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesHelpGabbroName

    Finish Gold Rush for Gabbro

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesHelpGabbro

    Do whatever Gabbro asks until his drill is back at work on his gold. Then I can stop hearing about it.

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesHelpGrubnikName

    Finish Over the Gap for Grubnik

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesHelpGrubnik

    Do Grubnik's job and get his cannons firing. If it gets him out of my hair, so much the better.

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesHelpShaleName

    Finish Shearing by Hand for Shale

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesHelpShale

    Help Shale with the golems until you can shear them by hand. Mind the herd. Shale fusses over them.

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesHelpDorrikName

    Finish Hearthdeep Stands for Dorrik

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesHelpDorrik

    Help Bram, Gilda and Sapphire, then Dorrik, until Hearthdeep stands again. Those are my dwarves down there.

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesReportName

    Return to Elder Crag

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesReport

    Go back to Elder Crag at the mine door.

  • －
    questSaveTheMinesCompleted

    Gabbro's drill is running, Grubnik's cannons are firing, Shale's herd is sheared and Hearthdeep stands again. You did what I hadn't the hands for, and everyone down there speaks well of you. I was wrong about you. Thank you, friend.

  • －
    smudgeQuestGreeting

    Mm. Someone sent you. I can always tell.

  • －

    Hands full. Make room, then take it.

  • －
    goal_smelter

    A Smelter turns Raw Iron into bars by itself, faster than your Furnace.

  • －
    goal_drills

    Craft a Machine Bench to build machines on, then set drills on Coal and Iron.

  • －
    goal_crusher

    A Crusher splits each ore in two before the Smelter, so you get twice the bars.

  • －
    goal_core

    The Core grows your island and opens new machines when you bring it what it asks for.

  • －
    goal_coalBelt

    Belt Coal into your iron line and it fuels itself, so it keeps making bars while you're away.

  • －
    goal_glass

    The Core wants Glass: crush Messy Stone into Sand, then smelt the Sand.

  • －
    goal_copper

    The Core wants Copper Bars, and for now copper only comes from the Wilds below.

  • －
    goal_recallBeacon

    A Recall Beacon takes you home from the Wilds: make one before your first trip down.

  • －
    goal_copperLine

    Tier 2 gave you a Copper Deposit: a copper line keeps copper coming.

  • －
    goal_generator

    Wire Mills, Presses and Recyclers run on power: a Generator burns Coal to make it.

  • －
    goal_wireAndPlates

    Tier 3 wants Copper Wire and Iron Plates from a Wire Mill and a Press, and Motors from the Parts Bench.

  • －
    goal_ruins

    Tier 3 also wants Relay Coils: a Recycler gets them from the Machine Parts in ruin chests in the Wilds.

  • －
    goal_routing

    A Splitter shares one belt between two places: Coal for the Generator, Iron Bars for the Press.

  • －
    goal_steel

    Tier 4 wants a lot of Steel: a coupled Alloy Kiln beside your iron line's Smelter makes it from Iron Grit.

  • －
    goal_logicBoard

    Logic Boards need Gold Plates: build a gold line and press its bars.

  • －
    goal_electricDrill

    An Electric Drill digs twice as fast on power, and a Solar Panel makes power for free.

  • －
    goal_coupler

    A Power Coupler runs a burner on power, twice as fast, but passes no fuel on: couple your iron line's Smelter, then its Crusher.

  • －
    goal_autoBench

    An Assembler crafts by itself: teach it Motors and stop making them by hand.

  • －
    goal_deepWilds

    Tier 4 wants Voltite from deep in the Wilds: a Vein Breaker mines it fast.

  • －
    goal_voltite

    Voltite Cells pack a lot of power, and they start as Voltite from your new deposit.

  • －
    goal_voltEngine

    A Volt Engine burns Voltite Cells for far more power than a Generator; a Charge Vault stores more of it.

  • －
    goal_skyTap

    A Sky Tap brings up Raw Voltite, Raw Gold and Diamonds from the Wilds without a trip down.

  • －
    goal_deepLine

    Tier 5 wants a lot of Steel: a deep line digs and crushes iron much faster, and a Fast Belt keeps up with it.

  • －
    goal_moonstone

    Tier 5 wants Moonstone and Diamonds from the bottom of the Wilds: tunnel along Y −85 with your Ore Lens to find Moonstone.

  • －
    goal_starbore

    The Starbore Drill takes whole veins in one swing: build it from Star Alloy, then dive for more Moonstone.

  • －
    goal_starAlloy

    Every Starwright stage wants Star Alloy: teach an Assembler to make it.

  • －
    goal_crystalVat

    A Crystal Vat grows Moonstone and Diamonds at home, so you can stop diving for them.

  • －
    goal_comet

    Every stage wants Comet Cores, and they only come from comets that fall in the Wilds.

  • －
    goal_vatDiamonds

    Stage 2 wants Diamonds: belt Coal into a second Crystal Vat, so your first keeps growing Moonstone.

  • －
    goal_balancedSplit

    Stage 2's Charge needs 60 Iron Plate a minute: split one belt of bars across 3 Presses, with a wire line beside it.

  • －
    goal_goldTwo

    Stage 3 wants many Logic Boards, so double your Gold Plate.

  • －
    goal_benchRow

    Stage 3's Charge needs 20 Logic Boards a minute: two benches sharing one mixed belt make that.

  • －
    goal_morePower

    Stage 4's Charge draws power every second: engines fed Cells by an Assembler cover it.

  • －
    goal_cellBuffer

    Stage 4's Charge wants Cells at a steady 20 a minute: bank them in a Silo and let a Belt Loader feed the Core.

  • －
    goal_threeLines

    Stage 5's Charge needs three items belted in at once, plus power.

  • －
    goal_powerBudget

    Three lines and a Charge share one power store: make it big enough, and make what the lines use.

  • －
    goal_starForge

    The Star Core lights the Star Forge: fill its orders, each bigger than the last, for rewards.

  • －
    goal_cometShards

    8 Comet Shards make a Comet Core, so you don't need to catch a whole comet.

  • －
    goal_voltiteSeed

    A Voltite Seed grows a deposit on your island that never runs out.

  • －
    goal_homingBeacon

    The Homing Beacon takes you home, then back to the same spot in the Wilds.

  • －
    goal_pullCharm

    The Pull Charm pulls nearby drops to you while it's in your hotbar.

  • －
    goal_arcCaster

    The Arc Caster hits creatures up to 20 blocks away, using your island's power.

  • －
    goal_voltplate

    Armour that runs on your island's power: the Chestplate's Barrier soaks up hits in the Wilds.

  • －
    goal_fullPlate

    Each Voltplate piece adds a perk: see in the dark, move faster, jump higher, fire the Arc Caster faster.

  • －
    goal_oldWorks

    Draugr guard the chest in an Old Works vault: open it for 6 Machine Parts and a Deposit Seed.

  • －
    goal_overtime

    Dusk Moss in the Core makes your next time away run at full speed for a while.

  • －
    goal_silo

    A Storage Silo holds up to 4096 of one item, far more than a chest; a Belt Loader feeds a machine from it.

  • －
    goal_growDeposit

    Deposit Seeds from the Wilds grow new deposits on your island that never run out.

  • －
    goal_treeCutter

    A Tree Cutter chops and replants a tree for you: wood without the axe.

  • －
    goal_coreTier2

    Tier 2: a bigger island, a Copper Deposit, power, wire and plate machines, the Parts Bench and the Iron Hammer, which digs 3×3.

  • －
    goal_coreTier3

    Tier 3: a bigger island, a Gold Deposit, Steel, Electric Drills, the Assembler and Logic Boards.

  • －
    goal_coreTier4

    Tier 4: a bigger island, Voltite, the Volt Engine, Sky Taps, the deep line and the Sky Pack.

  • －
    goal_coreTier5

    Tier 5: a bigger island, the Crystal Vat, Star Alloy, comets and the Starbore Drill.

  • －
    goal_coreTier6

    Starwright stage 1: a bigger island, the Belt Tunnel, and a ring on the Core's spire.

  • －
    goal_coreTier7

    Stage 2: a bigger island, a second Gold Deposit, an Iron Trophy and another ring on the spire.

  • －
    goal_coreTier8

    Stage 3: a bigger island with room for more machines, a Gold Trophy and another ring on the spire.

  • －
    goal_coreTier9

スカイブロックの「Showcase」が木の種類ごとの「Item Pedestal(台座)」に。コードエディタに AI ヘルパーの使い方チュートリアル。Golem Farmer の交換は最大 10 回まで

＋ 新しい文言 24〜 書き換え 3
🪵
遊ぶ人

「Showcase」が「Maple Item Pedestal」に改名、木の種類ごとの台座が 10 種追加

前回追加された、アイテムを飾る「Showcase」の名前が、「Maple Item Pedestal(メープルの台座)」に変わりました。あわせて、Pine(松)、Plum(梅)、Cedar(杉)、Aspen(ポプラ)、Jungle、Palm(ヤシ)、Pear(梨)、Cherry(桜)、Spectral、Mango の台座が、新しく入りました。木の種類で見た目を選べるようになったと思われます。

「見た目を選べる」は、名前の並びからの推測です。作り方や値段は、文言からは分かりません。

確かさ: 名前は確実 / 見た目や入手方法は不明
🤖
作る人

コードエディタの「AI ヘルパー」の使い方チュートリアル(12 項目)

「AI Helper Overview」というチュートリアルが追加されました。AI ヘルパーは、「全員に剣を配って」のように日本語や英語で頼むと、コードを書いてくれる機能です。答えるのは、無料の「Bot.xd」で、ログインすると、強い「Super Bot.xd」を試せます。自分の API キーも使えます。「編集をオン」にすると、AI の変更が直接コードに入り、オフだと、先に見せてから「Apply to my code」で入れる形です。「AI notes」に、ゲームの内容(「2 チームで旗を取り合う」など)を書くと、毎回それを読んで答えます。「Game settings」では、時間や数などを、コードを触らずに変えられます。AI ヘルパーを閉じて、コードの場所を広げるボタンもあります。

前回の更新で、Super Bot.xd が DeepSeek 製だという通知が入っています(質問とコードが中国の会社に送られる)。Bot.xd がどこの AI かは、文言に出ていません。

確かさ: 文言は確実
💣
遊ぶ人

スカイブロック: Golem Farmer の交換が「最大 10 回まで」と明記された

Moonstone 3 個を、Moonstone Explosive 2 個と Mining Grenade 2 個に換える交換の文言に、「最大 10 回まで」が足されました。

10 回が、1 日の上限か、1 回の会話での上限かは、文言からは分かりません。以前から 10 回だったのかも不明です。

確かさ: 文言は確実
🛒
遊ぶ人

自動販売機: 買えないアイテムを買おうとしたときのメッセージ

「そのアイテムは買えません。返金しました」というメッセージが増えました。自動販売機の、売り買いのできない物の扱いに対応する文言です。

どのアイテムが買えないかは不明です。

確かさ: 文言は確実
👥
遊ぶ人

フレンドのロビーが満員のときのメッセージ

フレンドのところへ行こうとして、そのロビーが満員だと、「満員です。誰かが抜けたら、もう一度試して」と出ます。

前は別のメッセージだったのかは、分かりません。

確かさ: 文言は確実

スカイブロックに「コレクション」「自動販売機」「ショーケース」「サイン帳」「総資産の表示」。Spencer がトロフィー・旗・Stone Generator の鉱石混ぜ・Melon Helper のクエストを追加。Super Bot.xd は DeepSeek 製と表示、更新中の待ち画面も追加

＋ 新しい文言 1010〜 書き換え 13－ 削除 3
📚
遊ぶ人

スカイブロック: 「コレクション」(集めると段階が上がってごほうび)

資源を集めると「Tier(段階)」が上がり、段階ごとにゴールドコインとスキル経験値がもらえる仕組みです。画面には、集めた数、次の段階までの進み具合、次のごほうびが出ます。1 つ目を集めるまでは「ロック中」の表示です。段階が上がると「○○ unlocked! +コイン +経験値」と出ます。

どの資源が対象か、何個で次の段階かは、文言には出ていません。

確かさ: 文言は確実 / 各段階の必要数・ごほうびの量は不明
🏪
遊ぶ人

自動販売機(プレイヤー同士の売り買い)

島に置く「自動販売機」で、プレイヤーが売り物を並べ、他のプレイヤーが買えます。スロットに、手に持ったアイテムを入れて(Stock)、1 個あたりの値段をゴールドコインで決めます(1 以上の整数、上限あり)。売れるたびに手数料が引かれ、価格を入れる画面に「この値段なら手取りはいくら」と出ます。売れた代金は、出品した人が「Collect」で受け取ります(受け取るまで次の販売ができないスロットもあります)。売り切れや値段の変更で買えなかった場合は返金されます。売れない物もあり、1 つの島に置ける台数にも上限があります。代金や在庫はメールでも届きます(自動販売機の売上、撤去したときの返却、購入、返金)。

手数料の割合と台数の上限は、文言では変数({{rate}} / {{max}})で、数値は見えていません。

確かさ: 文言は確実 / 置ける数の上限・手数料率は不明
🖼️
遊ぶ人

新アイテム「Showcase」(アイテムを飾る)

アイテムを持って使うと、島に飾れます。飾ったのは持ち主の名前つきで表示され、取り出せるのは持ち主だけです。1 つの島に飾れる数には上限があります。飾った物の価値は、総資産に数えられます。

見た目や、置ける場所の細かい条件は不明です。

確かさ: 文言は確実
✍️
遊ぶ人

サイン帳(オートグラフ)

「/autograph 名前」で、同じ場所にいるプレイヤーにサインを頼めます。相手に「サインしますか」と出て、Sign / Decline を選びます。返事がなければ期限切れになります。自分には頼めない、相手がその場にいないと頼めない、1 度に 1 件まで、相手が 1 人ずつ(同名が複数いると特定できない)、帳面がいっぱいだと書けない、などの制限があります。帳面には、サインの合計と「クリエイター・開発者からのサイン」の数が出ます。

サインの見た目や、集める意味(ごほうびの有無)は文言からは分かりません。

確かさ: 文言は確実
💰
遊ぶ人

総資産(Net worth)の表示

財布、銀行、持ち物、持ちきれず待っている戦利品、Moonstone Chest、島のチェスト、Showcase の中身を足した合計がゴールドコインで出ます。

各アイテムを何コインとして数えるかは不明です。

確かさ: 文言は確実
🏝️
遊ぶ人

島の訪問まわりの改善

同じ名前のプレイヤーが複数いると、訪問先を特定できないので「/islands から選んで」と案内されます。島が今は訪問できない、読み込めない、訪問が混み合っている、などのメッセージが増えました。「最後に保存された状態の島を見ている」という表示もあります。

「最後に保存された状態」になる条件は不明です。

確かさ: 文言は確実
🎨
遊ぶ人

Spencer のクエストが大量に追加(トロフィー、旗、鉱石入りの Stone Generator、Helper の強化)

【Helper の強化】Wheat Helper は金の歯車で改良すると、小麦が 40 秒ごと、保管 90 個になります(文言)。Carrot Helper の改良後は、30 秒ごと、保管 120 個です。必要な物は、金のインゴット(Gilded Gallery の金鉱石を炉で焼く。石炭も要る)、小麦 64、金のニンジン 24(Manor Farm の Lady Proudfeet と交換)などです。新アイテム Melon Helper は、スイカのスライスを 30 秒ごとに作ります(Spencer の「One in a Melon」クエスト)。
【トロフィー】鉄 → 金 → ダイヤ → Moonstone の順に、トロフィーを作って島に飾るクエストです。材料は、鉄のインゴット 8 とメープルの原木 16、金のインゴット 16 と石 64、ダイヤ 6 と火の玉 8、Moonstone 16 とランタン 8 などです。
【旗】ボス(Forge Warden など)を倒した証として、Skull Banner などの旗をもらえるクエストが、3 種(Forge / Frost / Wild)あります。
【Stone Generator の鉱石混ぜ】「A Seam of Coal」「鉄」「金」の 3 段階で、Stone Generator から石だけでなく、石炭鉱石、鉄鉱石、金鉱石も出るようになります(金は、金のインゴット 12 と石炭 32 が要る)。
【ミルクペイント】牛乳 32 個で、White Neon がもらえます。
【その他】小麦・ニンジン・石・原木の Island Order は前回どおりです。

各クエストの報酬の全部は、文言に出ていません。ボス旗の 3 種の細かい条件は、読み切っていません。

確かさ: 文言は確実 / 報酬は一部しか見えない
⛏️
遊ぶ人

精錬に「石炭」が要ることが明記された

「鉄/金を炉で焼く」クエストの説明に、「石炭 50 個」などの記述が足されました。たとえば、50 個の金のインゴットを作るには、石炭 50 個も要ると書かれています。

ゲーム側の仕組み(燃料が要る)が前からあったのか、今回変えたのかは、文言だけでは分かりません。

確かさ: 文言の変更で確認
🏮
遊ぶ人

新しいエリア・住民らしき名前(Lantern Reach、Ledger 系、常連の NPC)

クエスト名に「Into the Reach」「Kelpwood / Amethyst / Moonwell の Lens」「The Hush」「Lamp Festival」「Perfect Pitch」などが、新しく入りました。常連の NPC として、Flicker、Barnaby、Mossy、Gleam、Fizz、Pith、Snowdrop、Sterling、Bertha の名前も見えます。

中身(場所、物語、報酬)は、まだ読んでいません。名前の並びからの推測は書いていません。

確かさ: 名前だけ確認 / 内容は未読
🖥️
遊ぶ人

WebGPU の新しい描画エンジンの案内

「新しい WebGPU の描画エンジンは、ブラウザが再起動するまで無効になっている」という案内が増えました。シェーダーパックは WebGPU が要るため、WebGPU が無効だと使えず、設定で WebGPU をオンにするよう案内されます。

WebGPU の描画エンジンが、いつ標準になるかは不明です。

確かさ: 文言は確実
🔄
遊ぶ人

アップデート中の待ち画面

「Bloxd is updating」の画面と、「○○ 秒後に元のゲームに戻します」の案内が追加されました。オフラインのときは、つながったら戻ります。Discord 版では、「Restart Bloxd」で入り直す形です。「What's new」のボタンも出ます。更新のたびに、遊んでいる途中で落ちるのを、避ける狙いだと思われます。

「狙い」は文言からの推測です。

フォルダの名前を変えると、中のファイルもまとめて移ります(Rename Folder)。AI アシスタントの「Super Bot.xd」には、「DeepSeek が動かしている。質問とワールドのコードは、中国の会社 DeepSeek に送られる」という通知と、プライバシーポリシーへのリンクが付きました。

これまで別の AI だったのかは、文言だけでは分かりません。

    questSpencerWheatHelperWaitingForRoom

    I've got a spare Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]] for you once you've made some room.
