  • ＋
    questGoldenGearsName

    Golden Gears

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldenGearsDescription

    Your Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]] works so hard, neighbour, but I know how to make it even faster! Bring me 4 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] for shiny golden gears, and 64 Wheat [[Wheat]] to stuff a scarecrow to keep it company.

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldenGearsWaitingOn

    I've an idea for golden gears, neighbour, but the best gold is in the Gilded Gallery, past Elder Crag's mine door in Cragrock Mines. Prove yourself to him and he'll let you through. Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile in the Hub can show you the way there!

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldenGearsCompleted

    Listen to those golden gears hum! Your Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]] will keep the Wheat [[Wheat]] coming faster than ever, neighbour.

  • ＋
    questGoldenGearsGoldGatherName

    Smelt 4 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldenGearsGoldGatherDescription

    Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines, and smelt it into 4 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] with 4 Coal [[Coal]]. Gold gears never rust!

  • ＋
    questGoldenGearsGoldHandInName

    Bring 4 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldenGearsGoldHandInDescription

    Bring the 4 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldenGearsGoldReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to go! Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines.

  • ＋
    questGoldenGearsWheatGatherName

    Gather 64 Wheat [[Wheat]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldenGearsWheatGatherDescription

    Harvest Wheat [[Wheat]] on your island, or collect it from your Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]], until you have 64.

  • ＋
    questGoldenGearsWheatHandInName

    Bring 64 Wheat [[Wheat]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldenGearsWheatHandInDescription

    Bring the 64 Wheat [[Wheat]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldenGearsWheatReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Wheat [[Wheat]] to go! It grows right here on your island, and your Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]] makes it too.

  • ＋
    questTuneWheatHelperName

    Get Your Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]] Tuned Up by Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerTuneWheatHelperDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll tune up your Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerWheatHelperTuned

    Golden gears in, a little polish... done! Your Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]] now makes a Wheat [[Wheat]] every 40 seconds, and holds 90.

  • ＋
    questCollectTunedWheatName

    Collect 2 Wheat [[Wheat]] from Your Tuned Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerCollectTunedWheatDescription

    Go and try out your tuned Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]] on your island, and collect 2 Wheat [[Wheat]] from it. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questCarrotGoldName

    Twenty-Four Carrot Gold

  • ＋
    questSpencerCarrotGoldDescription

    Now your Carrot Helper [[Carrot Helper]] wants golden gears too, neighbour! Bring me 8 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] for its gears, and 24 Gold Carrots [[Gold Carrot]] so it knows what the very best carrot looks like.

  • ＋
    questSpencerCarrotGoldCompleted

    Twenty-four carrot gold, and two helpers humming along! Your island has never been so busy, neighbour.

  • ＋
    questCarrotGoldGoldGatherName

    Smelt 8 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerCarrotGoldGoldGatherDescription

    Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines, and smelt it into 8 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] with 8 Coal [[Coal]]. Twice the gold for twice the shine!

  • ＋
    questCarrotGoldGoldHandInName

    Bring 8 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerCarrotGoldGoldHandInDescription

    Bring the 8 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerCarrotGoldGoldReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to go! Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines.

  • ＋
    questCarrotGoldCarrotsGatherName

    Trade Lady Proudfeet for 24 Gold Carrots [[Gold Carrot]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerCarrotGoldCarrotsGatherDescription

    Lady Proudfeet trades Gold Carrots [[Gold Carrot]] at Manor Farm. Eat a Carrot [[Carrot]] in Goldenroot Burrow to spot her through the walls, knock on her door, then go in and trade her 24 Carrots [[Carrot]] for 24 Gold Carrots [[Gold Carrot]].

  • ＋
    questCarrotGoldCarrotsHandInName

    Bring 24 Gold Carrots [[Gold Carrot]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerCarrotGoldCarrotsHandInDescription

    Bring the 24 Gold Carrots [[Gold Carrot]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerCarrotGoldCarrotsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Gold Carrots [[Gold Carrot]] to go! Lady Proudfeet trades them in Goldenroot Burrow at Manor Farm.

  • ＋
    questTuneCarrotHelperName

    Get Your Carrot Helper [[Carrot Helper]] Tuned Up by Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerTuneCarrotHelperDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll tune up your Carrot Helper [[Carrot Helper]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerCarrotHelperTuned

    Golden gears in, a little shine... done! Your Carrot Helper [[Carrot Helper]] now makes a Carrot [[Carrot]] every 30 seconds, and holds 120.

  • ＋
    questMelonHelperName

    One in a Melon

  • ＋
    questSpencerMelonHelperDescription

    Two helpers hard at work, neighbour, so let's build a third! A Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]] needs 32 Melon Slices [[Melon Slice]] from Manor Farm so it knows a good melon, and 8 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] for golden gears from day one.

  • ＋
    questSpencerMelonHelperCompleted

    Three helpers on one island! Wheat [[Wheat]], Carrots [[Carrot]] and Melon Slices [[Melon Slice]], all made at home. You're one in a melon, neighbour!

  • ＋
    questMelonHelperSlicesGatherName

    Harvest 32 Melon Slices [[Melon Slice]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerMelonHelperSlicesGatherDescription

    Harvest the ripe Melons [[Melon]] at Meloncloak Grove in Manor Farm until you have 32 Melon Slices [[Melon Slice]]. Not Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]] this time, neighbour: those come from Stagstep Gardens, and a Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]] only knows Melons [[Melon]]!

  • ＋
    questMelonHelperSlicesHandInName

    Bring 32 Melon Slices [[Melon Slice]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerMelonHelperSlicesHandInDescription

    Bring the 32 Melon Slices [[Melon Slice]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerMelonHelperSlicesReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Melon Slices [[Melon Slice]] to go! Ripe Melons [[Melon]] grow at Meloncloak Grove in Manor Farm. Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]] won't do for this one.

  • ＋
    questMelonHelperGoldGatherName

    Smelt 8 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerMelonHelperGoldGatherDescription

    Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines, and smelt it into 8 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] with 8 Coal [[Coal]]. Golden gears from the very start!

  • ＋
    questMelonHelperGoldHandInName

    Bring 8 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerMelonHelperGoldHandInDescription

    Bring the 8 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerMelonHelperGoldReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to go! Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines.

  • ＋
    questBuildMelonHelperName

    Get Your Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]] from Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerBuildMelonHelperDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll hand over your Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerMelonHelperBuilt

    Golden gears in, a melon on top... ta-da! Here's your Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]]. It makes a Melon Slice [[Melon Slice]] every 30 seconds while you're home.

  • ＋
    questPlaceMelonHelperName

    Place the Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]] on Your Island

  • ＋
    questSpencerPlaceMelonHelperDescription

    Set your Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]] down anywhere on your island, next to the other two if you like. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questCollectHelperMelonsName

    Collect 2 Melon Slices [[Melon Slice]] from Your Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerCollectHelperMelonsDescription

    Keep your Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]] company on your island while it works, then use it to collect 2 Melon Slices [[Melon Slice]]. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questSpencerMelonHelperAgain

    Lost your Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]]? Here's another. Set it down on your island and it'll get back to work.

  • ＋
    questSpencerMelonHelperWaitingForRoom

    I've got a spare Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]] for you once you've made some room.

  • ＋
    questMilkPaintName

    Milk Paint

  • ＋
    questSpencerMilkPaintDescription

    Did you know you can make paint from milk, neighbour? It's an old painter's trick! Bring me 32 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] from the cows at Manor Farm, and I'll mix up the brightest white you ever saw.

  • ＋
    questSpencerMilkPaintCompleted

    Told you it'd be the brightest white, neighbour! Here's some White Neon [[White Neon]], so your island can glow with it too.

  • ＋
    questMilkPaintMilkGatherName

    Collect 32 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerMilkPaintMilkGatherDescription

    Feed the Cows in Snoutmeadow at Manor Farm 1 Wheat [[Wheat]] and 1 Melon Slice [[Melon Slice]] for each Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] until you have 32. Your Wheat Helper [[Wheat Helper]] and Melon Helper [[Melon Helper]] make both at home!

  • ＋
    questMilkPaintMilkHandInName

    Bring 32 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerMilkPaintMilkHandInDescription

    Bring the 32 Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerMilkPaintMilkReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Cow's Milk [[Cow's Milk]] to go! Feed the Cows in Snoutmeadow at Manor Farm a Wheat [[Wheat]] and a Melon Slice [[Melon Slice]] each.

  • ＋
    questCollectTunedCarrotsName

    Collect 4 Carrots [[Carrot]] from Your Tuned Carrot Helper [[Carrot Helper]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerCollectTunedCarrotsDescription

    Go and try out your tuned Carrot Helper [[Carrot Helper]] on your island, and collect 4 Carrots [[Carrot]] from it. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronTrophyDescription

    Every home needs something to be proud of, neighbour, and yours has earned it! I'll make you an Iron Trophy [[Iron Trophy]]. Bring me 8 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] for the cup, and 16 Maple Logs [[Maple Log]] for its stand.

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronTrophyCompleted

    Now that's a view! Your Iron Trophy [[Iron Trophy]] looks right at home, neighbour.

  • ＋
    questIronTrophyName

    Pride of Place

  • ＋
    questIronTrophyIronBarsGatherName

    Mine Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] at Ruby's Rockpile in the Hub, and smelt it into 8 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] with 8 Coal [[Coal]]. Iron makes a sturdy cup!

    Bring 8 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] to Spencer

    questSpencerIronTrophyIronBarsHandInDescription

    Bring the 8 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronTrophyIronBarsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] to go! Mine Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] at Ruby's Rockpile in the Hub.

    Chop 16 Maple Logs [[Maple Log]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronTrophyMapleLogsGatherDescription

    Chop the Maple trees on your island until you have 16 Maple Logs [[Maple Log]]. Each tree grows back from a sapling while you stay there.

  • ＋
    questIronTrophyMapleLogsHandInName

    Bring 16 Maple Logs [[Maple Log]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronTrophyMapleLogsHandInDescription

    Bring the 16 Maple Logs [[Maple Log]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronTrophyMapleLogsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Maple Logs [[Maple Log]] to go! The Maple trees on your island have plenty.

    Get Your Iron Trophy [[Iron Trophy]] from Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerMakeIronTrophyDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll hand over your Iron Trophy [[Iron Trophy]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronTrophyMade

    Hammered, polished and gleaming! Here's your Iron Trophy [[Iron Trophy]], neighbour. Find it a spot where everyone can see it!

  • ＋
    questPlaceIronTrophyName

    Place the Iron Trophy [[Iron Trophy]] on Your Island

  • ＋
    questSpencerPlaceIronTrophyDescription

    Set your Iron Trophy [[Iron Trophy]] down somewhere proud on your island. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldTrophyDescription

    Your Iron Trophy [[Iron Trophy]] could use a golden friend, neighbour! Bring me 16 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] for a Gold Trophy [[Gold Trophy]], and 64 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] for a grand plinth to stand it on.

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldTrophyWaitingOn

    I'm dreaming of a Gold Trophy [[Gold Trophy]], neighbour, but the best gold is in the Gilded Gallery, past Elder Crag's mine door in Cragrock Mines. Prove yourself to him and he'll let you through. Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile in the Hub can show you the way there!

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldTrophyCompleted

    What a gleam! Your island is really shining now, neighbour.

  • ＋
    questGoldTrophyName

    Good as Gold

  • ＋
    questGoldTrophyGoldBarsGatherName

    Smelt 16 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldTrophyGoldBarsGatherDescription

    Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines, and smelt it into 16 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] with 16 Coal [[Coal]].

  • ＋
    questGoldTrophyGoldBarsHandInName

    Bring 16 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldTrophyGoldBarsHandInDescription

    Bring the 16 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldTrophyGoldBarsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to go! Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines.

  • ＋
    questGoldTrophyStoneGatherName

    Gather 64 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldTrophyStoneGatherDescription

    Mine the Stone [[Stone]] that grows on your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] until you have 64 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]]. Either makes a fine plinth!

  • ＋
    questGoldTrophyStoneHandInName

    Bring 64 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldTrophyStoneHandInDescription

    Bring the 64 Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldTrophyStoneReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Messy Stone [[Messy Stone]] or Stone [[Stone]] to go! Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] keep making more.

  • ＋
    questMakeGoldTrophyName

    Get Your Gold Trophy [[Gold Trophy]] from Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerMakeGoldTrophyDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll hand over your Gold Trophy [[Gold Trophy]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldTrophyMade

    Solid gold on a stone plinth, fit for a champion! Your Gold Trophy [[Gold Trophy]] is ready, neighbour. Set it down where it can catch the light!

  • ＋
    questPlaceGoldTrophyName

    Place the Gold Trophy [[Gold Trophy]] on Your Island

  • ＋
    questSpencerPlaceGoldTrophyDescription

    Set your Gold Trophy [[Gold Trophy]] down on your island, next to your Iron Trophy [[Iron Trophy]] if you like. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyDescription

    Iron, gold... and now diamond, neighbour! For a Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]] I need 6 Diamonds [[Diamond]] from Shale's Goofy Golems, and 8 Fireballs [[Fireball]] to set a flame dancing inside it.

  • ＋
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyWaitingOn

    I've a sparkling idea for a Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]], neighbour! It needs Diamonds [[Diamond]] from Shale's Goofy Golems in Cragrock Mines, and Fireballs [[Fireball]] from the Wild Infernos. Help Shale with his herd, and Lorenzo at the Badlands in the Hub can show you the way to the Wild Infernos!

  • ＋
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyCompleted

    Three trophies to your name, neighbour! That's a sight to be proud of.

  • ＋
    questDiamondTrophyName

    Diamond Bright

  • ＋
    questDiamondTrophyDiamondsGatherName

    Shear 6 Diamonds [[Diamond]] from the Goofy Golems

  • ＋
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyDiamondsGatherDescription

    Shear Shale's Goofy Golems in Glimmerdeep Hollow, in Cragrock Mines, until you have 6 Diamonds [[Diamond]]. Set a Moonstone Explosive [[Moonstone Explosive]] down beside them and stand well back, or swing a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]]. Shale trades more explosives for Moonstone [[Moonstone]].

  • ＋
    questDiamondTrophyDiamondsHandInName

    Bring 6 Diamonds [[Diamond]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyDiamondsHandInDescription

    Bring the 6 Diamonds [[Diamond]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyDiamondsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Diamonds [[Diamond]] to go! Shale's Goofy Golems in Glimmerdeep Hollow have plenty.

  • ＋
    questDiamondTrophyFireballsGatherName

    Gather 8 Fireballs [[Fireball]] from Magma Golems

  • ＋
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyFireballsGatherDescription

    Knock the Magma Golems off the skeleton's ribs at the Shooting Gallery in the Wild Infernos until you have 8 Fireballs [[Fireball]]. Flint can show you how!

  • ＋
    questDiamondTrophyFireballsHandInName

    Bring 8 Fireballs [[Fireball]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyFireballsHandInDescription

    Bring the 8 Fireballs [[Fireball]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyFireballsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Fireballs [[Fireball]] to go! The Magma Golems at the Shooting Gallery drop them when they fall.

  • ＋
    questMakeDiamondTrophyName

    Get Your Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]] from Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerMakeDiamondTrophyDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll hand over your Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerDiamondTrophyMade

    Sparkling bright, with a flame dancing inside! Give your Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]] the best spot on your island, neighbour.

  • ＋
    questPlaceDiamondTrophyName

    Place the Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]] on Your Island

  • ＋
    questSpencerPlaceDiamondTrophyDescription

    Set your Diamond Trophy [[Diamond Trophy]] down anywhere on your island. It'll look best beside your other trophies! Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questMoonstoneTrophyName

    Over the Moon

  • ＋
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyDescription

    Iron, gold, diamond... and now moonstone, neighbour! For a Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] I need 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] from across the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines, and 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] to make it glow like the moon.

  • ＋
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyWaitingOn

    I've a shining idea for a Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]], neighbour! Its Moonstone [[Moonstone]] grows past the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines, and only Grubnik's cannons can fire you over. Pay Grubnik his fee and he'll send you flying!

  • ＋
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyCompleted

    Four trophies, shining like the night sky! Your shelf is the talk of the islands, neighbour.

  • ＋
    questMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneGatherName

    Mine 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] Across the Broken Bridge

  • ＋
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneGatherDescription

    Ride Grubnik's cannon over the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines, and mine the Moonstone Ore [[Moonstone Ore]] on the far wall until you have 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]]. A Pure Moonstone Ore [[Pure Moonstone Ore]] is slower to mine but gives 9 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] at once. Your Cracked Rubellite Pickaxe [[Cracked Rubellite Pickaxe]] mines Moonstone [[Moonstone]] from both, as does an Iron Pickaxe [[Iron Pickaxe]] or better, but a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]] gives you the ore itself instead.

  • ＋
    questMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneHandInName

    Bring 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneHandInDescription

    Bring the 16 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMoonstoneReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Moonstone [[Moonstone]] to go! Grubnik's cannon fires you over the broken bridge in Cragrock Mines to the Moonstone Ore [[Moonstone Ore]].

  • ＋
    questMoonstoneTrophyLanternsGatherName

    Craft 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] at Your Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyLanternsGatherDescription

    Craft 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] at the Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]] on your island. A little light makes moonstone shine!

  • ＋
    questMoonstoneTrophyLanternsHandInName

    Bring 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyLanternsHandInDescription

    Bring the 8 Lanterns [[Lantern]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyLanternsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Lanterns [[Lantern]] to go! Craft them at the Artisan Bench [[Artisan Bench]] on your island.

  • ＋
    questMakeMoonstoneTrophyName

    Get Your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] from Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerMakeMoonstoneTrophyDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll hand over your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerMoonstoneTrophyMade

    Pale as a full moon! Here's your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]], neighbour. It'll catch the moonlight all night long.

  • ＋
    questPlaceMoonstoneTrophyName

    Place the Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] on Your Island

  • ＋
    questSpencerPlaceMoonstoneTrophyDescription

    Set your Moonstone Trophy [[Moonstone Trophy]] down on your island, beside your other trophies. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questForgeBannerName

    Banner of the Forge

  • ＋
    questSpencerForgeBannerDescription

    My trophies show off what you gather, neighbour, but a real hero needs banners for the bosses they beat! Bring down the Forge Warden in Skullforge, or tell me if you already have, and I'll paint you a Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] to prove it.

  • ＋
    questBeatForgeBossName

    Beat the Forge Warden in Skullforge

  • ＋
    questSpencerBeatForgeBossDescription

    Go through the dungeon portal in the Hub, use Skullforge's statue in the dungeon hall, and beat the Forge Warden at the end of the dungeon. Any difficulty counts!

  • ＋
    questFetchForgeBannerName

    Get Your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] from Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerFetchForgeBannerDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll paint your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerForgeBannerPainted

    You beat the Forge Warden! Here's your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]], neighbour. Careful, the paint's still wet!

  • ＋
    questPlaceForgeBannerName

    Put Up the Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] on Your Island

  • ＋
    questSpencerPlaceForgeBannerDescription

    Hang your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] on a wall or stand it on the ground, anywhere on your island. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questSpencerForgeBannerCompleted

    Your first banner, flying high! Everyone who visits will know you beat the Forge Warden, neighbour.

  • ＋
    questFrostBannerName

    Banner of the Frost

  • ＋
    questSpencerFrostBannerDescription

    Your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]] needs some company, neighbour! Beat the Frost Wraith in Frozen Hollow, or tell me if you already have, and I'll paint you a Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] to go with it. Fair warning: it's tougher than the Forge Warden!

  • ＋
    questBeatFrostBossName

    Beat the Frost Wraith in Frozen Hollow

  • ＋
    questSpencerBeatFrostBossDescription

    Go through the dungeon portal in the Hub, use Frozen Hollow's statue in the dungeon hall, and beat the Frost Wraith at the end of the dungeon. Any difficulty counts!

  • ＋
    questFetchFrostBannerName

    Get Your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] from Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerFetchFrostBannerDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll paint your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerFrostBannerPainted

    You beat the Frost Wraith! Here's your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]], neighbour. I painted it so frosty, I needed mittens!

  • ＋
    questPlaceFrostBannerName

    Put Up the Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] on Your Island

  • ＋
    questSpencerPlaceFrostBannerDescription

    Hang your Draugr Banner [[Draugr Banner]] on a wall or stand it on the ground, anywhere on your island. It'll look best beside your Skull Banner [[Skull Banner]]! Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questSpencerFrostBannerCompleted

    Two banners flying! The Forge Warden and the Frost Wraith, both beaten. What a hero you are, neighbour!

  • ＋
    questWildBannerName

    Banner of the Wilds

  • ＋
    questSpencerWildBannerDescription

    Two banners up, neighbour, and the wilds are calling! The Tiki Terror in Wildwood Grove is the toughest boss yet! Beat it, or tell me if you already have, and I'll paint you a Green Banner [[Green Banner]] as leafy as the grove itself.

  • ＋
    questBeatWildBossName

    Beat the Tiki Terror in Wildwood Grove

  • ＋
    questSpencerBeatWildBossDescription

    Go through the dungeon portal in the Hub, use Wildwood Grove's statue in the dungeon hall, and beat the Tiki Terror at the end of the dungeon. Any difficulty counts!

  • ＋
    questFetchWildBannerName

    Get Your Green Banner [[Green Banner]] from Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerFetchWildBannerDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll paint your Green Banner [[Green Banner]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerWildBannerPainted

    You beat the Tiki Terror! Here's your Green Banner [[Green Banner]], neighbour, as green as a fresh spring leaf.

  • ＋
    questPlaceWildBannerName

    Put Up the Green Banner [[Green Banner]] on Your Island

  • ＋
    questSpencerPlaceWildBannerDescription

    Hang your Green Banner [[Green Banner]] on a wall or stand it on the ground, anywhere on your island, beside your other banners. Lost it? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questSpencerWildBannerCompleted

    Three banners for three bosses! Your island looks like a real hall of heroes now, neighbour.

  • ＋
    questCoalSeamName

    A Seam of Coal

  • ＋
    questSpencerCoalSeamDescription

    Neighbour, what if your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grew Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] as well as Stone [[Stone]]? Old Smudge works the coal quarry in Cragrock Mines, and nobody knows coal like he does. Go and ask him how it gets into rock!

  • ＋
    questSpencerCoalSeamWaitingOn

    I've a bright idea for your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]], neighbour, but it needs coal from Cragrock Mines. Ruby at Ruby's Rockpile in the Hub can show you the way there!

  • ＋
    questSpencerCoalSeamCompleted

    Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] growing right here at home, neighbour! Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] are full of surprises now.

  • ＋
    questCoalSeamMeetSmudgeName

    Ask Old Smudge in Cragrock Mines About Coal [[Coal]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerCoalSeamMeetSmudgeDescription

    Find Old Smudge at the top of the coal quarry in Cragrock Mines' entrance yard, and ask him how coal gets into rock.

  • ＋
    questSpencerCoalSeamMeetSmudgeNext

    That's the coal sorted, neighbour! Now pop over to Old Smudge in Cragrock Mines and ask him how it gets into rock.

  • ＋
    questCoalSeamCoalGatherName

    Gather 32 Coal [[Coal]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerCoalSeamCoalGatherDescription

    Mine the Pure Coal Ore [[Pure Coal Ore]] in Old Smudge's coal quarry in Cragrock Mines until you have 32 Coal [[Coal]].

  • ＋
    questCoalSeamCoalHandInName

    Bring 32 Coal [[Coal]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerCoalSeamCoalHandInDescription

    Bring the 32 Coal [[Coal]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerCoalSeamCoalReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]] to go! Old Smudge's coal quarry in Cragrock Mines is full of it.

  • ＋
    questCoalSeamUpgradeName

    Have Spencer Seed Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with Coal [[Coal]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerCoalSeamUpgradeDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll seed your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with the Coal [[Coal]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerCoalSeamUpgraded

    A sprinkle of Coal [[Coal]] in each, a good stir... done! Get mining, neighbour, and watch for the first dark speckles of Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]].

  • ＋
    questCoalSeamMineName

    Mine 4 Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] Grown by Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerCoalSeamMineDescription

    Stay on your island and mine 4 Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] as your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow it. About one block in five they grow is coal now! Lost your generators? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questIronSeamName

    Iron in the Stone

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronSeamDescription

    That coal was only the start, neighbour! Let's teach your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] to grow iron too. Bring me 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] to seed them with, and 16 Coal [[Coal]] to keep them warm.

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronSeamCompleted

    Iron and coal from your very own island! What a clever pair of generators you have, neighbour.

  • ＋
    questIronSeamIronBarsGatherName

    Smelt 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronSeamIronBarsGatherDescription

    Mine Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] in Cragrock Mines, where a Pure Iron Ore [[Pure Iron Ore]] gives plenty, and smelt the Raw Iron [[Raw Iron]] into 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] with 16 more Coal [[Coal]].

  • ＋
    questIronSeamIronBarsHandInName

    Bring 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronSeamIronBarsHandInDescription

    Bring the 16 Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronSeamIronBarsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]] to go! Cragrock Mines has Pure Iron Ore [[Pure Iron Ore]] to spare.

  • ＋
    questIronSeamCoalGatherName

    Gather 16 Coal [[Coal]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronSeamCoalGatherDescription

    Mine the Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow until you have 16 Coal [[Coal]]. Coal [[Coal]] from the mines will do just as well!

  • ＋
    questIronSeamCoalHandInName

    Bring 16 Coal [[Coal]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronSeamCoalHandInDescription

    Bring the 16 Coal [[Coal]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronSeamCoalReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]] to go! Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] keep growing it, and Cragrock Mines has plenty too.

  • ＋
    questIronSeamUpgradeName

    Have Spencer Seed Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronSeamUpgradeDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll seed your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with the Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronSeamUpgraded

    In go the Iron Bars [[Iron Bar]], a good shake... there! Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] takes its time to show, so keep mining those generators, neighbour.

  • ＋
    questIronSeamMineName

    Mine 4 Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] Grown by Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerIronSeamMineDescription

    Stay on your island and mine 4 Iron Ore [[Iron Ore]] as your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow it. Iron is twice as rare as coal, about one block in ten, so keep at it! Lost your generators? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questGoldSeamName

    A Glint of Gold

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamDescription

    First coal, then iron... now picture your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] glinting with gold! Bring me 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] and 32 Coal [[Coal]], and I'll stir a little gold into the stone.

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamWaitingOn

    I'm dreaming of gold in your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]], neighbour, but the best gold is in the Gilded Gallery, past Elder Crag's mine door in Cragrock Mines. Prove yourself to him and he'll let you through!

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamCompleted

    Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow coal, iron and now gold! Not one island I've painted has generators as fine as these, neighbour.

  • ＋
    questGoldSeamGoldBarsGatherName

    Smelt 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamGoldBarsGatherDescription

    Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines, and smelt the Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] into 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] with 12 more Coal [[Coal]].

  • ＋
    questGoldSeamGoldBarsHandInName

    Bring 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamGoldBarsHandInDescription

    Bring the 12 Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamGoldBarsReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]] to go! Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines.

  • ＋
    questGoldSeamCoalGatherName

    Gather 32 Coal [[Coal]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamCoalGatherDescription

    Mine the Coal Ore [[Coal Ore]] your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow until you have 32 Coal [[Coal]]. Coal [[Coal]] from the mines will do just as well!

  • ＋
    questGoldSeamCoalHandInName

    Bring 32 Coal [[Coal]] to Spencer

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamCoalHandInDescription

    Bring the 32 Coal [[Coal]] back to me on your island.

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamCoalReminder

    Just {{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]] to go! Mine it at home or in Cragrock Mines, whichever's handier.

  • ＋
    questGoldSeamUpgradeName

    Have Spencer Seed Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamUpgradeDescription

    Come and see me on your island, and I'll seed your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] with the Gold Bars [[Gold Bar]].

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamUpgraded

    A pinch of gold in each... and they're glinting already! Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] is shy, so mine away and catch it when it peeks out.

  • ＋
    questGoldSeamMineName

    Mine 2 Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] Grown by Your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]]

  • ＋
    questSpencerGoldSeamMineDescription

    Stay on your island and mine 2 Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] as your Stone Generators [[Stone Generator]] grow it. Gold is the rarest yet, about one block in twenty, so watch for the glint! Lost your generators? I've got another for you.

  • ＋
    questSmudgeCoalSeamMeeting

    Spencer's idea, is it? Rock grows coal by sitting still a few thousand years. He hasn't got that long. Seed his stone with 32 Coal [[Coal]] from my quarry instead.

  • ＋
    zoneFishing1

    Lantern Reach

  • ＋
    mapFishing1Reference

    Lantern Reach

  • ＋
    fishingPortalGuardianBlocked

    Halt. Passage requires Blubberbeard's approval and a paid toll. Speak to me beside the portal.

  • ＋
    fishingPortalGuardianFreeBlocked

    Halt. Passage requires Blubberbeard's approval.

  • ＋
    fishingPortalGuardianIdle

    I report to Watch Dog. Passage rules apply equally to everyone.

  • ＋
    fishingPortalGuardianGreeting

    State your business.

  • ＋
    fishingPortalGuardianInventoryFull

    Make room in your inventory before proceeding.

  • ＋
    questFishingPortalTollPayment

    Pay the toll to the Lantern Reach Portal Guardian

  • ＋
    questFishingPortalTollPaymentDescription

    Speak to the Portal Guardian beside the grey portal at the west end of Blubberbeard's path to pay {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] from your purse. Withdraw banked [[Gold Coin]] from Bling Bling, or sell spare resources at the hub's Market to earn more.

  • ＋
    questFishingPortalTollReminder

    The toll is {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]]. Your purse needs {{remaining}} more [[Gold Coin]]. Withdraw any you have banked from Bling Bling, or sell spare resources at the Market, then return.

  • ＋
    questFishingPortalTollPaid

    Payment recorded. Go through the blue portal to the Lantern Reach.

  • ＋
    glowtideCast

    The glowtide takes your cast!

  • ＋

    Your own glowtide bloom rises!

  • ＋
    glowtideFlareFaded

    Your glowtide bloom has faded.

  • ＋
    glowtideFlareNoWater

    Aim the flare at open water nearby.

  • ＋
    glowtideFlareAsleep

    This water is still asleep. Relight its lens first.

  • ＋
    glowtideFlareStillGlowing

    Your last bloom is still glowing.

  • ＋
    glowtideFlareNotHere

    Glowtide Flares only work in the Lantern Reach.

  • ＋
    glowtideFlareNoEmitters

    The water is too busy to glow right now. Try again soon.

    glowtideChipInRange

    Glowtide!

  • ＋

  • ＋

    Your Glow meter is full: your next bite is a rare!

    Glow meter: {{fill}}/{{capacity}}

    The Lamp kept this bloom for you!

    fishGotAway

    It got away! Cast by the ripples to try again.

  • ＋
    wakeFillsGlowMeter

    Fish along a wake to fill your Glow meter faster!

  • ＋
    wakeFishedByOther

    Another angler fished along your wake.

  • ＋
    splashJarPrompt

    Check your splash jar

  • ＋
    splashJarFull

    Your splash jar is full! Tip it before you leave.

  • ＋
    splashJarStill

    Relight this island's lens to fill this jar.

  • ＋
    splashJarLow

    Your jar is nearly empty. Stay nearby to fill it.

  • ＋
    splashJarQuarter

    Your jar is about a quarter full.

  • ＋
    splashJarHalf

    Your jar is about half full.

  • ＋
    splashJarAlmost

    Your jar is nearly full.

  • ＋
    splashJarsStopped

    Tip your full jar at {{island}} to fill this one.

  • ＋
    splashJarRodHeld

    Put your rod away to tip your full jar.

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachName

    Into the Lantern Reach

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachDescription

    You've a real angler's hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I've never been back. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, so see Up Dog at the hub's Market first. He'll help you sell your way there.

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachLearnedDescription

    You've a real angler's hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I've never been back. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, and you know the Market already. Sell what you can spare and pay him!

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachFreeDescription

    You've a real angler's hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I've never been back. The Portal Guardian will let you through. Go and see it for me.

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachMarket

    Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachMarketDescription

    Visit Up Dog at the hub's Market. He'll show you how to sell spare resources for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachMarketLearned

    You've met Up Dog already, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachPortal

    Use the blue portal to the Lantern Reach

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachPortalDescription

    Toll paid! Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachFreePortalDescription

    Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachKeeper

    Speak to Stinky at the lighthouse

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachKeeperDescription

    Follow the jetty from the harbour to the lighthouse on its rock. You'll smell old Stinky before you see him! Tell him Blubberbeard sent you, and that I'm sorry.

  • ＋
    questIntoTheReachMeeting

    Blubberbeard sent you? My old apprentice... Tell him there's nothing to forgive. Welcome to the Lantern Reach, friend. Everyone here calls me Stinky, and you'll soon smell why! The Lamp has been dark a long while, and the fish sleep deep without its light. But a good angler might just wake them.

  • ＋
    keeperWickNothingToDo

    Sit a while and watch the water, friend. Upwind of me, if you like. Every ripple has a story.

  • ＋
    keeperWickQuestGreeting

    Ah, a visitor! Come into the light, such as it is. Don't mind the flies, they're old friends.

  • ＋
    keeperWickInventoryFull

    Your pack is full to the brim, friend. Make some room and come back.

  • ＋
    lanternReachHush

    This water is still. Only small fry bite here until Stinky's lens shines on it.

  • ＋
    questKeeperWickLensHandIn

    Ah, look at it glow! Thank you, friend.

  • ＋
    questKeeperWickLensReport

    Report back to Stinky

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensName

    The Kelpwood Lens

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensDescription

    The lagoon fish still carry a little of the old light. Catch me a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]], a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]], an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]] and a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]] here in the lagoon, and their glow will relight the lens that faces Kelpwood.

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensReportDescription

    Got all four? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.

  • ＋
    questNothingToForgiveName

    Nothing to Forgive

  • ＋
    questNothingToForgiveDescription

    The Lamp is waking at last, and its light reaches further every day. Would you carry a message for an old Keeper, friend? My apprentice never heard my answer. Tell Blubberbeard there's nothing to forgive, and that the Lamp burns again.

  • ＋
    questNothingToForgiveTell

    Tell Blubberbeard in the Hub

  • ＋
    questNothingToForgiveTellDescription

    Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and give him Stinky's answer.

  • ＋
    questNothingToForgiveCompleted

    He said that? Nothing to forgive... I've carried that guilt since I was a lad, matey. And the Lamp burns again! Here, take these two Glowtide Flares I've kept since I left. Light one over Reach water and think of an old Keeper.

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensCompleted

    Look, friend! The west lens is burning again, and its beam has reached Kelpwood. The fish there are waking already. Take my old Tidelight Rod. Its line still holds a little of the Lamp's light, so fish bite on it quicker and two at a time more often.

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensName

    The Amethyst Lens

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensDescription

    Kelpwood is waking, and its big fish glow brighter than anything in the lagoon. Catch me a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]], a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]], a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]], a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]] and an Oarfish [[Oarfish]] in Kelpwood's water, west across the bridge, and we'll light the lens that faces the Amethyst shoals.

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensReportDescription

    Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensCompleted

    Two lenses lit! The east beam has reached the Amethyst shoals, and the crystals are humming. This Glowglass Rod has a chip of the Kelpwood lens for a float, and fish come to it sooner.

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensName

    The Moonwell Lens

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensDescription

    Now the lens that faces the Moonwell, where the oldest fish sleep. It needs the brightest catches in the Reach. Catch me an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]], a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]], a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]], a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]] and a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]] in the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge.

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensReportDescription

    Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensCompleted

    Three beams across the water, friend! The Moonwell is stirring at last. Take the Moonwell Rod. It's cut from amethyst and cooled in that very pool, and the deepest fish rise to it.

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensHatchetfish

    Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensHatchetfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]. A thin silver thing that glints when it turns. The lagoon is full of them.

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensPolarflash

    Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensPolarflashDescription

    Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]. It still sparks a little in the lagoon's dark water. Quick on the hook!

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnow

    Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnowDescription

    Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]. Pale as mist, and the gentlest bite in the lagoon.

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouper

    Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]

  • ＋
    questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouperDescription

    Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]. It hides on the lagoon floor and rarely bites, so be patient.

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensArapaima

    Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensArapaimaDescription

    Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]. Big and slow, with a back as green as the kelp it hides in.

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensStingray

    Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensStingrayDescription

    Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]. It glides low through the mangrove roots. Reel it in steadily.

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensSawfish

    Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensSawfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]. Mind its nose! It fights hard all the way in from Kelpwood's channels.

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensSturgeon

    Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensOarfish

    Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensSturgeonDescription

    Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]. The oldest fish in Kelpwood, and a shy one.

  • ＋
    questAmethystLensOarfishDescription

    Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]. Long as a jetty and rarely seen. Keep casting in Kelpwood's water, and it will come.

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensEel

    Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensEelDescription

    Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]. It crackles with light of its own down in the shoals. Just the thing for a lens!

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensDarter

    Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensDarterDescription

    Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]. Quick as a shadow between the crystals. Watch your float closely.

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensMoray

    Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensMorayDescription

    Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]. It hides in the crystal cracks and bites hard when it does.

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensDragonfish

    Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensGiantMoray

    Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensDragonfishDescription

    Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]. It shines like moonlight on the Amethyst shoals.

  • ＋
    questMoonwellLensGiantMorayDescription

    Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]. The biggest hunter in the shoals, and the rarest bite of all. Patience, friend.

  • ＋
    questTheHushName

    The Hush

  • ＋
    questTheHushDescription

    Three lenses lit, and still the Lamp won't wake fully. That's the Hush, friend. It's no curse, only a great old fish that fell asleep in the Moonwell when the light went out, and the whole Reach went quiet with it. Will you call it up for me? Gently, now. It only needs waking.

  • ＋
    questTheHushCall

    Wait for the Hush in the Moonwell without reeling in

  • ＋
    questTheHushCallDescription

    Cast into the Moonwell, north across the bridge from the Lamp, and keep still while you wait: a tap or click reels the line in. When the Hush rises, tap to bring it up and it will swim home.

  • ＋
    questTheHushReturn

    Return to Stinky

  • ＋
    questTheHushReturnDescription

    The Hush is home in the deep again. Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.

  • ＋
    questTheHushCompleted

    There! Do you see it? The whole Lamp is shining, friend, brighter than I've seen it since I was young. The Hush was never our enemy. It only needed someone patient enough to call it up and let it be. Take these five Glowtide Flares, and fish the Moonwell whenever you like. That old fish may come up to say hello.

  • ＋
    questLanternReachMailName

    News of the Lantern Reach

  • ＋
    questLanternReachMailDescription

    There you are! The portal to the Lantern Reach can finally be opened. Blubberbeard grew up out there, and he's been staring at that portal all week. Go and ask him about it!

  • ＋
    questAskBlubberbeardAboutReach

    Ask Blubberbeard about the Lantern Reach

  • ＋
    questAskBlubberbeardAboutReachDescription

    Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and take on his task to reach the Lantern Reach.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentQuestGreeting

    There you are, dear. I was hoping you'd drift by.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentInventoryFull

    Your pockets are full, dear. Make a little room, and I'll give you what I owe you.

  • ＋
    questLostPoolName

    The Lost Pool

  • ＋
    questLostPoolDescription

    When I was young, dear, there was a pool hidden among these roots, where the kelp meets the cliff. The wisps still whisper of it. Would you find it and catch 3 fish there? I'd so like to know it's still alive.

  • ＋
    questLostPoolCatch

    Catch 3 fish in Kelpwood's hidden pool

  • ＋
    questLostPoolCatchDescription

    Search Kelpwood's west rim, behind the trees on the far side from its bridge, for a crack of hidden water. Cast into it and land 3 fish.

  • ＋
    questLostPoolReturn

    Return to Auntie Glenda

  • ＋
    questLostPoolReturnDescription

    The old pool is still full of fish. Go and tell Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood's roots.

  • ＋
    questLostPoolCompleted

    Still full of fish, after all these years... Thank you, dear. I feel a little lighter, as if the mist has thinned. Take these Glowtide Flares, and the [[Gold Coin]] that washed into my roots.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentLampFestivalInvited

    A festival at the Lamp? Oh, dear, I haven't been to one in a hundred years. I'll drift across the water as soon as the lanterns are lit.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentQuestGreeting

    You came back! I've got a really important job for you.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentInventoryFull

    Your bag's too full! Make some room, then come back. I've got something for you!

  • ＋
    questPerfectPitchName

    Perfect Pitch

  • ＋
    questPerfectPitchDescription

    When the Lamp's beam shines on my crystals, the fish swim up to listen! I want to hear them sing. Catch 3 fish where the beam touches the Amethyst water, and I'll tune to their song.

  • ＋
    questPerfectPitchCatch

    Catch 3 fish where the Lamp's beam touches the Amethyst water

  • ＋
    questPerfectPitchCatchDescription

    Find the column of light where the Lamp's beam touches the Amethyst water. It drifts across the water and rests now and then, so cast into it and keep your float in its light until the bite. Land 3 fish bitten there.

  • ＋
    questPerfectPitchReturn

    Return to Urchin

  • ＋
    questPerfectPitchReturnDescription

    The shoal sang in the beam's light. Go and tell Urchin by his dock hut.

  • ＋
    questPerfectPitchCompleted

    Listen... every crystal is singing the same song! You did it! Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]]. And tell Stinky he still hums flat. Don't say it was me!

  • ＋
    amethystResidentLampFestivalInvited

    A festival? With music?! I'll tune every crystal on the shoals. Can I stay up for the lanterns?

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentQuestGreeting

    Softly... oh, it's you. Come and sit by the well.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentInventoryFull

    Your pack is full... make a little room, and I'll give you what I promised.

  • ＋
    questGlowtideLullabyName

    Glowtide Lullaby

  • ＋
    questGlowtideLullabyDescription

    When the glowtide drifts over the Moonwell, the sleeping fish rise to dream in its glow. Would you catch 40 of them there for me? Then I'll know what they're dreaming, and what to sing.

  • ＋
    questGlowtideLullabyCatch

    Catch 40 fish in a glowtide bloom on the Moonwell

  • ＋
    questGlowtideLullabyCatchDescription

    Find a glowing glowtide bloom on the Moonwell's water, cast into it and land 40 fish while your float is in its glow. A Glowtide Flare calls up a bloom of your own.

  • ＋
    questGlowtideLullabyReturn

    Return to Hesper

  • ＋
    questGlowtideLullabyReturnDescription

    The Moonwell's fish rose to the glow. Go and tell Hesper at the Moonwell.

  • ＋
    questGlowtideLullabyCompleted

    They dream of the light... every one of them. I'll sing them something new tonight. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and keep the Moonwell glowing.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentLampFestivalInvited

    A festival at the Lamp... I'll bring my lantern, and sing the fish to sleep after. Wake me if I doze off.

  • ＋
    pimLampFestivalInvited

    A festival?! At the Lamp?! I'll hang the bunting! I'll bake! Oh, I've waited my whole life for this!

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalInvitedBlubberbeard

    A festival at the Lamp, and old Stinky asked for me? ...Tell him I'll be there, matey. It's high time I went home.

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalName

    The Lamp Festival

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalDescription

    The whole Lamp is shining, friend, and every island is awake again. Time we had a Lamp Festival, like the ones I knew as a boy! Will you invite everyone for me? Start with Auntie Glenda, over on Kelpwood.

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalRose

    Invite Rose to the Lamp Festival

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalRoseDescription

    Back to the harbour now. Find Rose by her Tide Ledger and invite her to the Lamp Festival. She'll want to bake.

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalGlenda

    Invite Auntie Glenda to the Lamp Festival

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalGlendaDescription

    Find Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood's roots, west across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalChime

    Invite Urchin to the Lamp Festival

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalChimeDescription

    Find Urchin by his dock hut on the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge, and invite him to the Lamp Festival.

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalHesper

    Invite Hesper to the Lamp Festival

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalHesperDescription

    Find Hesper at the Moonwell, north across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalBlubberbeard

    Invite Blubberbeard to the Lamp Festival

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalBlubberbeardDescription

    Everyone in the Reach is coming. Go back through the portal to the Hub, find Blubberbeard by his shack, and invite him home to the Lamp Festival.

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalReturn

    Return to Stinky

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalReturnDescription

    Blubberbeard is coming home! Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.

  • ＋
    questLampFestivalCompleted

    Blubberbeard's coming home? Oh, friend... I never stopped keeping a light on for him. Look at the Reach tonight: every island lit, and all of us together again. You did this. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and come to every festival we ever have.

  • ＋
    keeperWickHushWaitShh

    Shh... Keep still and let the line rest, friend.

  • ＋
    keeperWickHushWaitStill

    Still now. Something old is stirring...

  • ＋
    keeperWickHushWaitNearly

    Nearly... It's rising to you.

  • ＋
    keeperWickHushWaitAbandoned

    Shh... it's still close. Cast again and keep still.

  • ＋
    keeperWickHushReelLost

    Oh! It slipped back down, friend. Cast again, it's still close.

  • ＋
    keeperWickHushWaitInterrupted

    The Hush is still close, friend. Cast again when you're ready.

  • ＋
    keeperWickKeepersChairLocked

    Not yet, friend. The Keeper's Chair waits until the whole Lamp is awake.

  • ＋
    keeperWickKeepersChairWelcome

    Sit a while, friend. Turn the Lamp toward any water you've lit, and it will shine a little kinder there, just for you.

  • ＋

    Keeper's Chair

  • ＋
    keepersChairClose

    Close the Keeper's Chair

  • ＋
    keepersChairPrompt

    Sit in the Keeper's Chair

  • ＋

    Climb to the lantern room

  • ＋

    Climb down

    Aim the Lamp

    Aim the Lamp at {{island}}

    Lamp aimed

  • ＋

    Rest the Lamp

  • ＋
    keepersChairDark

    Lens still dark

  • ＋
    keepersChairTideNotice

    Today's Tide Notice

  • ＋
    keepersChairFavour

    Aimed water: blooms hold more rares and last longer, and the Tide Notice fish bites more often.

  • ＋
    keepersChairAimedStatus

    The Lamp shines on {{island}}.

  • ＋
    keepersChairRestedStatus

    The Lamp rests, shining on every island alike.

  • ＋
    keepersChairTooFar

    Climb to the lantern room to aim the Lamp.

  • ＋
    keepersChairNotRelit

    Relight that island's lens first.

  • ＋
    keeperWickReachLogWelcome

    My old logbook, friend. It smells of bait, like me! Land the biggest of each fish and I'll ink it in, bright as a beam.

  • ＋
    keeperWickReachLogPageGold

    A whole page in gold! Not even the Lamp shines that bright. Take these three Glowtide Flares, friend.

  • ＋
    keeperWickLampLightWelcome

    Every fish you let go leaves a little light behind, friend. The Lamp keeps it safe for you.

  • ＋
    keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseKelpwood

    A Kelpwood fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight Kelpwood's lens and they'll swim home.

  • ＋
    keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseAmethyst

    An Amethyst Shoals fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight their lens and they'll swim home.

  • ＋
    keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseMoonwell

    A Moonwell fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight the Moonwell's lens and they'll swim home.

  • ＋
    keeperWickHiddenWatersAllFound

    Every hidden water in the Reach! Even I'd forgotten one or two. Take this Glowtide Flare [[Radiant Spark]], friend.

    A gift from the Amethyst Shoals' Regulars. In a bloom, faster bites but fewer rares.

    Moonwell Pearl

  • ＋
    lampLightCharmMoonwellPearlEffect

    A gift from the Moonwell's Regulars. Away from blooms, slower bites with a few more rares; in a bloom, fewer rares.

  • ＋

    No orders on the Ledger right now. The tide will turn soon!

  • ＋

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentHome

    Feel that, dear? The moment that beam touched the kelp, the mist lifted, and I'm warm right through for the first time in years.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentGreeting

    Oh! Don't be frightened, dear. I'm only tall.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentAsleepGreeting

    Oh! Don't be frightened, dear. I'm only tall, and a touch misty while the water sleeps.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentAsleepTalk

    The kelp water has slept since the Lamp went dark, and the roots have grown so cold. Stinky at the Lamp knows how to relight Kelpwood's lens.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentWork

    I've drifted through these roots for centuries. Some nights I can almost see the way on... then the mist closes again.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentFavouriteFish

    Ever landed a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]? Its green is the kelp of the first morning I remember, centuries ago.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentHome

    Listen! The crystals are ringing again! I knew they would. Ding!

  • ＋
    amethystResidentGreeting

    Oh! Hello! Tiptoe, please. The crystals are tuning.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentAsleepGreeting

    Oh! Hello! Shh... the crystals haven't rung once since the light went out.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentAsleepTalk

    My crystals won't ring without the Lamp's beam, and the fish won't come up to listen. It's sooo quiet! Ask Stinky how to relight the Amethyst lens. Please?

  • ＋
    amethystResidentWork

    I tune all the crystals. All by myself! Hmm... that one's a teeny bit flat.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentFavouriteFish

    An Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]] hums the perfect note! I tune my crystals to it. Bzzzz!

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentHome

    Softly now... I stayed by the well through all the dark. Now the light's back, I can sing in it again.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentGreeting

    Softly now... the old fish are dreaming.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentAsleepGreeting

    Softly now... the whole Moonwell is asleep while the Lamp is dark.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentAsleepTalk

    I sing to the Moonwell every night, but its fish won't wake without the light. Perhaps Stinky could help you relight its lens...

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentWork

    Lullay, little fins... The oldest fish sleep deep down there. I hum to them each night so they dream of the light.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentFavouriteFish

    A Glacial Lanternfish [[Glacial Lanternfish]] glows just like a little lamp. On dark nights, I wish I had one to sing by.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentLoanAsk

    Lend me your next Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]] from Kelpwood? I'll keep it a day for its warmth, then let it go.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentLoanAskPopup

    Lend Auntie Glenda your next Mossback Arapaima? It comes back with a gift once the day turns over.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentLoanAccepted

    Thank you, dear. Land one on Kelpwood and it will find its way to me.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentLoanWaiting

    Still hoping for that Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]. From Kelpwood water, mind.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentLoanWithMe

    Your fish is circling my roots, not a bit afraid of me. Come and see me once the day's turned over.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentLoanBusy

    Oh, I've gone a little misty. Ask me again in a moment.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentLoanSpokenFor

    Spoken for: Auntie Glenda will love this one.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentLoanThanksSmall

    A little one, {{kg}} kg, but so warm and lively! It's back among the reeds. This is yours.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentLoanThanksFine

    A fine {{kg}} kg! It kept me company all night, and now it's swimming free. Take this, with my thanks.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentLoanThanksBig

    {{kg}} kg! I haven't felt so much life in a century. It swam off proud. For you.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentSplashJarTipped

    A full jar, dear! I watched over it while it filled. Straight into your net.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentLoanAsk

    Can I borrow your next Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]] from the shoals? Its hum will fix my flat crystal, then it can swim home.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentLoanAskPopup

    Lend Urchin your next Electric Eel? It comes back with a gift once the day turns over.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentLoanAccepted

    Yay! Land one in Amethyst water and it comes to me. I'll get my tuning fork!

  • ＋
    amethystResidentLoanWaiting

    No Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]] yet? It has to be from the shoals! My crystal is still all wonky.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentLoanWithMe

    Your eel is humming lovely and I'm still tuning. Come back when the day has turned over, okay?

  • ＋
    amethystResidentLoanBusy

    Shh, I'm holding a note! Ask me again in a bit.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentLoanSpokenFor

    Spoken for: Urchin will love this one.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentLoanThanksSmall

    A tiny eel, {{kg}} kg, but what a big voice! My crystal rings true, and the eel is back in the shoals. Yours!

  • ＋
    amethystResidentLoanThanksFine

    {{kg}} kg of perfect humming! I tuned three crystals with it, then let it go. Here, take this!

  • ＋
    amethystResidentLoanThanksBig

    A {{kg}} kg eel! It hummed like a harbour bell, and my whole shelf rang along! It swam home singing. This is yours!

  • ＋
    amethystResidentSplashJarTipped

    Did you hear that? Splish, splash, plop! That's three notes!

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentLoanAsk

    Could I borrow your next Glacial Lanternfish [[Glacial Lanternfish]] from the Moonwell? One lullaby, then it swims free.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentLoanAskPopup

    Lend Hesper your next Glacial Lanternfish? It comes back with a gift once the day turns over.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentLoanAccepted

    Thank you... Land one in the Moonwell, and it will find its way to me.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentLoanWaiting

    I'm still listening for a Glacial Lanternfish [[Glacial Lanternfish]] from the Moonwell.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentLoanWithMe

    Shh... your lanternfish is dozing by my lantern. Visit me once the day has turned over.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentLoanBusy

    Hush a moment... the verse isn't done. Ask me again soon.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentLoanSpokenFor

    Spoken for: Hesper will love this one.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentLoanThanksSmall

    Your little lanternfish, {{kg}} kg, dozed off by the second verse. It drifted down to the deep. Something for you.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentLoanThanksFine

    I sang to your {{kg}} kg lanternfish all night; it glowed with every note. It glides in the dark water now. Here.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentLoanThanksBig

    Such a big one, {{kg}} kg... its glow lit the whole well while I sang. It sank away slowly, still shining. Thank you.

  • ＋
    moonwellResidentSplashJarTipped

    Softly now... that one was dozing in the jar. Off you go, little fins.

  • ＋
    pimResidentLoanKelpwood

    Auntie Glenda's glowing over at Kelpwood! Sounds like she has something for you.

  • ＋
    pimResidentLoanAmethyst

    Urchin's waving from the Amethyst shoals! Something about a crystal, and something for you.

  • ＋
    pimResidentLoanMoonwell

    Hesper's lantern is swinging over at the Moonwell. She has something for you!

  • ＋
    pimResidentLoanSeveral

    Your friends on the isles are waving! Some of them have something for you.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentReturnerThanksA

    My locket, dear! Caught on {{name}}'s fin all these years? I lost it before the Lamp was built. Here's {{coins}} [[Gold Coin]], with my thanks.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentReturnerThanksB

    Is that my old comb? On {{name}}, of all fish! You clever thing. {{coins}} [[Gold Coin]] for you, dear, and not a word of argument.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentFeatPageGold

    Stinky says every Kelpwood fish in your Reach Log has a Gold mark now. I've not seen the like in three hundred years, dear!

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentFeatReturner

    The roots are still whispering about that giant {{fish}} you hooked!

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentFeatHaloA

    Your {{fish}} came up in the beam's light, didn't it? It shone right through me!

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentFeatHaloB

    A {{fish}} touched by the Lamp's beam! That light felt almost warm.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentFeatHiddenWater

    You found the crack through the west rim? Clever dear. I drift through there on quiet nights.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentFeatGoldFishA

    A Gold mark for your {{fish}}! I've watched anglers for centuries, and that's among the finest.

  • ＋
    kelpwoodResidentFeatGoldFishB

    Word drifted to my roots about your Gold {{fish}}. Well done, dear. Now sit a while with an old ghost.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentReturnerThanksB

    My spare tuning fork! It's back from the deep and still perfectly in tune! {{name}} looked after it. Here's {{coins}} [[Gold Coin]]!

  • ＋
    amethystResidentFeatPageGold

    Gold on every Amethyst fish in your Reach Log! The crystals rang a whole chord when I told them.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentFeatReturner

    That giant {{fish}} you landed! The crystals are still humming about it.

  • ＋
    amethystResidentFeatHaloA

    A {{fish}} caught in the beam's light! I bet it rang like a bell!

  • ＋
    amethystResidentFeatHaloB

    Your beam-touched {{fish}}! I heard it from here. Ding!

  • ＋
    amethystResidentFeatHiddenWater

    You found the crack past my spires? That's my secret echo spot! Hellooo!

  • ＋
    amethystResidentFeatGoldFishA

    A Gold {{fish}}? Wow! That needs a fanfare. Ta-da-daaa!

  • ＋

  • ＋

2026年11月6日 01:30bny9u → 6i9gblo

スカイブロックに「プロフィール(最大3つ)」、Spencer の島づくりクエスト(小屋・灯台・花壇・池・果樹園)、自動で作物を作る「Helper」。観戦の操作表示、テクスチャパックの制限、Potion Table が Cauldron に改名

＋ 新しい文言 263〜 書き換え 6－ 削除 2
👤
遊ぶ人

スカイブロック: プロフィールを最大3つ持てる(個人用 / 共同用)

「Profiles(プロフィール)」の分類が追加されました。1 つのアカウントで、最大 3 つのプロフィールを作れて、それぞれが自分の島と進み具合を持ちます。種類は「Personal profile(個人用)」と「Co-op profile(共同用)」です。画面では、新規作成(「新しい島で最初からやり直す」)、切り替え(Switch)、名前の変更(連続では変えられず、数十秒の待ち時間あり)、削除ができます。削除は、プロフィールの名前を正確に入力しないとできず、島と進み具合は完全に消えます。切り替えには条件があります。ダンジョンの途中では切り替えられない。島を一度訪れてからでないと切り替えられない。切り替え直後は待ち時間がある。メールが届いたままのプロフィールは、先に切り替えて受け取らないと消せない。持ち物や Moonstone Chest の中身が多すぎると、切り替えに失敗し、「片付けてからもう一度」と出ます。同じ文言群に、メールボックス(「You've got mail!」)も入りました。

3 つのプロフィールで、ゴールド、スキル、持ち物のどこまでが別々なのかは、文言からは分かりません。共同用プロフィールの人数の上限も不明です。

確かさ: 文言は確実 / 引き継ぐ範囲の細部は推測
🎨
遊ぶ人

Spencer のクエストが大幅に増えた(島を作り込む流れ)

前回追加された新 NPC の Spencer(絵描き)が、島づくりのクエストを次々に出す形になりました。
【建築】Cosy Cabin(小屋): Maple Door を作って置き、扉の 4 マス以内に、木か石の壁 20 ブロック(扉と同じ高さ)、ガラス 4 枚、ほかの条件を満たして建てます。ガラスは、ハブの浜の砂を炉で焼いて作ります。Lighthouse(灯台): Artisan Bench(島に置く作業台)でランタンを作り、10 ブロック以上の高さの塔のてっぺんに置きます。
【畑・庭】Carrot Patch: Manor Farm でニンジンの種 16 個を集め、4×4 に植えて育てる。Flower Bed: 赤チューリップ・ピンクチューリップ・デイジーを 4 本ずつ集め、3 種類以上の花 12 本を、真ん中の 1 本から 3 ブロック以内に植える。Fish Pond: バケツ 4 杯の水を汲み、島に 2×2×深さ 1 の穴を作って池にし、釣りで魚を 1 匹釣る(島には水がないので、水はハブで汲みます)。Orchard: ヤシの苗 1 本と梨の苗 2 本を育てる。
【石】Twin Springs: 石 64 個と石炭 16 個を渡して、2 つ目の Stone Generator をもらい、2 つの生成器から石を 32 個掘る。
【絵の具】Paint Box(赤と黄): 梨ブロック 3 個とスイカのスライス 32 個。Deep Purple(紫と金): ビートルート 16 個と、金のかけら 8 個(Cragrock Mines の金鉱石から)。Bone White(白): 骨 20 個(Wild Infernos の骸骨から)と、Magma Golem から落ちる Golem Eye 4 個。報酬として、赤・黄のコンクリート、スイカの種、紫のガラス、紫のたいまつ、桜の苗などがもらえる文言があります。
【毎日】「Island Order」: 小麦 32、ニンジン 32、石 32、Maple の原木 16 のどれかを、日替わりで頼まれます。

建築の判定(壁の数や形)の細かい条件は、文言の一部しか見えていません。報酬は文言に出ている分だけで、全部とは限りません。

確かさ: 文言は確実 / 報酬の量は不明
🤖
遊ぶ人

新アイテム: Wheat Helper / Carrot Helper(島にいる間に作物を作る装置)

島に置くと、自分が島にいる間、小麦やニンジンを自動で作ってくれる装置です。使うと、たまった分を受け取れます。持ち物がいっぱいのときは、装置が保管してくれます。置けるのは、それぞれ島に 1 つまでで、中身が残っているうちは動かせません。受け取れるのは島の持ち主だけです。Carrot Helper は、クエスト文言に「ニンジン 1 個を 45 秒ごと」とあります。クエストで、Wheat Helper は Spencer からもらい、Carrot Helper は、鉄のインゴット 4 個とニンジン 32 個を渡して作ってもらいます。

小麦が何秒ごとにできるかは、クエスト文言には出ていません。装置が貯められる上限も不明です。

確かさ: ニンジン 1 個 45 秒は確実(文言)/ 小麦の間隔は不明
🧪
遊ぶ人

「Potion Table」が「Cauldron」に改名

アイテム名の表示が、「Potion Table(ポーション台)」から「Cauldron(大釜)」に変わりました。クエストの Stone Generator の条件も、「Messy Stone 32 個」から「Messy Stone か Stone」に緩くなりました(普通の Stone でも納品できます)。

見た目やレシピが変わったかは、文言だけでは分かりません。

確かさ: 確実
👀
遊ぶ人

観戦中の操作の表示(セッション制のゲーム)

観戦中に出る操作案内が追加されました。「クリックで次のプレイヤー」「右クリックで自由に飛ぶ」「タップで次のプレイヤー(スマホ)」、メニューの項目は「Next Player / Fly Freely / Watch Players」です。

どのゲームモードで使われるのかは不明です。

確かさ: 文言は確実
🧑‍💻
作る人

テクスチャパックの制限と、スタジオの新しい指標

カスタムテクスチャパックで、外部の画像やリソースの URL は使えなくなり、パックの中にファイルを全部入れる必要があります。外部 URL を使っているゲームのパックは、適用できない旨の案内が出ます。ワールドビルダーには、「変更が保存されませんでした」の案内が入りました。スタジオ(作ったゲームの統計)には、「◯分以上遊んだ人の割合」と「◯分以内に抜けた人の割合」の指標が追加され、「抜ける人を減らすのが遊ぶ時間を伸ばす一番の近道」という説明が付いています(古い指標 2 つは入れ替わりました)。

確かさ: 文言は確実

2026年11月5日 01:00op8uk → bny9u

スカイブロックに新NPC「Spencer」と、島に置ける「Trading Terminal(自宅でマーケットと銀行)」「Stone Generator」。コードエディタにチャット。Frontline の画面表示、プッシュ通知の設定

＋ 新しい文言 92〜 書き換え 1－ 削除 1
🏝️
遊ぶ人

スカイブロック: 新しい隣人 Spencer(絵描き)と島のクエスト

島に引っ越してくる NPC「Spencer」が追加されました。Maverick から「Spencer が島を明るくしたがっている。会いに行って」と案内され、Spencer が島に住み着いたあとは、島の中でクエストを出します。クエストは次のとおりです。(1) 「Maple の木を 5 本育てる」: Maple の葉を集め、Maple の原木 1 と葉 1 を作業台で合わせて苗にします。(2) 「Crop Circles」: 小麦の種 9 個を、島の平らな地面に 3×3 の正方形に植え、全部育つまで島にいます。種はハブの Tillie の畑の小麦から取れます。(3) 「Trading from Home」: Trading Terminal を買って置き、売買まで体験します(次の項目)。(4) 「A Spring of Stone」: Messy Stone を 32 個集めて渡し、Stone Generator をもらいます(その次の項目)。前の更新で入った「Maverick」の島の案内の続きで、島を発展させる流れの一部です。

クエストの報酬(金貨や経験値など)は、文言に出ていないため不明です。「島に住み着く」演出の細かい動きも、文言からは分かりません。

確かさ: 文言は確実 / 順番や報酬の細部は推測
🛒
遊ぶ人

Trading Terminal: 島にいながらマーケットと銀行を開ける

新しいアイテム「Trading Terminal」を島に置くと、その横に立つだけで、ハブにしかなかった Market(売買)と Bank(銀行)を開けます。ハブのマーケットで Up Dog から買えて、クエストの文言には「100 Gold Coin」とあります。ショップにも「Market at Home」という分類ができました。端末から離れすぎていると「Step closer to your Trading Terminal to trade」と出ます。Market では、Instant Sell(すぐ売る)、出品して他のプレイヤーに売る、Orders タブで注文を出す、ができます。

100 Gold Coin は Spencer のクエスト文言の値で、ショップ上の価格と同じかは確認していません。置ける個数の上限は文言に出ていません。

確かさ: 文言は確実 / 価格は文言に1か所だけ
🪨
遊ぶ人

Stone Generator: 上に石が生えてくる装置

「Stone Generator」は、置くと、その上に新しい Stone が生えてくるアイテムです(上が空いている必要があります)。Spencer のクエストで、Messy Stone 32 個と引き換えにもらえます。なくしても Spencer が再配布してくれます。1 つの島に置ける数には上限があり、超えると「壊して場所を空けて」と出ます。クエストでは「自分の島で、生成された Stone を 10 個掘る」ことを求められます。

上限の個数と、石が再び生えるまでの時間は、サーバー側のようで不明です。

確かさ: 文言は確実 / 石が生える間隔は不明
🏰
遊ぶ人

スカイブロック: ダンジョンの入場条件(Watch Dog の許可)

ダンジョンの前の広間で、Watch Dog が入場を管理する文言が入りました。ダンジョンは像ごとに封印されていて、中心にボスがいます。Skullforge のボスは、石のゴーレム「Forge Warden」です。Watch Dog の許可を受けて、渡される棍棒(なくしたら予備をくれる)を持って挑戦します。何も持たずに入ることは勧められていません。順番も決まっていて、Skullforge を Easy で倒すと Frozen Hollow が開き、Frozen Hollow を Easy で倒すと Wildwood Grove が開きます。

難易度(Easy 以外)ごとの違いや、各ダンジョンのボスの強さは、不明です。

確かさ: 文言は確実
🧑‍💻
作る人

コードエディタ: チャット表示と、ライト/ダークモード

コードを書いている画面の横に、ワールドのチャットを出せる「Show Chat / Hide Chat」が追加されました(説明は「コードを書きながらプレイヤーと話せる」)。チャンネルごとの入力欄(Tab キーで切り替え)があります。あわせて、エディタを「ライトモード / ダークモード」に切り替えるボタンも入りました。

確かさ: 文言は確実
🔔
遊ぶ人

プッシュ通知の設定画面と、フレンドの招待の通知

通知設定に「Push Notifications」の項目が増えました。自分のどの端末に通知が届くか(Bloxd アプリ、ブラウザ、MSN Play の台数)を表示し、「この端末でオンにする」ボタンがあります。通知の案内文には「フレンドに招待されたとき」が加わりました。招待を開いたとき、友達がもうそのゲームを抜けていた場合の案内(「Your friend has left that game」)も入りました。

確かさ: 文言は確実 / 通知が届く条件は不明
🎯
遊ぶ人

Frontline の画面表示と、シューティングのヒント

Frontline(ゲーム一覧に前からあるチーム戦)の画面表示の文言が追加されました。拠点を「Capturing(占領中)/ Contesting(奪い合い)/ Defending(防衛中)/ Captured(占領済み)」で表し、「OBJ-◯ // 味方 v 敵」の形で人数を示します。「First to ◯(先に◯点)」というチケット(点数)の勝利条件があり、「Objective secured / Objective lost / Reinforcements / Round over」といった軍事風のお知らせが出ます。チームは Red と Blue です。シューティングでは、「ショップで無料の連続キル(streak)特典を選ぶと、次の連続キルでボーナス」というヒントが入りました。

ゲームのルール(点数の増え方、拠点の数など)は、サーバー側にあり、文言からは分かりません。

確かさ: 文言は確実 / ルールの詳細は推測
🔧
作る人

内部: ビルド全体の入れ替えと、ファイル6つの追加

ビルドIDが op8uk から bny9u に変わり、195 個のファイルのハッシュが変わりました。さらに、ファイル(チャンク)が 6 つ追加されています(196〜201 番)。コード内には、日付の文字列「2026-11-04T12:00:00Z」(日本時間 11/4 21:00)があり、新しいスカイブロックの機能の公開時刻などを管理する印かもしれませんが、推測です。

追加された 6 つのファイルの中身は、まだ読んでいません。

確かさ: 追加は確実 / 中身は未確認
